title: Connect 4
description:
Connect 4 is a timeless strategy game that challenges your thinking, planning, and observation skills. In this digital version, two players take turns dropping colored discs into a vertical grid. Your goal is to be the first to connect four of your own discs in a row, either horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. The rules are easy to understand, but winning takes careful thought and smart decisions, which makes Connect 4 both fun and rewarding for players of all ages.
The game begins with an empty grid and two sets of colored discs. One player uses one color, and the other player uses a different color. Each turn, a player selects a column and drops a disc from the top. The disc falls to the lowest available space in that column. Because discs stack from the bottom up, every move can create new opportunities or change the strategy for both players.
One of the best things about Connect 4 is how simple the concept is while still offering deep strategic play. At first glance, dropping a disc into a column seems easy, but as the game progresses, you begin to notice patterns and plan several moves ahead. You might place a disc to block your opponent’s potential four-in-a-row, or you might build toward your own winning pattern. This mix of offense and defense keeps every game interesting.
The game also moves at a nice pace. There is no timer, and neither player is rushed. This gives you time to think about your next move and watch how the board changes after every turn. It’s a great game to play when you want a thoughtful challenge or when you want to challenge a friend to a match of clever moves and smart thinking.
Connect 4 is perfect for playing with a friend or family member on the same device. Taking turns makes each round feel like a face-to-face battle of wits. Because every player can see the grid clearly, both sides can think ahead and react to each other’s strategy. Whether you play for just a few minutes or enjoy longer sessions trying to outmaneuver each other, the game offers plenty of fun.
The clean graphics and simple layout make it easy to focus on the game board. There are no complicated menus or confusing controls. You simply choose a column and tap to place your disc. This makes Connect 4 accessible to new players while giving strategic depth for those who enjoy thoughtful games.
Connect 4 also teaches important skills such as pattern recognition, planning ahead, and making decisions based on how the board is developing. Each match feels unique because your opponent’s moves affect your strategy and force you to adapt.
Whether you are playing a quick round or a longer series of matches, Connect 4 provides a satisfying mix of simplicity and strategy that keeps players coming back for more. This classic game stays fun through every move and every challenge, making it a great choice for anyone who enjoys smart, engaging gameplay.

𝑯𝒆𝒍𝒊𝒄𝒐𝒑𝒕𝒆𝒓 𝑮𝒂𝒎𝒆 is an absolute classic Flash game of balance and timing, first released in 2004. It has been created by David McCandless and the team of Seethru.
So, you think you can fly? Well, don't be so sure! 
It gets pretty hairy up there, once you're fighting gravity and dealing with an X and a Y axis, you might just realize that flying is for the birds. Sharpen your retinas and crack your knuckles. 
Keep an eye on your speed, watch your altimeter, don't roll, don't overheat, avoid obstacles and try to keep your cool as you turbo thrust your way through a series f levels which get harder, faster, and more impossible to pass. If you thought a game like flappy bird was hard to play, you don't know what you're talking about. You literally have no idea. This is a chopper game designed to break you, to frustrate and intimidate. Only the strongest pilots with the most iron of wills and the hardiest hearts will be able to take on these obstacle courses, navigate, and survive! 
How long will you be able to outplay the game itself? 
Can you defeat it to survive longer than your friends? 
Will you spend hours of your time racking up a high score only to see all of your hard work dashed in half the time by someone a quarter of your age? 
Yes absolutely. 
Such is the curse of the legendary 𝑯𝒆𝒍𝒊𝒄𝒐𝒑𝒕𝒆𝒓 𝑮𝒂𝒎𝒆.

title: Galaga
description:
Galaga is a legendary arcade shooter that brings fast-paced space battle excitement to your browser. In this classic game, you control a lone starfighter at the bottom of the screen and face endless waves of alien enemies descending from above. Your goal is simple: survive as long as you can, defeat every enemy, and score the highest number of points before your ship is destroyed.
The gameplay in Galaga is clear and thrilling. You move your ship left and right while firing at enemy ships that swoop down in patterns. Some enemies fly in predictable paths, while others dive toward you with sudden attacks. Each wave becomes more challenging, requiring quick reactions and careful timing to avoid being hit. Staying in motion and aiming your shots carefully help you stay alive longer and earn a bigger score.
Enemies in Galaga come in different shapes and formations, and each type behaves in its own way. Some enemies split into smaller ships when hit, while others can capture your ship with a tractor beam. If your ship is captured, you have a chance to rescue it by defeating the enemy holding it, giving you two ships in return for extra firepower. This adds a fun twist to the classic shooter formula and rewards bold play.
The controls are simple and responsive, making Galaga easy to start playing but hard to master. With just movement and shooting, the game focuses on pure arcade action that tests your reflexes and shooting accuracy. As enemy waves grow faster and more complex, every shot counts and every dodge matters.
Visually, Galaga uses bright, retro-style graphics that pay homage to the original arcade game while remaining clear and easy to follow. The space backdrop and colorful enemy ships make each match feel like a cosmic battle, and the smooth animation keeps the action lively.
Galaga is perfect for short play sessions when you want a quick challenge, but it is also easy to spend longer trying to beat your best score. Players often return again and again to improve their performance, survive longer, and see how high they can climb on the leaderboard.
If you enjoy classic shooter games with nonstop action, simple controls, and rising challenge levels, Galaga delivers a timeless space battle experience that remains fun and addictive today. Pilot your ship, blast the alien waves, and see how far you can go in this iconic arcade adventure.

𝐁𝐮𝐛𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐫 is an original puzzle game where the goal is to clear all the bubbles on the board by matching 3 or more bubbles of the same color. When the third one connects to the other two (or more) the whole formation will pop and disappear freeing some space for the player to manoeuvre. The only way to do that is to shoot additional bubbles from the top of the screen aiming at the ones you want to get rid of.
Playing a 𝐁𝐮𝐛𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐫 game during a break is a great way to give your mind some rest without shutting it off completely. The twist of this particular title is that the bubbles are organized into a neat hexagon that rotates depending on the angle and the velocity of your shots allowing you to adjust its position for optimal view. Aim with your mouse by adjusting the arrow at the top indicating the direction of your future shot, then click the left mouse button to shoot. If your bubble doesn’t pop anything it will be added to the main bunch making things just a tad more cluttered and difficult for you.
The decision to release 𝐁𝐮𝐛𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐫 online was a great move on the part of the developers: there is very little preventing the players from checking it out, since there’s no need to wait for a download to finish or install the game on a physical drive. All of the fun this game has to offer can be had right then and there in the browser tab without any issues or inconveniences.
Fans of 𝐁𝐮𝐛𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐫 play it whenever they get a couple of minutes to spare. It’s also a great way to keep busy while watching a TV show or listening to a podcast. Even at school or at work a game like this wouldn’t hurt anyone’s productivity, because it can be played in the background and minimized whenever a particularly demanding task arises. Can you clear all the bubbles on the board? Give it a try and see how long you can keep going!

title: Spot the Difference
description:
Spot the Difference is a fast and fun observation game that tests how sharp your eyes really are. Two pictures appear side by side, and your task is simple but challenging. Find the three differences between the images before the timer runs out.
At first glance, the pictures may look exactly the same, but small details have been changed. It could be a missing object, a color difference, or a small visual change hidden in plain sight. You need to scan the images carefully and react quickly to spot what does not match.
The game is all about focus and speed. As soon as the round begins, the countdown starts, pushing you to look closely and think fast. The faster you find the differences, the better you perform. Each correct click brings you closer to completing the puzzle, while mistakes can cost valuable time.
Spot the Difference is easy to understand and play. You simply click on the part of the image where you notice something different. No complex controls or instructions are needed, making it accessible for players of all ages. It is especially enjoyable for quick play sessions when you want a short but engaging challenge.
As you continue playing, the puzzles become more demanding. Differences become more subtle, and images require closer inspection. This keeps the game interesting and encourages you to improve your attention to detail and visual memory.
The clean and clear visuals help you focus fully on the task. Each image is designed to look almost identical, which makes finding the differences both tricky and satisfying. Successfully spotting all three differences before time runs out gives a strong sense of accomplishment.
Spot the Difference is not only entertaining but also great for improving concentration and observation skills. It is a perfect game for relaxing your mind while still keeping it active.
If you enjoy quick puzzle games that challenge your eyes and your speed, Spot the Difference delivers a fun and rewarding experience. Look closely, stay calm under pressure, and see if you can find all the differences before the clock reaches zero.

title: Snail Bob 6: Winter Story
description:
Snail Bob 6: Winter Story is a charming puzzle adventure set in a snowy winter world. In this chapter of the Snail Bob series, Bob’s grandpa is captured by a mischievous villain, and it is up to Bob to travel through icy landscapes and rescue him. Each level is filled with clever mechanisms and interactive objects that you must use to guide Bob safely to the exit.
You do not control Bob directly. He keeps moving forward on his own, and your task is to adjust the environment around him. You will press buttons, pull levers, open doors, move platforms, melt ice, and block dangerous traps to clear a safe path. The game rewards careful timing and creative thinking as you solve the puzzles in each stage.
Winter Story features beautifully themed levels with snow, ice, festive decorations, and fun holiday animations. Some stages include new winter elements like sliding platforms or frozen objects that behave differently from anything in the earlier Snail Bob games. These snowy mechanics add variety and make the puzzles feel fresh.
Each level also hides three stars that you can collect by paying close attention to the environment. Finding all of them adds an extra layer of challenge and encourages players to explore every detail on screen. Some stars are hidden in plain sight, while others require solving small secondary puzzles.
The game gradually becomes more challenging as you progress, introducing faster traps, moving obstacles, and more complex puzzle layouts. Still, the controls remain simple, and the design stays friendly and enjoyable throughout.
Snail Bob 6: Winter Story is a fun and thoughtful puzzle game that focuses on timing, logic, and observation. Guiding Bob through the winter world and helping him rescue his grandpa creates a warm and engaging adventure that keeps players interested from one level to the next.

title: The Impossible Quiz
description:
The Impossible Quiz is a legendary quiz game originally created in 2007 by Splapp-Me-Do and first released as a Flash game. Now you can enjoy it again without Flash, directly in your browser. What looks like a simple quiz quickly turns into a strange, funny, and challenging experience that tests far more than basic knowledge.
The game presents you with a series of questions, but answering them is rarely straightforward. Many questions rely on wordplay, visual tricks, unexpected logic, or completely absurd ideas. The correct answer is often not what it seems at first glance, forcing you to think creatively and question every assumption.
As you progress, the quiz becomes increasingly unpredictable. Some questions require fast reactions, others demand careful observation, and a few even encourage you to interact with your mouse or browser in unusual ways. The game constantly surprises you, making each new question feel like a puzzle rather than a traditional quiz.
The humor in The Impossible Quiz is intentionally random and silly, reflecting the internet style of the late 2000s. While some jokes may feel strange or outdated, the creativity behind the questions remains clever and memorable. The game challenges you to laugh, think, fail, and try again, often all within a few seconds.
You are given a limited number of lives, and one wrong move can cost you dearly. This makes every question feel important and adds tension to even the most ridiculous moments. Many players remember struggling to finish the quiz, as it often requires trial and error, patience, and a willingness to learn from mistakes.
Despite its silly appearance, The Impossible Quiz is not easy. It encourages problem solving, lateral thinking, and attention to detail. Success often comes from experimenting, noticing small clues, and thinking beyond normal quiz rules.
The simple visuals and sound effects help keep the focus on the questions themselves. Each failure becomes part of the experience, and every correct answer feels like a small victory. It is the kind of game that players often remember and talk about long after playing.
The Impossible Quiz is perfect for players who enjoy unconventional puzzles, clever tricks, and humorous challenges. If you like games that break the rules and make you think in unexpected ways, this classic quiz offers a unique and memorable experience that still stands out today.

description: Join the fun in this simple and cute puzzle game. Match two and more of the same animal to clear. beware not to click on single animal or be ready to lose a life. Let’s see how far you can get. Let’s frenzy!!

title: Realistic Ice Fishing
description:
To all fans of winter fishing is dedicated.
It is your turn, fans of winter fishing, it is time to go on the ice!
Ice fishing is a special fishing. In this fishing involves catching a cold and very limited time.  Ice fishing does have its own set of rules. 
- Be mindful of everyone's personal space. Don't drill a hole too close to another hole.
- Mark your holes. Click the mouse on the lake.

title: Connect Me Factory
description: Connect Me Factory is a challenging and cute puzzle game. Your goal is to connect all blocks with each other. Try to master all 60 levels by rotating and moving the little blocks around until they all stick together happily.

title: Monkey in Trouble 2
description: Are you smarter then the big Gorilla? Collect all the fruit by letting it fall down to the ground before the Gorilla gets to you. Shoot bananas at the Gorilla with the space bar and walk over the fruit to let it fall down. Control your monkey with the arrow keys.

title: World Peg Football
description: Take out all the red players as you kick the ball with precision and skill. Hit the ref for a double ball bonus and the streaker for big score wins

title: Clicker Heroes
description: Click, click, and click as you deal damage to monster to earn coins. Upgrade and and buy heroes to fight for you. It is basically an idle adventure game. How many level can get to? Save your progress by click on the button on the top right corner, you’ll be given a code when you export, paste the code into game to import to resume where you left off.

title: Timber Man
description: Cut the never ending try from the proper side as you avoid chopping & getting hit by a branch.

title: Bobby the Fish
description: Eat smaller fishes, and avoid biggers and sharks.

title: Mysterious Pirate Jewels
description: Mouse over aligned jewels & clear the ones that have a golden background tiles. Use the key to win.

title: Emily's Diary: Birthday Party
description: Nia was really cute little witch. The party was full of muggles, wizards, white owls and sweets with unpredictable flavors. Girls had a fascinating journey to the Harry Potter world and had so much fun that they could stay there forever.

title: Soccer Physics
description: Two-button soccer game! So dumb it’s fun.

title: Discover Istanbul
description: Collapse the gems as you clear the golden tiles & make the key drop through the dashed area.

title: Bubble Meadow 2
description: Get rid of all bubbles in this bubbleshooter game Bubble Meadow 2! A beautiful bubble shooter game. You must shoot the bubbles strategically to maximize your score ouput.

title: Mini Putt Gem Garden
description: It's a mini-putt adventure in two parts encompassing 18 levels across 2 themed courses - Morning Garden and Water Park. Each course gradually introduces new game-play features and puzzles - from navigating water logged lilly pads to avoiding getting stuck in the mud!

title: Classic Boxing
description: Classic Boxing is a tribute to Activision’s Boxing (Atari 2600 | 1980). The focus is on online multiplayer with a world ranking.

title: Snail Bob 7: Fantasy Story
description:
Our little snail dreamed of fantastic adventures, knights and mythical quests. Well, you'll never guess what; his dreams have come true in Snail Bob 7!
Our little spiral-hulled hero can't get enough as he faces the greatest dangers he's ever faced across 30 brand-new levels. In this strange universe, absolutely everything is possible throughout this 7th episode. Discover new mechanics and new puzzles, and Bob the snail can even transform into other animals to cross certain passages.
Improve your puzzle solving skills and have fun playing the game Snail Bob 7: Fantasy Story here, at Y8.com!

title: Smart Pen
description: Draw line trajectory to destroy all circles! Play the Smart Pen game at Y8 now and have fun.

title: Ryona Bowman
description: Tap, drag, and release anywhere on the screen to fire an arrow. Double tapping will open up the pause menu. Land head shots for more damage! Enjoy 4 playable modes including, Practice, vs player, vs CPU, and Birds!

title: Swing Copters
description:
Not easy to fly with such helicopter but try it.
You just will be CRAZY ^^

title: My Dolphin Show 4
description: My Dolphin Show 4 is an entertaining game where you take control of a playful dolphin, guiding it to leap high, dive gracefully and swim through colorful hoops. With each successful jump and trick, you earn points and delight the audience. The game combines fun challenges with creative stunts, making every performance exciting and rewarding for players of all ages. Play games on Y8 - The biggest modern HTML5 gaming platform!

title: Baby Hazel Bathroom Hygiene
description: Avoid contact of germs by maintaining good hygiene standards!! This time Baby Hazel learns to maintain bathroom hygiene standards. Her bathroom is wholly messed up and bathroom accessories are stained and dirty. Help Hazel in performing hygiene care activities such as clearing the mess, unclogging a washbasin drain and cleaning the bathroom accessories.

title: Crane It Up!!
description: Because Zombie is most popular nowadays, Tifa father always bought her Zombie dolls..but Tifa want to have another doll, she really like a bear dolls..Help Tifa to get a bear dolls as much as you can ^^..

title: Drive Thru
description: Wecdonald is a famous fast-food restaurant. Because the queue is always long at counter the restaurant manager decide to introduce drive-thru system. Help the manager to serve the customers effectively and efficiently.

title: Blackbeard's Island
description:
Captain Blackbeard lost his gold coins on the forsaken caribbean island.
Help him recover his pirate treasure - pick up all the coins throughout the 12 levels.
Unfortunately for the Captain, once he starts to run, he can only stop at the solid obstacles.
Swipe on the screen to guide the captain, but beware the nasty crabs and undead pirates.
If Captain Blackbeard runs off the screen he’ll surely die in the jungle - you can’t let that happen as well.

title: Alien Runner
description: Alien Runner is an endless runner game designed to test your mental focus. Running through the desert, avoiding cacti, sliding through the fences, dodging all the rockets coming from the helicopter and evading being capture by the soldiers.

title: Captain Rogers: Defense of Karmax-3
description: In the episode titled "Defense of Karmax-3", Captain Rogers needs to defend the base at Karmax-3 from the treacherous attack carried out by the Kershan Empire. Using only a very basic space cannon, Captain Rogers needs to shoot down incoming rockets and missles.

title: Saga of Cragen: Stones of Thum
description: On his search for more ale the barbarian Craigen stranded in the camp of the northern tribe. The king offers him a new quest, in which you have to match all of the 12 secret trials of the stones. Shoot marbles to complete all sacred stones of the same kind.

title: Crazy Pizza
description: Match 3 pizzas to ear money.

title: Captain Rogers: Asteroid Belt of Sirius
description: Captain Rogers, an intergalactic courier, is being chased by evil Kershans. To escape them, he has only one option. He must fly expertly through an asteroid field and hope that his flying skills are better than theirs. To win, help Captain Rogers get through the asteroids while being chased by aliens. Dodge asteroids and mines by moving up and down the screen as you fly forward. Collect stars and blue symbols to increase your score and power up your shield. Avoid destroying the ship and collect 20,000 points to win.

title: Skill 3D Parking Police Station
description: As a law officer, you get to drive and park police cars. This 3D game will let you try your skills out across 10 challenging levels. Enjoy the graphics and have fun.

title: Greedy Gnomes
description:
Try this greedy puzzle and play alone against the game or try the hot seat multiplayer and beat your friends.
Oh, by the way - whoever loses, needs to give his gems to the winner!

title: JomJom Jump
description: Try to pick up tasty apples to refill your energy resources and use time bonuses to get more time. Much fun!

title: Let's Go Fishing
description: Catch as many fishes as possible

title: Mini Golf Kingdom
description: Simple and fun to play.

title: Pumpkin Smasher
description: You don't need Halloween to play this fun Pumpkin Smasher mobile game. Your object is simple: tap on flying pumpkins to smash them up into pieces. Aim is to break as much of those large orange fruits but avoid to hit bombs. Much fun!

title: Sam Bogart Files Vol.2
description:
Here's what happened. Some very pretty Vixen asked me to help her.
But all she really wanted was to get to this badger guy she has a beef with.

title: Skater Dude
description:
You are a great skater and the police dont want to see your show in the street. 
Avoid their obstacles.

title: Christmas Madness
description: Santa is handing out Christmas gifts to the children as usual. Unfortunately this time the rain deer somehow feel so exhausted just half way of the entire journey. Santa has to rush back to North Pole to seek for more assistance. Guide Santa while he is running on the rooftop.

title: Freaking Math
description: Check the solution of the mathematical problem as quick as you can. The more you solve correctly the better will your high score be!

title: Flappy Fish
description:
In "Flappy Fish" you Play a little cute Fish who just Learn To Swim.
"Flappy Fish" is not like other "Flappy" type games. The difference is there are more obstacles beside just the pillar. When you tap the fish will dive not fly. Plus more attractive graphics than the other "Flappy" types games.
So what are you waiting, let’s help the Little Cute Fish learn how to swim.

title: Speed Maniac
description: Rudy is the No. 1 street racers in the city. His desire is to become the No. 1 in the world. Help Rudy to materialize his dream by challenging racing heroes from all over the world.

title: Turtle vs Reef
description: Kuya is a newly hatched baby sea turtles. Help him find his way home as soon as possible because a hungry shark chasing him.

title: Extreme Blocks
description: Rotate the blocks to align the colored lines with those on the already dropped blocks.

title: Woodcutter Chuck
description:
Fill yourself as a cool timberman! Let fill yourself as a Chuck.
Show us what can you do. Or you haven’t got an ax. Use your hands and legs! Chop the wood as quick as possible! Store up the biggest stack don’t let to enemy branches to flag the spirits!

title: Razor Run
description:
Razor Run is a super-fast 3D escape game where you need to blast your way through the small corridors. Evade the different obstacles that are in the way, and escape the station safely before it explode. Razor run is a real 3D space shooter which is full of action. You have different possibilities to upgrade your 3D spacecraft, make it faster, bigger and better in this intergalactic 3D space shooter. Adding some awesome weaponry to get even further in your escape runs.
If you enjoy the old school vertical space-shooters and if you are a fan of these old school games you are going to love Razor Run – 3D space shooter. So go ahead and upgrade your arsenal and space ship to make it as far as you can!

title: Flight of the Ninja
description: Climb, avoid deadly wheels , climb, avoid deadly spikes.

title: Compact Conflict
description: Reminiscent of Risk with a religious flavoring.

title: Let’s Fish
description: Let’s fish is a new high quality fishing game. Try to catch the biggest fish and compete with your friends in rankings and tournaments. Over 30 realistic locations, hundreds of fish species, professional fishing tackle. Join us, play the game and have fun playing it here at Y8.com!

title: Elsa Frozen Brain Surgery
description: Put your scrubs on and start your neurologist role with a thorough medical exam in order to gather as many details as possible about Elsa’s health condition. Check out her temperature and her heart as well and once you’re sure she needs a brain surgery, start shaving her gorgeous blonde hair and prepare her for the long surgery hours. Then feel free to dig into her brain and make sure you use the right doctor tools to cut out her little obsessions, to repair whatever you find broken and to reactivate the dead synapses snowflakes. Good luck, ladies!

title: Color Frenzy
description: Test your reflexes in Color Frenzy. Clear blocks that match the current color and race to beat your highscore.

title: Cupcake Kerfuffle
description: Manage a cupcake cafe! Serve customers as many cupcakes as they can eat within the time limit. Get orders right to earn more time!

title: Tri-Memory
description: Challenge yourself with this unique take on a classic puzzle design! Features include multiple difficulty settings and high scores.

title: Rainblox
description: Match 'em up in this colorful puzzle game! Clear sets of Rainblox by matching three or more touching blocks. Check out the different game modes for an added challenge.

title: Pizza Whiz
description: Pizza Whiz is a pizza themed cutting game where you goal is to cut the perfect slice of pizza. Yum! Try to make the cuts exactly as shown to score the highest points. Careful not to slide off the screen or it won't slice.

title: Golf Blast
description: A twist on the popular mini-golf game. Play through nearly 40 levels and test your skill in arcade mode.

title: Hit & Miss
description: Play the classic game Battleships against a challenging computer opponent. Hit & Miss is a simple game for all ages that relies on strategy and tactics.

title: Combo Burger Advanced
description: Combine Flying ingredients to make super burger bar burgers! Combo Burger Advanced is a fun game where you need to collect the awesome burger. Play now at Y8 and have fun.

title: Missile Madness
description: Defend your city from missiles and nukes! Collect stars along the way and use them to buy upgrades at the end of each round.

title: Space Miner
description: Take the roll of an extraterrestrial miner on an unknown planet. Dig your way through 20 unique levels – and don't miss the collectible loot!

title: Hi-Lo
description: A challenging mix of luck and skill. Try to beat your longest streak before running out of lives!

title: Munch Monsters
description: Choose an adorable Munch Monster to feed – but watch out for dirty boots! Eat as many sweets and candies as you can.

title: Space Controller
description: Play as an intergalactic traffic controller as you command spaceships toward their destination in Space Controller.

title: Sky Drop
description: Race around a beautiful setting collecting meteors in the form of eggs! Be careful to avoid the rotten ones as you make a dash for your highscore.

title: Zoo Match
description: Match exotic animals and train your memory at the same time! Each level has different animals for you to find. Clear all of the matching animal pairs to win.

title: Turret Turmoil
description: Blast approaching waves of enemies to bits! Turret Turmoil starts off slow but quickly picks up the pace. Upgrade your turret after each round to survive longer!

title: Phantomb
description: Vampires and ghosts haunt all 30 challenging levels. Phantomb draws inspiration from the classic Chip's Challenge. Take a nostalgic trip into the abyss!

title: Danger Light
description: See how good your memory really is in this space-themed puzzle game. Watch the flashing lights and repeat the sequence when it's finished.

title: Bubble Popper
description: Bubble Popper - fun game, try to win your opponent and pop bubbles so fast as you can. Use mouse to interact with the game or tap on your touchscreen if you play on mobile platforms. Small bubbles move faster, but have a lot of game points inside. Have fun!

title: Swooop
description: Become a fearless pilot in our side-scrolling infinite runner game SWOOOP! Jump in your biplane and discover a fantastic world. Collect gems, stars, wrenches and avoid the clouds to reach the highest score!

title: Rig BMX
description: In Rig BMX, Rigby has been turned into a bike and the world has gone crazy! Help Rigby ride his way out of this mess and get things back to normal. Roll your way to freedom and pop a few wheelies as you solve one puzzling level after another.

title: Foot Chinko
description: Foot Chinko is a mobile friendly football game that will keep you busy with more than 90 levels. You can win 9 major international cups, starting with Oceania cup (creators pleasantly inform us that football is played there, too). When the match starts, you'll find out that you are faced with cute pinball-like game in which the goal is to score required number of goals to win. Now, go on and fill that trophy case.

title: Radioactive Rumble Parking
description: Throw off all your unimportant work and take part in a cool 3d game. The main goal is to park your truck as better as you can. Make haste and you will be the best!

title: Elemental Fortress
description:
A click-frenzy action tower defence, using the elemental strengths and weaknesses of water, fire, and earth.
The Elementals are an ancient and monstrous organic life-form, bent on destroying all of humankind and everything in it’s path.
Defend your fortress from the Elementals by building Sentry Towers and using the elements against them.

title: Pokikex
description: You are Pokikex , hungriest caterpillar in the world! Your destiny is in your legs! Go invade grandpa Joseph' garden! Gobble everything on your way!

title: Sling Basket
description: Sling basket is a mix of basketball and physics puzzle trick shots. The mechanics make for a difficult game yet it is hard to give up on. Use a slingshot physics mechanic to launch basketballs, just remember to collect the stars and get the ball into the basket. This game is surprisingly challenging, so you will need to restart to find the perfect shot.

title: Sneakin' Santa
description: Help Uncle Grandpa save Christmas through the power of breakdancing. Press the arrow keys in the right order to dodge obstacles and deliver presents! Go as fast as you can but don't make too many mistakes or you'll wake the house!

title: Tiny Rifles
description: In Tiny Rifles you have to buy troops and send them to the frontlines of the battlefield. Take down alle enemies on the right. Buy snipers, machine gunners and airstrikes. Use your mouse/or tap with your finger to buy new soldiers and let move up a line.

title: Physics Sandbox
description: You can play in 8 various levels, each based on different physics model.

title: Mini Putt Gem Forest
description: Mini Putt Gem Forest is the second part of the cool miniature golf game. Again, your finger is your club on the digital green. Mission of the game is to complete all forest levels in as few strokes as possible. Don't forget to collect the gems!

title: Ice Hockey Penguins
description:
What? Penguins can play ice hockey? Of course they can! And they are all over the world! 
In this challenging game you have to go through six countries to be the champion!

title: Hunt the Yeti
description: Dig through the ice with your hi-tech drill then PUNCH enemies into the water, freezing them to death. Defeat all waves to face the Legendary Cyber-Yeti! Collect coins and gems to buy shiny upgrades or keep your money and set a new high score record.

title: Extreme Kitten
description: The adorable kitten wants to jump far: show your skills and help her by finding the right timing for her start and extend it by tapping the items on the playground. Extras and power-ups are available in the shop.

title: My Dolphin Show 5
description: Perform tricks as a dolphin at a water park to earn food. There are many tricks you can do, such as, Beach ball hit, donut jumping, hurdle jumping, splash the audience wet, jump through rings, score a soccer goal, coin collect, piñata smash, air stunts, water walk, bowling, basketball, love kiss, golf, volleyball, collect fish from the trainer, underwater ring, fetch the ball, hit the bell and many more fun tricks.

title: Handless-Millionaire
description:
If you really want to become a millionaire, you are going to have to take risks! We are not talking about small challenges, but big risks. Indeed, the tickets are in front of you. You will have to catch them by running your hand over the guillotine.
Take the bills and remove your arm before the blade drops and hits you. If this were to happen, you would have to restart the game because your hand will be cut off.
A game not recommended for the youngest because it is quite bloody, but for all the others, it's up to you to prove your determination!

title: Back to Santaland: Winter Holidays
description: Try out all of these puzzles as you travel down a path to an enchanted castle made out of candy canes.

title: Ancient Mahjong
description: In this relaxing Mahjong version your task is to combine two of the same Mahjong stones to remove them from the field. Only free stones can be combined. A stone is free when it's not covered by another stone and at least one side is open. Clear all tiles to complete a level.

title: Sieger: Rebuilt to Destroy
description: Sieger returns! Play 32 of the most notable sieges of the past 2500 years in this fairly simple physics puzzle-strategy game. Kill all castle defenders and save the hostages by carefully choosing what supporting blocks of the castle to smash.

title: 2 Cars
description: 2 Cars is a challenging car race where you need to manage the 2 cars and collect objects to avoid crashing on obstacles. This new car and racing game is a challenge for your reactions! Are you quick enough to react? You need to constantly switch lanes on two streets with two different cars. While you have to gather all the round objects you must avoid the squares. To manage this you need good coordination skills. The first mistake will end the game. What will your high score be? Take the circles, Avoid the squares. Don't miss any circles! Enjoy playing 2 Cars here at Y8.com!

title: Christmas Chain
description: In Christmas Zuma you have to make chains of three or more balls of the same color. Let them all disappear before the balls reach the end.

title: Back to Santaland: Christmas is Coming
description: Your task in this game is to get together a minimum of three identical elements. If you succeed, and you get points to your total score. Make everything so that everything was in perfect order. Logically slide all the objects and believe that you can do it.

title: Shurican
description: Kind of flappy ninja, but with fighting, demons and explosions.

title: Pixels for Christmas
description: It’s almost Christmas, so get all the golden pixels using the cursor keys! No, there’s no map, it would spoil the ending :) Merry platforming!

title: Frozen Christmas Tree
description: Christmas has come for the frozen family! Elisa is decorating the Christmas tree for this special time of the year.Try to help her decorate the Christmas tree and dress her up in a festive clothes.

title: Face It Color Edition
description: Make sure the correct color faces the incoming circles by spinning the cube!

title: Snail Bob 8: Island Story
description: As such, a small Christmas present today, we add already the eighth sequel of the popular adventure game Snail Bob. This time you find yourself in a dangerous island, from which you'll find a way out. In addition to the dangerous obstacles and be careful on the hungry natives who would like to slug certainly enjoyed.

title: Maori The Spirit's
description: A small platform with a young Maori who must conquer the spirits of the forest…

title: Jelly Slice
description: Slice the jelly in as few moves as you can make. Go on, try it. It's way harder than it looks.

title: Block Swat
description: Run and Gun your way through your friends in different maps and using multiple weapons. Playable in-browser with great blocky style.

title: Lighty Bulb
description: In each level, your goal is to figure out how to turn on the lightbulb, but it’s rarely as simple as flipping a switch. All you need to do to play is click to interact with things, but you’ll need to experiment in each level to figure out what you need to do, since it often isn’t obvious.

title: Indian Solitaire
description: Indian Solitaire is very much like the classic solitaire game Forty Thieves, except that there are fewer cards in the original tableau, and the method of tableau building is down in any suit but the same.

title: Back to Candyland 1
description: Victory has never been so sweet! Tap the candy to remove groups of same-colored stones in this cute Match3 game. Combos give you bonus points, lines of jellies create special stones. Make sure to complete all challenges and master 35 levels! Can you finish all with 3 stars?

title: Back to Candyland 2
description: Time to visit the sugar hills of Candyland and its addictive levels again! Just as in episode 1 of the Match3 hit, object of the game is to score as many points as possible. Combine same-colored jellies, create special stones and explode the sweets in a firework of calorie-free confetti. Can you obtain 3 stars in every level?

title: Back to Candyland 4: Lollipop Garden
description: All good things come in four! In this new journey you will visit the lollipop garden. Return to Candyland and master 40 brand new level. Object of the fourth episode is to score as many points as possible. Combine same-colored jellies, create special stones and explode the sweets in a firework of calorie-free confetti. Can you obtain 3 stars in every level?

title: Spider-Man Web-Slinger
description: Play as Spider-Man and swing through the streets of New York City! Use your spider-skills to web swing, slide and jump to avoid danger and collect coins to try to get the highest score you can!

title: Noughts and Crosses
description: A simple game of 'tic tac toe' on a chalkboard theme. You can play alone or with a friend in two player modes. This is a classic game that is easily playable with paper. Now you can play using a computer.

title: Dig 2 China
description: Dig2China takes place in an American neighborhood, particularly in the kid's backyard. In the game's intro scene, he is seen building the digger, and catches the attention of his neighbor, the bully. After explaining that he is digging to China, the bully doubts that he can do so, and continues to throughout the game. As the player purchases upgrades using money gained from treasure, the digger's performance is improved, allowing for it to dig deeper and more efficiently. Dig2China features 13 different layers that the kid must dig through, each featuring different enemies, fuel, obstacles, and treasure.

title: Gravity Command
description: Aliens are invading and Earths outpost is in the way. Can you protect it over the course of 100 waves? Touch the screen to deploy your defenses, anything that comes in contact will be destroyed. Protect your missile silos as you will need every shot, and it goes without saying DON’T let the workers die! If you loose them all then it is game over.

title: Mr Mine
description:
𝗠𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗰𝗲𝘀
Mine deeper underground to obtain more resources and minerals to sell. You'll also encounter treasure chests the further you dig. These chests contain random rewards from small to huge sums of money and resources.
𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲𝘁𝗲 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝘀
While mining, you'll eventually reach the underground city. At this point, you'll be introduced to new resources and a pyramid where you'll find quests to complete.
𝗨𝗽𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗲 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗴𝗲𝗮𝗿
You start the game with a humble shovel for digging. When you earn enough currency, you can upgrade your digging methods, from shovel to jackhammer; drill to nuclear excavator when you earn enough currency. Beyond that point, upgrades get supernatural, with workers being replaced with aliens and demons!

title: Twelve
description: It is a basic game for kids to learn math. Hyper-casual puzzle game. Tap on the same numbers to grow them. Can you reach twelve?

title: Castle Attack HTML5
description: Don’t die buddy! Evade everything that is going to hit you.

title: Space Inferno
description: Remake of the classic space invaders with a bit of extra craziness.

title: Jump King
description: Test your luck and skill by dodgin arrows, birds, and fast cars! Gain metals and crowns. Try to get the gold metal! Play along with a friend to see who is the true Jump King! Tap anywhere during play to make your character jump.

title: Paris Dress Up
description: Dress up in Paris! Drag the clothing and accessories to wear them! Try out many different styles of fashion!

title: Princess Summer Makeover
description: Help the princess clean up her face and get dressed! Wash her face with soap and apply much needed treatment to get ride of her blemishes! After washing up choose between a variety of accessories from hair styles, earrings, clothing, lips, and more!

title: Secret Makeout
description: Kissing is fun, but not when people are paying attention! Tap and hold the couple to kiss! The other girls don't want to see that kind of behavior in public, so don't get cought! 3 lives to kiss it up secretly in Secret Make Out!

title: Money Movers 2
description: The sequel to Money Movers. This time the duo is trying to break in to save their father!

title: Speed Pool King
description: Show the others how quick you are and defend your title as the Speed Pool King. To win this physics-based billiard game you must pot as many pool balls as possible before the timer counts down.

title: Cybercells
description: Move the white cell to the finish and solve ninety brain busting levels.

title: Stephen Karsch
description: Secret agent Stephen Karsch is on shadow mission to catch criminals. He must collect all the evidence to catch the villains.

title: Blue Box
description: Small puzzle game about little blue box.

title: Go Ninja
description: Go Ninja is a game will challenge your skills in making decisions. Jump on platforms, fight ninjas and bats, flies through the skies and make the best score of the overall score!

title: Flappy Christmas
description: Flap and fly through the starry Christmas sky! Quark sets out to help Santa Claus in this fun Christmas game.

title: A Nonogram a Day
description: Paint by Numbers: every day a new nonogram puzzle. Discover the hidden image in this Griddlers game. Color the grid and reveal an image every day. At the top of each column and at the left of each row there are one or more numbers. These numbers tell you the runs of colored squares in that row/column. So if you see '4 1', it means there will be a run of exactly 4 squares in the indicated color followed by a single colored square. If the 4 and 1 have the same color then at least 1 white square is between them.

title: Pet Pop Party
description: Play this cute match 3 game for free! Match the kitty, bunny and bear to score points and win coins. Save the pets and they'll help you progress through the different levels with great power-ups. Come and play in this magical animal puzzle world!

title: Gentleman's Blackjack
description: Beat the bank.

title: Parking Rage Touch Version
description:
A fun an unique 2d parking game.
Upgrade your car.
Unlock more cars.
Many levels.

title: X-Kill
description: Kill some aliens while listening to heavy guitar riffs.

title: Day D: Tower Rush
description: Tower Rush is a non traditional tower defense game. The graphics are 3D rendered giving the game a unique and refreshing style. Towers can only be built in certain locations, so choose a good spot near the entrance where baddies come from. Towers can be upgraded. Just remember to protect the base.

title: Spider-Man Wall Crawler
description: Vulture, Electro and Doc Ock have taken over a rooftop! Only one man can help, Spider-Man! However, he is out of webbing and must crawl his way to the top avoiding dangerous attacks from above! Help him climb to the top, take down his enemies and save the day.

title: CMYK Slime Quest

title: Bob The Robber
description:
Bob The Robber is a fun stealth puzzle game where you guide Bob, a clever thief with a good heart, through buildings filled with guards, cameras, and locked doors. Bob is not out to cause trouble. Instead, he specializes in slipping past security, solving simple puzzles, and completing missions that require patience and smart thinking.
Each level is designed like a mini maze with multiple floors. Your goal is to help Bob move quietly, avoid being spotted, and reach the main objective. You will search for keycodes, disable alarms, open safes, and use tools to get through locked areas. Every step must be timed carefully, because one wrong move can alert a guard or activate a security device, forcing you to try again.
Bob can hide in the shadows, sneak behind obstacles, and wait for the right moment to move forward. Some levels require turning off power switches, while others involve distracting guards or finding secret paths. The game rewards players who take their time and observe the patterns of each guard and camera before making a move.
The puzzles are light, enjoyable, and designed to be accessible for all players. As the levels progress, the layouts become more detailed and the challenges more interesting. You will encounter different types of guards, more advanced security systems, and clever traps that require a mix of timing and logic to bypass.
Bob The Robber stands out because of its charming cartoon style and simple controls. Every level feels like a small adventure where you plan your route, react quickly when needed, and celebrate every successful escape. The game encourages replay as you return to earlier stages to find faster solutions or hidden details you may have missed.
If you enjoy stealth, puzzle solving, and exploring carefully designed levels, Bob The Robber offers a fun and engaging experience that keeps you thinking from start to finish.

title: Parking Fury
description:
Parking Fury is a fun and skill-based driving game where your goal is to park each car safely in the highlighted spot without hitting walls, cones, or other vehicles. The challenge increases with every level, turning each stage into a test of timing, control, and smooth driving.
You begin with simple parking spots in quiet areas. As you progress, the environments become tighter and busier. Sharp turns, narrow spaces, and moving traffic force you to think ahead and carefully plan your route. Completing a level without a scratch feels rewarding, especially when the layout gets tricky.
The controls are easy to understand and allow for precise movement. You steer the car carefully into place, watching your surroundings and adjusting your speed to avoid obstacles. Each parking spot requires patience and focus, and even small improvements feel satisfying as you learn how to handle different situations.
Parking Fury also includes a variety of vehicles, each with its own handling style. Some cars turn quickly, while others take wider paths, and learning how each one behaves keeps the gameplay fresh. Every new level helps you improve your judgment, maneuvering skills, and parking accuracy.
The smooth animations, clear visuals, and clever level design make Parking Fury enjoyable to play. Whether you want a short challenge or a longer session to sharpen your skills, the game offers plenty of opportunities to practice and master the art of perfect parking.
Parking Fury delivers a simple but engaging experience where precision matters. It is a great choice for anyone who enjoys thoughtful driving challenges and steady progress through increasingly creative levels.
