You will be an exciting journey and a new approach to building bridges that will absorb you for a long time.

title: Lucky Runner
description: Lucky runner able to run an infinite distance. Avoid a collision with boxes and barrels. Thermonuclear waste, high voltage, explosive mixtures and bombs are waiting for you on the way. Other routes are waiting for you. Go through them all. One tap on the screen will allow you to jump over an obstacle. Along the way you can collect power-ups such as double, triple jump, coins and more. Several locations, a variety of obstacles will cause you to pass the game again and again. Put your record. Bring a better result. Play with your friends on who will run away.

title: Frozen Bridges
description:
This is an interesting puzzle game for those who love design and construction . The essence of the game is very simple and clear even to a child – you have to build a bridge , driving a vehicle in which you have chosen will get to the next level .
Need to build a successful bridge , using a variety of designs : the roadbed , ropes and props. If you do it right , your machine will rush on through the drifts and icy prigrady .
Construction of the bridge – it is responsible , and without knowledge of the physical laws can not do here . Complexity increases from level to level , passing each of which offers the player access to new transport.

title: Micromorphers
description:
A stylish top down shoot’em up inspired by Geometry Wars and WE Are Doomed. Kill enemies, gain experience and become more pointy.
The catch? Lacking the ability to aim at the enemy you must maneuver yourself so that your bullets make contact with your target.
Your bullets aren’t your only weapons in this microbe eat microbe world though, when under pressure you can hold space bar to unleash a spinning laser.

title: Jedi Trainer
description: Use your sword to deflect enemy lasers into floating orb droids. Avoid from having the lasers hit your handle and see how long you can last! Use practice mode to configure what types of enemies you want to fight against and how quickly they respawn.

title: Kings and Knights
description: Mahjong Solitaire game in a Medieval setting. Travel to your castle. Remove all tiles in a level in pairs.

title: Charm Farm
description: The Magic Forest and the Shmoos need your magic spells!

title: Extreme Mini Massacre
description: Kill all the enemies while avoiding their bullets.

title: Kaasua
description: Fast and fun little racing game for 1-8 local players!

title: GlitchBox
description:
Random fun! Random frustration!
GlitchBox is a First-Person Platforming game whose main goal is to run and jump in order to get on the checkered box, and so complete the level.
Sounds simple? Not a challenge? Well, the game ain’t gonna go easy on you, pal. If you stay quiet too much, you fall. If you move too quickly, you fall. If you move and jump at random… maybe you win? Who kno- Oops! The game just got harder!
How many times will you achieve your goal until your untimely decline to the void of the glitches?

title: Growing Trees!
description: Make our planet green and leafy. Plant trees in any part of the world. Plant as many as possible and have fun.

title: Blossom School Style
description: Dress up this beautiful young lady in this amazingly awesome dressing game made for girls, Blossom School Style!

title: Powerblocks
description: Poweblocks is an HTML5 puzzle game in which you have to fit all the blocks in a square frame. It's a tricky game so you better think and solve the puzzle so you can go to the next stage. There are 60 stages and every puzzle is unique. So put your thinking hats on and play Powerblocks now!

title: Kopanito All-Stars Soccer Lite
description: It may not look serious, but we guarantee, that it is. Kopanito’s match engine is well-balanced. Use slide tackle to intercept passes or knock-down opponents (or even score a goal!). Pass the ball straight to your teammates (ground or air) or pass the ball between opponents. Score goals using chip shots or by swerving the ball using slow-motion shots. There are various set pieces, like corner kicks or throw-ins too, but no rules apart from that! Don’t forget, it is a fast-paced game – it might be funny and cartoonish, but it’s not that easy. Try it yourself!

title: Soccer Sumos
description:
Tabletop multiplayer soccer for 1-4 players!
Are you ready to score and tackle? Everybody can play with one-button controls and 1 vs 1 and 2 vs 2 matches. Frantic multiplayer gameplay and Guaranteed laughs with friends.

title: Goldcraft
description: Begin your idle gold mining adventure! Hire loyal workers and purchase equipment for upgrades to help you on your journey. Find rare and powerful artifacts along the way. Can you reach the top of the leaderboard? Play now!

title: Magic Jewelry
description: Match three blocks to make them vanish. Every 70th matched block you get a magic block that lets you erase a color.

title: Glorious Space Balloons
description: Simple local 2-player game, in which you try to knock the opposing player out of a planet’s atmosphere.

title: LoucoLandia
description: This is a Endless Runner Game, where you run until die.

title: Cosmocidio
description: Destroy ALL ASTEROIDS!!!!

title: Sawblade Panic
description: Simple plattformer with tight controlls. Contains 8 levels in total. All with different and fun designs. Also offers a competetive side with global leaderboards to compare your skill with other people around the world.

title: Butterfly Madness
description: Control a Butterfly, gt to the end of the level without hitting anything, and get all the Targets-Flowers if you can!

title: Snowfall HTML5
description: Battle wave after wave of enemies in an endless attempt at survival. Go beat em up as long as you can use your bow or sword to defeat your enemies.

title: Autoliiga
description: Play soccer with cars, 2 players. Made as a school project.

title: Spiders Arena
description:
You are alone in the arena, surrounded spiders monsters. 
Use all the guns and destroy them to have big score.

title: Radioactive Decay
description: Based upon a space shoot em up. This is a game where you play as a radiation particle and have to enter a human blood stream, avoiding any red and white blood cells, and ultimately trying to reach the boss(the lung).

title: Zombocalypse
description: Fight for survival against an ever growing horde of cold unforgiving undead in this 3D, top down, zombie, wave defense, game.

title: Children Laundry
description: Help this little girl do her laundry. Sort the whites from the colored clothes. Operate the washing machine and help her hang her clothes to dry. Y8 will teach you to wash your clothes, just never forgot. You can sort the clothes for better results.

title: Tap Skiner
description: Help the boy to face this super radical adventure aboard his snowboard.

title: Another Dimension
description: Destroy the enemy's mothership!

title: Lily Slacking Dating Mobile
description: Your out in a date with your boyfriend at the park. You don't want to make it a plain and boring date so you decided to make things more exciting by doing mischievous things. Just remember don't get caught!

title: Lily Slacking School Mobile
description: Taylor is quite bored with her History Class. So she decided to slack without everyone's noticing her. Help her have fun and avoid getting caught by Mr. Bobby!

title: Lily Slacking Restaurant
description: Taylor is now working in a restaurant. She's working so hard but she doesn't want to get bored so she wants to make it entertaining! Making it a little more exciting by doing things secretly so no one knows what she's doing. Help her have fun by not getting caught!

title: Snowball Champions
description: Shoot all the enemies before the time ends! Collect coins to help you purchase upgrades.

title: Flirting Makeover
description: Eileen needs to look good so that Jave can fall in love with her. Give her a make over so she'll get Jave's attention. Do her make up and dress her up in a stylish outfit!

title: Flirting Makeover Mobile
description: Eileen needs to look good so that Jave can fall in love with her. Give her a make over so she'll get Jave's attention. Do her make up and dress her up in a stylish outfit!

title: Daily Ally
description: Welcome to Allyson's daily life! Help her clean her room, do shopping and even baby sitting.

title: Rogue Solitaire
description: Marble Solitaire meets roguelike. Classic puzzle gameplay with procedural level generation.

title: Bunny Shot
description: Help the Bunny to defend the land against invasion space invader

title: Light Space Dimension
description: This is a shooting game where you must destroy all your enemies.

title: Jolly Jong Dogs
description: A new game in the Jolly Jong series: Jolly Jong Dogs. Combine 2 of the same dogs to remove the dogs from the game. Remove all dogs to advance to the next level.

title: Box Sucker
description: Use your magnet to attract boxes in your direction. Lead the boxes in to the basket, when basket is full you complete the level.

title: Jelly Madness
description: Those wobbly jellies don't always have it all together and sometimes they go completely jelly-jolly. Match and line up the same jellies to remove them from the screen in this mad match-3 game!

title: U.F.O. Swarm
description: Control a space ship and fight against a swarm of UFOs!

title: Void Shooters
description: This extremely simple, yet challenging game is surprisingly fun to play, face off against a endless horde of randomly spawning enemies, and try to become the very best, like no one ever was

title: Great Attractor
description: Great Attractor is a action space shooting game. you need to attract firepower from enemies to keep your mothership safe. Play up to 4 mission and enjoy.

title: Pitboy Adventure
description: Guide Pitboy through 45 levels in three different zones filled with traps and dangers. Each just waiting to end your journey. Use skill and timing to beat levels. Master the double jump and become a Pit Master. Grind your teeth to dust and overcome seemingly impossible levels.

title: Poly and the Marble Maze
description:
Guide the lost ball Poly through a mysterious and beautiful marble maze.
Poly and the Marble Maze is a modern Platformer with intuitive controls, huge collection of challenging levels and stunningly beautiful visuals. In this unique ball rolling game your goal is to collect all three crystals and reach the flag on each levels. To succeed, you need to solve tricky puzzles and overcome many obstacles.

title: Better Together
description:
Sometimes you get closer to the right person, and sometimes you don’t. This game is about how hard it is to be with the right person, even when there are so many others that feel right but are not a match.
Match the yellow player to the pink one. There is a reload level button at the top right, in case it is needed.

title: Magnet Boy
description: Escape each room using your magnetic powers.

title: Ice Cold Love
description: Have a cuteness overload. Help the couple of penguins to meet each other again! But be careful with the over friendly seals. They are huggable, but they hurt!

title: ZOON
description: Survive until the star implodes into a black hole. evade micro black holes.

title: Handsome Jim Muscle
description:
You are looking for “it”, can you find it?
Evade a factory full of thugs and find “it”.
Use your attractiveness to seduce boxes, and make them smash the thugs!

title: Lightness of Love
description:
You’re stuck on a small piece of land with a cast of diverse characters with very different views on life.
Lightness of Love has no winning or losing conditions but focus instead on telling a simple story. Play around to see how you can change the outcome!
Point and click to move around and interact with other characters.

title: Blood Run 2
description: During a simple medical treatment you got infected. The infection turned you into a blood hungry zombie. While you start to feast on the living your powers grow stronger, turning you into a mega zombie who can't be stopped or killed! If you only bite the living, they will likely become one of your kind. But be careful, the authorities are on the way, so kill them before they overrun you! Kill as many living as you can. Spawn as many zombies as you can. Don't get killed by the cops!

title: Mass
description: Collide your way through the cosmos in this addictive action packed game! Smash into smaller asteroids to absorb their mass. Watch out, space can be dangerous! Many objects will try and stop you from becoming the most massive object in the Universe.

title: Mango Mania
description: This jumpy monster is out for a mango hunt and will do anything to get it. Collect all the mangoes and find a way to get out to go to the next stage!

title: Valiant Knight: Save The Princess Mobile
description: Your beloved princess was kidnapped by the goblins. The king commanded you to save the princess and collect all the golden coins on your way to the dungeon!

title: Winter Adventures
description: Collect all the stars for decorations. Watch out for falling snow balls!

title: Whack a Ninja
description: Whack ninjas as many as you can, once a ninja is flying you will lose.

title: GraZ Wars
description: Survive waves of evergrowing hordes of zombies. The only friend in this game is the shop, that helps you upgrade and succeed.

title: Jim Addict
description:
Save a kingdom with your coffee fuel powers! Also try and make the nicest coffee ever!
Buy upgrades to get further along, during play when meter is power is above 100 press Space bar to launch Special Power

title: The Journey Home
description: A short story about the travels of an adventurer and a young girl she meets along the way.

title: Don't Get Cocky!
description: Asteroids clone with a SOLO twist.

title: Divine Cimb
description: An unfortunate stickman finds himself in a lava filled cave. Can you rescue him with your divine powers?

title: Super Soccer Noggins
description: Choose your team of Super Soccer Noggins and bring them to victory. This game features a bunch of wacky tournaments and tons of upgrades and power-ups.

title: Mine Swine
description:
Command World War II pigs to hide bombs on the battlefield with the goal to blow the enemy army to bacon bits.
Try to avoid the enemy’s laid bombs minefield as you plot your own plan of attack.
Can you predict and outwit your enemy and win the war for your nation?

title: Golden Blocks
description: Explore 9 beautiful level and collect all golden blocks

title: Deep Sea Jewels
description: Remove Jewels at the bottom of the Ocean. Click on connected groups to remove the jewels. Reach the goal to advance to the next level.

title: The Immortal Life of the Son of Jay
description:
A long time ago the Son of Jay messed with a bad alchemist, who wants now to take revenge. Era after era, he sends his alchemy-enforced troops to make the Son of Jay pay…
An action game where you have to use your weapon to deflect projectiles against your enemies.

title: Ribbit Racer
description: Play this HTML5 game, Ribbit Racer. Control this tiny car and let it cross the water. In order to avoid falling into water, click your mouse when the car is approaching the edge of the bridge. This is a very challenging game that crossing the bridge multiple times is a very hard task. Play now and see how many bridges you can drive across and how many cars you will unlock.

title: Ninja Spark
description: A platform puzzle game about an alien ninja with the power to teleport.

title: Bubble Rain
description: In this game you need to destroy tons of bubbles to get the best score possible. You must destroy the bubbles to get score also you can destroy special bubbles to get special powers. Don't touch the bomb bubble or you’ll lost one life.

title: Unleash 2 - BURN
description: A top-down 2D racing game. Race an win unlock  new circuit to race with.

title: Dungeon Fighter
description:
Kung Fu Groove is On in this endless 8 bit fighting game.
The Bad Dudes and Robot Ninja Warriors Have invaded the Dungeons of the Inner Earth to find the precious and magical treasures. It is up to you to stop them with your Kung Fu Power.
Enjoy this old arcade style urban fighting game with retro look of the 80s and 90s.
Just Go Up In This Dungeon Mayhem and Beat The Foes in this ground breaking Martial Arts brawler game.

title: Pico Racer
description: Overtake opponents and avoid obstacles! Drive through the night! Race your way through three continents! Enjoy geography that makes no sense!

title: Mad Combat Marines
description: Mad Combat Marines is a multiplayer shooting game that gives the player a set of weapons to choose from. Choose among the weapons that suits you best in order to make the first shoot against other players.

title: Frunithorhyncho
description: Toto is a magician platypus, help him destroying the runes using their powers from the fruits

title: Runy Lite
description:
Runy is a classic platform game where you must collect the spheres arround each of the 10 labrynts and avoid that te "baddies" makes explode you.
In Runy you have 2 modes to Play.
Windows Mode: Collect the diamonds before baddies hunt´s you.
Training Mode: In Android Version you can explore the labrynts and collect the pinkies without boxerks triying to hunt you.

title: Sanity Check: Chapter 1
description:
Sanity Check is a game about the creative process, game design, and what it means to be an artist in the modern age. But...more specifically, it's a game about power-mad demon ladies, showboating skeletons and elder gods who just can't stick to the script. A hapless creator's first RPG Maker game spirals out of control as the stock assets take over and begin running the show.
Beat the combat scripting out of enemies to learn their moves! Experiment with unique equipment that radically alters your play style! Encounter hilarious monsters, each fight with its own unique dialogue! And maybe even find some secrets!
It's time for a Sanity Check!

title: Groovy Ski
description: Skiing down a mountain might not be very difficult, but it will be when there are a lot of fences down the hill. This means you only have a small space to ski and you need to take your turn at the right time. Otherwise you will crash. Are you able to get down the hill safely?

title: Jaru
description: Jaru is a simple yet challenging platformer. It currently features 50 levels.

title: Clown Nights
description: The good news: you just got a job at the circus. The bad news: you’ll be working the night shift and dealing with psychotic clowns. How long will you survive in this crazy online game?

title: Mixed Macho Arts
description:
Beat your friend in PvP MMA battle or test your skills against the powerful CPU player! Wrestle, kick & punch your opponent off the platform and into the lava below!
Test your luck in Absolute Randomness mode! 
Get gorilla arms to power punch your puny opponent or fill your head with helium and gently float above them!
Punch and grab your opponent with your fists, kick them with your feet and hope that they’ll reach the

title: Flight Simulator - Night Tour
description: Learn ho fly an aircraft. Learn how to land and take off. Maneuver in the sky high.

title: Big Cheese
description: Help chaz the mouse to get as much cheese as he can and get to the mouse hole. Use analog control on the right to pick up cheese and bonus items. Watch out for traps and hazards.

title: Ninja Master Trials
description: Do you think you have what it takes to become a Ninja Master? Then prove yourself in this hardcore platforming game, Ninja Master Trials! You’ll go through some of the toughest platforming stages you’ve ever faced! Earn new abilities as you progress, as well as new challenges and obstacles! So, do you think you’re ready?

title: Pilgrim's Fortune
description: A Rogue-Like RPG. A pilgrim that that travel around and deals with the hazards of the world.

title: Oh, Rats!
description: Defend the almighty cheese totem from the horrid rat invasion !

title: Color Match
description: Color Match is a new type of puzzle-like game that will test your reflexes and how fast you think in a short given time. The mechanics is simple, all you need to do is choose what the word say not the color of the word in order to survived.

title: Ropemania
description:
Prepare to play jump rope with your pixelated friends and try to score as much as you can in this simple yet highly addicting game – Ropemania! Click at the right moment to jump! The longer you play the faster the ropes move!
Ropemania is an arcade reaction game based on the kids game jump rope/ jumping ropes. Just like the real game, in this game, your goal is to jump at the right time before the rope hits your leg. Score is determined on how times you jumped over the rope. After each jump, the rope will go a bit faster than the last, making the game more difficult after quite some time. As a guide, you must jump the moment you see an “!” on top of your character.

title: Revativity SHMUP
description:
A platformer shoot’em up.
No plot! No development!
Just pure mayhem!

title: MisRepresented
description:
Great quotes said by women about woman!
Solve puzzles, smash patriarchy!
Fun, simple, scored game!
Turn the words to solve puzzle and discover initial meaning of the quote

title: Alchemy Idle Clicker
description:
Harvest ingredients and brew elixirs. Sell them to research stronger and more expensive items. Level up to double your income rate.
Are you the master alchemist, who discovers the philosopher’s stone?
Click the items on the right side to sell them. Click the production units on the left side to buy a new one. Click a production unit in the middle section to speed up production.
Please be aware that this game is not persistent. Only your income multiplier (level) is saved.

title: Altruism
description:
Altruism is a metroidvania-esque platformer. Play as 2 companions, Squirt and Lola, as they help each other explore the world and find out what happened to their species. Use shapeshifting powers found within mysterious artifacts to take different forms that will help reach new locations.
Find all the artifacts and help Squirt and Lola find out what happened to the Bloops, and more importantly, what is beyond the locked door.

title: The Wolf's Tale
description: The Wolf’s Tale is a Native American inspired platformer game in which you have to collect all the souls in the level before the timer expires.

title: Tucan Bird
description: It is a game where you control a Toucan dodging all trunks that appear randomly in addition appear hourglasses that give greater difficulty to the game since the moment of eating one time spends in slow motion

title: Space and Asteroids
description: Delve into the depths of the galaxy and get ready to dodge asteroids and safely to your destination

title: MazeGame
description: You have to try find the exit from maze!

title: Cabbage Run
description: Bunny likes to eat carrots, but watch out for the cabbages! The cabbages are fighting back, and will squish Bunny if they can. Get the carrots to gain super powers, destroy obstacles, and avoid the tall grass which slows down Bunny.

title: Asteroids CL
description: The object of the game is to shoot and destroy asteroids avoid hitting the fragments of these .

title: Square Switch
description: Switch the switch while switching the square in the wire as much as you can. Square can only be switched as long it touches the wire. Each time the square switched a switch, it will become faster. There are 4 levels of positive/negative signs, starting from level 1 to level 4. Higher level means more signs. The more the positive/negative signs, the faster the square going up/down.

title: Kinoko
description: Kinoko (Japanese for “mushroom”) is a unique mix of clever puzzles, thinking-outside-the-box, and just plain ole’ fun. However, only the cleverest can survive, so step up and prove yourself worthy!!

title: Tonguey Frog
description: The frog is not just hungry, it's starving! You would never know, what your body is capable of when you want to eat. Use your tongue as a rope to climb higher and get those insects!

title: Classic Mahjong
description: A classic Mahjongg Solitaire game in 2 different game modes. Play for a highscore or play all 100 level individually. Combine free highligted tiles in pairs to remove tiles.

title: Cats Reversi
description: Cats Reversi is remake of well known classic game Reversi. You can play vs computer or vs your friend!

title: Clear Skill
description: A graphic basic plat-former that will put a variety of your skills to the test.

title: Cartoon Strike
description: Play with your friends or with strangers this first-person multiplayer game (FPS). There is no story available at this moment, just the multiplayer. Join to running game or create your own server and invite your friends.

title: Virtual Shooter Arena
description:
Step into the adrenaline-fueled world of the Virtual Shooter Arena, where your skills are put to the ultimate test. Can you dominate the arena?
Cutting-edge VR tech for unbeatable immersion
Adaptive AI for dynamic, challenging gameplay
Realistic ballistics and recoil add authenticity
Diverse multiplayer modes to squad up with friends
Experience combat like never before in the Virtual Shooter Arena. With precision aim and quick reflexes, battle relentless enemies in gripping VR shootouts across visually stunning arenas. This is VR gaming taken to the next level.

title: Lab Security
description:
The Lab has been hacked! You have been tasked with clearing out the corrupted security systems with an old manual tank.
This is a top-down shooter with obstacles.
Reach the exit for all 30 levels. You get 1 star for beating the level, 1 star for killing all enemies, and 1 star for taking no damage.

title: Catroom Drama - CASE 1
description:
Case 1 – The Eager Eater
Catroom Drama! The one place where cats can drag other cats to small claims court – and you’re the judge! Listen to testimony, gather evidence, and DISPENSE YOUR JUSTICE.

title: Bonehead
description: A short Vertical Runner game

title: Frosty Donuts
description: Step inside this wonderful bakery and see if you can arrange all of these frosted donuts in the correct order. Can you get them squared away before time runs out in this puzzle game?

title: Space Invaders Mini
description: A mini version of the classic space invaders game

title: Juggle Sim
description:
Test your juggling MIGHT in the Juggle Sim arena! Will you conquer your body and pull off neat tricks?
Juggle up to 6 balls and throw in many tricks to mix up your game. Juggle your way to glory!
Beat your friend’s high scores in multiple modes and show that you’ve got the skills to pay them bills!

title: Forgotten Hill: Puppeteer
description:
Will you escape the Puppeteer?
You ran off the horrors of the dreadful house of Forgotten Hill and are finally back to your car, just to find out that your girlfriend is not there anymore! Following the few clues she left, you find yourself inside a terrible and grotesque Puppet Theatre. Can you Survive?

title: Cut My Rope
description: Om Nom is hungry for candy, and it's your job to help him out! Collect gold stars, discover hidden prizes and unlock exciting new levels in this addictively fun, award-winning, physics-based game!

title: Block Monsters 1010
description: A fun game of 1010. Move the shapes on the left onto the playing area and try to complete a row or column to score points. Reach the goal to advance to the next level.

title: Dream Baby Care
description: In this game, you will baby sit this cute baby. Take good care of her by taking her to bath, feeding her, and choosing an outfit for her.

title: Party Leg Spa
description: Get that relaxing Leg Spa. Remove those unwanted hair, calluses and exfoliate those dry skins. Have that pampering massage and end it up with a cool tattoo and fabulous outfit!

title: Final Defender
description: Test your defence abilities against the invading forces. Will your tower last for the ages or perish in the sand? Fight them on the land and in the air to protect the communication tower! Survive longer than your friends and show you are a worthy Final Defender.

title: Fruit Rush
description: Catch the rush! Arrange all of these yummy pieces of fruit in the correct order while you keep an eye on the clock. Can you match them all up before time runs out in this puzzle game?

title: Pillow Fight Fun
description: It is so easy to be real and express your true feelings with friends: happiness, pain, excitement, worries. But one of the best part about friendship is to have fun and enjoy small silly stuff like pillow fights.

title: Pix Hop
description:
Pix Hop, a simple endless platform game. You control a bouncy white square collecting coins and avoiding lovely colored enemies.
Use Left and Right Arrows to Move [ Keyboard, Gamepad ]

title: Space Bunny Zita
description:
A high speed score attack wave-survival game inspired by arcade and DOS classics. A strict time limit mixed with a pulse pounding soundtrack and hoardes of enemies keep you on edge.
The Galactic Special Weapons and Tactics have sent Lt. Zita Volare down to an abandoned planet that has been taken over by an empire of evil aliens. Zita is sent down to both clear the planet of baddies, and destroy their sources of power, bright energy crystals littered throughout the areas. It’s a seemingly endless battle, how long can Zita last?

title: Weapon Quest 3D
description: In Weapon Quest 3D, the player can choose a warrior and its class either archer or swordswoman. Then, there's an NPC where you can get quest, buy items, etc.As soon as the player is done with the quest, there will be rewards that he/she will receive such as exp, gold, and potions.This game also has a dungeon, but be careful because the mobs that are living in there are more advanced and have more skills than the mobs that are living in the greenfield. The player can also craft items like sword or bow, and armor.

title: Mixed World: Magic Night
description: Welcome to Mixed World, the cheerful platform puzzle game! This is the magic night series. Use your funny friends’ special skills to nudge all monsters off the platforms!

title: Backwards Dragon
description: An endless runner. Space or mouse click to move up or respawn.

title: The Lucid Void
description: Go to strange places and pick up some clues that will lead you to the demon's whereabouts. But the question is, can you catch the demon?

title: S_135
description: Swap squares, depending on the color that would not miss the enemy. Red destroying the enemy red, green, green enemy.Management “Z” or the left mouse button.

title: Tough Life Gangland
description: Only the sharpest shooters will survive out there in Gang Land! Speed and accuracy are the name of the game as you take down your rivals on the streets. Ready? FIRE!

title: The Forsaken Lab 3D 2
description: From the thrilling first person shooting game"The Forsaken Lab 3D" comes its second installment . Find your way out from the hellish Lab, infested with mutated zombies. Use all the things that you can find in order to survive!

title: Baby Painting Room
description: Baby Painting Room is a cute decorating game that lets the player be creative enough to decorate this baby's room. The player will surely have fun playing this game. Not only that, the player can also get an idea for his/her future room.

title: Baby Hair Doctor
description: Oh my gosh! Baby's head has lice, wounds, etc. As a hair doctor, you need to attend to her needs and cure her head problems. After the treatment, give her a total makeover to bring back her confidence.

title: Monster Temple
description: This temple is full of monsters. But that's not a bad thing. We can still manage them. But first we have to sort them.

title: Battlecoast
description: Defend your castle from the enemy ships that dare to challenge your rule! In Battle Coast, use your ultimate weapon against them, but make sure to upgrade it!

title: Rogue Within
description: In time where it's either you obey or be killed. There's only one option if you want to get out of the barbaric group that you have been forced to join. That's going rogue! Escape and survive this treacherous game!

title: Harajuku Fashion Girl
description: This Japanese fashion is now going global. Give her a make over and dress her up into this cool Harajuku style!

title: Princess Hairdo
description: The princess needs a new hairdo. Your job as her loyal servant is to wash and clean her hair. Remember to use conditioner, so it is soft and flows well. Remember to rinse and cut the princesses hair, she will want the best haircut.

title: Bradley and Baby Royal Superstars Like
description: Bradley and this royal baby wants to be a superstar-like for a day. Help them achieve this look by choosing perfect outfits for them.

title: Prom Night At High School

description: The disney princess crew of Elsa, Tiana, Cinderella, and Ariel have been infected by the zombie virus! But even if they're zombies already, they still want to be fashionable and fabulous. Help these zombie princesses find the right zombie outfits that will fit them.

title: Trump Funny Face
description: Trump Funny Face is a funny face game for everybody. Use your mouse to make a funny face of Trump. Post your funny face creations on your Y8 Profile! Have fun playing this game here at Y8.com!

title: Princess Anna Hand Doctor
description: In this game you need to ensure first aid Anna game you will need to pull out the kit and start cleaning her hand and bandaging it or else she will be in pain and also her wound might get infected and we do not want that to happen. Be a good doctor in this Anna medical game and she will definitely be grateful that she ran into your office shortly after the accident occurred. Show her how to protect her hands the next time so she will not be visiting you too often with this issue.

title: Bonnie Coachella
description: Bonnie will be attending the one of the famous parties in the world - Coachella. Can you help her get ready with her makeup and outfit? Enjoy!

title: Princess Mannequin Challenge
description: Elsa, Jasmine, and Merida are looking for something fun to do today. They've decided to do Mannequin Challenge. You can use your creativity in choosing an outfit for them.

title: Princess April Fools Hair
description: It's April Fools day and Maleficent is in the right mood to prank some princesses.  Ariel, Elsa and Jasmine decided to have a hair makeover for today so they asked Maleficent to do they hair.

title: Princess Anna Arm Surgery
description: Could you be the surgeon who’s taking care of sweet Princess Anna and her emergency surgery? Then feel free to join her in getting the ‘Princess Anna Arm Surgery’ doctor game for girls started and first of all run a short test using the X-Ray machine to identify the broken bones. Then take her to the OR and step-by-step use all the sterilized tools to perform the arm surgery. Now of the next page of our fun Frozen game, you get to help our adorable little princess dress up as nicely as possible. Choose her a new hairstyle and a lovely printed top, match it with a cute skirt or with some shorts, a comfy pair of shoes and with some sparkly jewelries too. Have a great time playing the ‘Princess Anna Arm Surgery’ game for girls!

title: Little Brain Doctor
description: Annabelle is acting weird and she needs to get a brain operation so she can act normal again. Help this adorable brain doctor fulfill his duty. Enjoy!

title: Princess Highschool Dating Tips
description: Asking your crush on a date is quite difficult specially if it's you first time! In this game, there are some tips made to successfully ask your crush. Of course, you need to dress up in a way where your crush will notice you. Have fun!

title: Princesses Royal Boutique
description: There is a newly opened boutique in the city and these beautiful princesses are very excited to shop! Can you help them select and do some makeover? Have fun!

title: Sprout Hair Pins Game
description: Since the Heart Bangs hair trend made such huge waves last year, we’ve decided to start the new year in style with another one. Ladies, get ready for this one! Dressupwho.com brings up the quirky floral ‘antenna hairpins’ a quirky new trend originated in China. Come and join us in getting the ’Sprout Hair Pins’ game started to learn more about it and also how to wear these funky flower-made antennas. Begin with a fun doll-maker session in which you get to customize the girl’s face as you wish starting with its face, eyebrows, the color and shape of her eyes, nose and lips. Don’t forget to also apply a thin layer of blush for a complete session. Once you’re done within stage, you can move to the next page of the game and choose a really cute outfit to dress your model girl up with! Decide on the outfits she should wear today, then deal with her hairstyle and choose sprout hair pin to accessorize it up with! Have a great time playing our new hair game for girls!

title: Stone Age Racing
description: These prehistoric guys are totally crazy! They were bored to paint in their caverns so they made crazy vehicles and go fast on desert rocks, jungle trails or the snowy mountain slopes! And there are rocket birds, turtles and explosive pigs in this pretty mess! Let's go!

title: The Doctor Hospital
description: Reynaldo the only doctor in the clinic wanted to go for a short vacation to relieve all his stress but no one will check on all the patients. Good thing his friend Charice, also a doctor, came by and was nice enough to take over. But she's really into a great deal of work now that she found out that Renata, the nurse, needs to go too. So she's left alone taking care all the patients. Help her manage the hospital and get though her shift and also fulfill all her tasks.

title: Battle Robot T-Rex Age
description: Battle Robot T-Rex Age is an assembly game similar to model making except your get to fight with your creations afterwards. Put the pieces of your T-Rex together and progress to the next stage in this robot themed fighting game.

title: Bonnie's Patchwork Peasant Dress
description: Bonnie loves to design clothes, this time she needs a elegant peasant dress! Can you help Bonnie?

title: Hipster Creator
description: Being a hipster these days is really hard! You have to deal with the ideal of being nonconforming while looking identical to everyone in the hipster community. So, do you want to be one of them? Then play the "Hipster Girl" dress up game and find out what it takes to be a real hipster. Put your fashion skills at work, start mixing all of those old school tight fitting t-shirts, skinny jeans, flowing sweaters and retro shoes and put together a unique hipster attire to dress her up.

title: Donald Trump Vs Hillary Clinton
description: Donald Trump and Hillary Clinton are both running to win the presidential elections in the United States. But none of them is quite ready to be the new president the country needs… they first need to stop by Mr. Obama’s hair salon to get a new haircut and then to get ready to make a good impression at the last confrontation. So why don’t you ladies step in getting this brand new game of the hair salon series started and help Mr. Obama deal with your favorite candidate. Begin by selecting between the two of them, then check out the new hairstyle they want to want to flaunt at the next confrontation and help Obama create it in no time. Once you’re done you can even choose a funky outfit to dress up your candidate with. Have a great time playing this fun game for girls!

title: Koutack
description: Your goal in this puzzle game is to stack the tiles into a single stack.

title: Highway Patrol Showdown
description: You always wanted to race with police cars? Now it's possible with Highway Patrol Showdown! You can choose between several vehicles and different police decorations of the world!

title: Jessica at Spa Salon
description: Take care for Jessica. She is need an spa face treatment which will make her face smooth and gentle. After you will finish her spa, help her to choose clothes and complete her look.

title: My First Crush Date
description: This girl has a date with the guy she’s been chasing all year. Help her look fab!

title: A Gift For Mother
description: It's the mother's day. So let help this mother to prepare herself, with makeup and dress up to look gorgeous on front of her son.

title: Toy Car Simulator
description: Toy Car Simulator is a 3D car simulator game which lets you play with dozens of toy cars! It's a game with various game modes: free ride in which you freely explore a big city and collect coins, highway mode in which you participate in an adrenaline pumped high-speed car race to collect coins and avoid traffic, and lastly arena mode in which you compete with other toy cars to eliminate each other. In the first 2 modes, your car relies on battery; fill it occasionally by picking up the red thunder power-up. Don't forget to collect coins to unlock more awesome rides, including a helicopter and even a tank! All of the game modes are guaranteed to let you have fun for hours!

title: Air Hockey Html5
description: In this game, your goal is to score against your enemy by shooting the puck into the enemy's end.

title: Lost in Time Html5
description: Time is lost in this Mahjong Solitaire. Combine free tiles to remove tiles. Combine the time tiles as fast as possible.

title: International Royal Beauty Contest
description: Welcome to the International Royal Beauty Contest, where princesses from all over the world show off their talents, beauty and fashion taste. This year’s finalists are: Elsa (Norway), Cinderella (France), Moana (USA) and Jasmine (Iran). Help each princess choose the most exquisite gown and matching accessories. When all the contestants are ready, enjoy the amazing talent show and pick hearts to make your favorite princess win. Who will become Royal Miss World this year?

title: Ezender Keeper
description: You are the guardian of the Ezender's mines, hidden in a mountain that was the great fortress of an ancient and forgotten kingdom. Some fools are looking for something and have awakened you ... Show them they are not welcome here!

title: Princess Moana's Ship
description: Beautiful princess Moana is now getting ready for a brand-new mission. She needs to find a new outfit and to customize her boat. Can you help her to do so? Just choose her clothes and the colors of her boat. Have fun!

title: Cute Panda Dentist Care
description:
Ever wanted to be a dentist? Do you think you can do a better job than your local dentist? Now is your chance. Become a dentist of this Cute little Panda themed dentist game.
Take care of her mouth health, and make to shiny her teeth.

title: Bonnie and Friends Graduation
description: You’ve been chosen to take care of Bonnie’s lovely look for the Graduation Hurry up and join her to see what jaw-dropping looks you can put others for these lovely friends. Keep in mind that these beautiful girls love their glitzy dresses, killer high-heels and oversized jewelry when choosing the outfit they are going to wear under the colourful robe. Go through each girl’s uber chic wardrobe and select whatever you like the most to dress up the best friends, then select the right graduation cap hat and robe for them!

title: Around The World Darts
description: Round the clock darts: from 1 to 16 and finally the bull. Throw the darts from 1 to 16 and end on the bull. Can you finish before your computer opponent.

title: Prince Romper Squad
description: The rompers for men is the new fashion craze in town and four of your favourite Disney Princes are going to try on these colourful, summer fitted one-piece shirt-and-short combo and you ladies are going to help them out! So come and join the brave man in getting our exclusive ‘Prince Romper Squad’ dress up game started and see what daring looks you can put together for each of these male characters willing to make a fashion statement. The rompers in our game come in a wide variety of colors, some of them feature playful prints while others are plain and more easily to be accessorised. Depending on their style male rompers can be accessorise with loafers, sneakers and moccasins, with bomber jackets or with checkered shirts, with hats, sunglasses and with… statement beards, of course. Feel free to go for bold choices when dressing up the Frog Prince, Kristoff, Li Shang and Prince Eric.

title: Magic Princess Secret Recipe
description: Learn how to use magic in cooking, follow the recipe of this princess and you will find the magic secret and make amazing cake.

title: Zombie Derby
description: Will you find the road to survival? Real men have two favorite things: cars and weapons. It is not the arrival of stinking zombies that will change the deal. Take control of your car and escape by eliminating a max of zombies while trying not to lose your head. 6 cars available to help you reach the stronghold. All are improveable during the game, from the simple farm pick-up through the classy Hunter, the solid Sledge or the stupid Harvester. You will love to throw your vehicles on lines of undead. Each of these cars can be upgraded with 15 items, such as a pile bumper, improved tires, overinflated engine, plus armaments, fuel or turbos. 5 different places to explore, amazing 3D graphics and ruthlessly exploding bodies, Zombie Derby is a killer game. How far will you go before they catch you?

title: Make a Car Simulator
description: This is a car building simulator! If you don't mind complex controls, you can make very cool cars in this game. Once you have built your roadworthy vehicle, take it for a spin and see how it drives. Share your car pictures with others by taking a screenshot.

title: Sea Battles
description: Sea Battles is a great naval combat game. The game has beautiful 3D graphics, and is very interesting, with lots of action !. Sea Battles is an excellent challenge for your captain's skills. You must defend the complex against an opponent ready to destroy it - and destroy you at the same time. Sea Battles guarantees you at least a few hours of fun and good mood. The real connoisseurs will find the game very playable!

title: Zombie Derby 2
description: Check out this sequel of a great arcade game with cool 3D graphics! Brutal upgradable cars, big guns and daredevil speed will steer you through places that are chock-a-block with zombies…

title: Maximum Acceleration
description: 3D car racing simulation game where you will take part in a car racing championship. Drive as fast as you can to win all the opponents and purchase faster cars.

title: Emilia Spa Party
description: Take care for Emilia about her beauty. Make some hair and face treatment, then choose the hair style and color. And finally you can finish her look by choosing clothes.

title: Y8 Racing Thunder
description: You are chosen to win the race every track. Defeat all the racers and become a top racer in history. You can unlock other cars by winning the race every track.

title: Water Scooter Mania
description: A really awesome game where you have to race with water scooters against other competitors. Do you have the skills to win the gold medal in every race?

title: Princess EDC Vegas
description: Las Vegas never sleeps and the Electric Daisy Carnival made sure its streets will be filled with party people and good music. But how about you, ladies? Are you going to attend it? Of course that your are! We’ve prepared a VIP ticket for you to the most awaited summer festival so hurry up and get the ‘Princess EDC Vegas’ dress up game started to team up with Jasmine, Anna, Elsa and Aurora as they are heading to Las Vegas.

title: Superstar High School 2
description: The much awaited continuation of the interactive fiction Superstar High School is here. Will Izzy stay unrecognized as the famous Crystal Anderson? What will her life at school like, now she's friends with Chloe? Will her frenemy Deon find out that she's actually the Crystal Anderson that he admires so much? Find out now in this new episode!

title: Space Princess
description: Give Princess Leia  from Star Wars movie some tips on dressing up and discover how pretty she can be.

title: Neon Bathing Suits
description: Summer is here and that means one thing: it’s time for beautiful Lisa to pack a few things and head to the seaside for a relaxing sunbathing session on her yacht. She’s going to spend the entire morning preparing for it and she could surely use your precious helping hand. Come and join her in getting the ‘Neon Bathing Suits’ game started and first of all, see if you could design a neon bathing suit for our fancy girl here. Select its shape and a few bold colors in order to make sure you come up with a unique design for Lisa’s bathing suit. Next you’ll have to shave her legs and armpit by using a delicate shaving foam and a razor. Don’t forget to also apply some sunblock and then you can put on the neon bathing suit you’ve created at the beginning of the game. Choose a matching pair of flip-flops, a pretty hair accessories and some sparkling jewelries and a pair of over-sized sunglasses. Great job, ladies! Now how much should we let her enjoy the warm sun rays?

title: Boyfriend Girl Makeover
description: As a girl, it is your time now to dress up and make up your boyfriend. Pick a dress for the girl and also for her boyfriend.

title: Descendants Dress Up
description: They need your help to make them looks awesome. Pick any dress for them and you can freely select those dress as you can. It is your choice.

title: Wonder Woman Movie
description: Today you ladies are invited to spend the day in the company of this beloved superhero character known as Wonder Woman. She’s a bit busy filming for the new movie but you’ll get to help her out through some important scenes. Get the ‘Wonder Woman Movie’ dress up game started to join her in and then get ready to discover the setting of the first scene.

title: Princess Dentist
description: Guess what? Four of your favourite Disney Princesses are in need of a super talented dentist to help them deal with their toothache and since you are the best one out there, you’ve been chosen to take a closer look. Queen Elsa, Ariel, Cinderella and Rapunzel are the four patients on your waiting list but due to your busy schedule and you will be dealing only with one of them. So join the girls in getting the ‘Princess Dentist’ game for girls started and begin by selecting your patient. Once the main decision was taken, you can then move to the next page of your game and use your dentist tools to fix all of those painful cavities. Move on and get rid of the bacteria living on her tongue. Great job, ladies! Now since you patient is feeling way better, you can also choose her a really nice top to dress her up with! Have a blast!

title: Shadowhawks Squadron
description:
In Shadowhawks Squadron, you take the place of a pilot of an elite squadron charged with defending the human colonies which are attacked by an unknown extraterrestrial race... Shadowhawks Squadron is a great 3-dimensional space shooter with nice graphics.
You can choose to follow the campaign mode and complete the different missions to save humanity, or you can switch to survival mode, where, as the name suggests, you will have to survive the enemy waves for as long as possible.
Have fun!

title: Minion Wedding Hairstyles
description: We’ve got some wonderful news for you, ladies! This lucky minion girl is now getting ready to walk down the aisle and she would very much like to impress her loving groom with a stunning bridal look. She’s going to need some expert advice and you have been chosen to help her impress on one of the most important days in her life. As her personal fashion adviser you’ll have to deal with her bridal hairstyle and choose a lovely wedding dress that’s sure to make a statement. So get the ‘Minion Wedding Hairstyles’ game for girls started and begin the beautifying process with a hairstyling session. Use professional hair care products to wash her hair, then blow it with the hairdryer and then go to the next page of the game to decide on her wedding hairstyles. There are three elegant hairdos prepared for her big day and you just have to decide on the winning one and then carefully fix the hair locks until you obtain the desired updo. Select from different colors a new shade for her bridal hairstyle, then accessorize it as you wish and finally go to the next page of the game to find the right bridal dress. Have a great time playing the ‘Minion Wedding Hairstyles’ game!

title: Princess or Minion
description: These four best friends are huge fans of the funky Minions so the came up with this challenging idea of wearing Minion inspired outfits for a whole week. It’s going to be minion inspired outfits for their next night out or beach day… and it’s going to be so much fun. You could also help them out by getting started the Princess Or Minion dress up game for girls. Once in feel free to browse though their wide collection of girly-girl, fit and flare dresses, lovely tops and matching pleated mini-skirts, cute over-tops and high heeled shoes - all of them available in different shades of yellow and blue - and see what jaw-dropping minion inspired looks you can put together for Princess Anna, Snow White, Rapunzel and Princess Ariel. Select some oversized goggles or a nice hat to complete their looks with! Have fun, ladies!

title: Jolly Jumpers
description: Call your friends and let's play Jolly Jumpers! Not just 2 players but 4 can compete in this very challenging game. Jump on those moving platforms and climb as high as you can so that the lava won't get you. Who will be the last one standing and be the ultimate Jolly Jumper?

title: Cleaning Girl RPG
description: Help this sweet girl around cleaning her home and hiding the evidence of her last night. Be quick because her parents are coming soon.

title: Spongebob Crossdress
description: A mysterious lady just moved in the underwater city of Bikini Bottom and every bachelor living there can't wait to meet the cutie. But we won’t let her make a first bad impression, isn’t it ladies? Before letting SpongeSue out in the neighbourhood we need to make sure her look is flawless, her hair stays in place and that nothing will vanish that charming smile on her face! So let’s join her in getting this brand new game for girls started and help miss SpongeSue prepare herself to meet the neighbours but especially to meet SpongeBob Squarepants… because of him she is here after all. Begin the preparations by customising her smiling face: you get to choose from a wide selection of eye shapes, eyebrows shapes, noses and smiles the pair that brings a bit of chicness to her face. Once you’re done, you can then go to the next page of the game and decide on the hairstyle. Choose the bangs, then the back and change the color of her hair with a new one. Then browse through her Sue inspired wardrobe and select a candy-colored two pieces outfit or a girly-girl dress to dress her up with. Don’t forget to also accessorise your selected outfit as well. Well, what do you think? Is she going to conquer SpongeBob’s heart?

title: Baby Mother's Surprise
description: Create your own fashion by cutting moms clothes. Maybe skip that in real life, it's alright in a game though. Create art and crafts projects like sewing a string to make a design. Create the perfect gift to impress your mother.

title: Princess Castle Wardrobe
description: This lovely princess needs a new look for her party that will be held in the castle! As a princess, she needs to stand out among the other princesses. Choose an outfit that will make her the prettiest princess in the party!

title: Vampire Princess New Room
description: The vampire princesses just moved into their new house. They can't wait to decorate their own rooms! There are so many cute furnitures to choose from. You could decide where to arrange the furnitures, which wallpaper you like and how the floors look like. The best thing is you could design custom made furniture using the color pallette and beautiful patterns. How great is that! Set the diner table and prepare some drinks and food, too! Because once the vampire princess new room is done decorating, we could have a house warming party! Have fun playing this new HTML5 game called the Vampire Princess New Room game!

title: Rooster Warrior
description: Help the Rooster Warrior to pass the trial of Gods and proof that he has ability to handle his parent rejection. So go ahead trough the levels by fighting with all enemies who will appear, beat the all bosses which will stay on the way, and collect all item which are necessary for building the village.

title: Battle Robot Samurai Age
description: One more Battle Robot game, this time your robot is the samurai which must beat the opponent. Let assemble your robot, then training with him to be ready for battle with opponent.

title: Bartender Perfect Mix
description: Help this stunning lady bartender to mix her drinks in the right ratios. You can choose a bunch of drinks such as Vodka, Whisky, Tequila, and a lot more from the shelf.

title: Super Nanny Jen
description: Through Super Nanny Jen  bring this two little kids to discipline and order, and this brother and sister will learn something more how to behave.

title: Ariana Grande World Tour
description: Is that her personal fashion adviser quit her job and that she's looking to hire a new one? It's a great opportunity to travel the world and stay around one of the hottest celebrities out there. Come and join her in getting the Ariana World Tour? Celebrity dress up game for girls started and discover the places you two are going to visit.

title: Monster Swimsuit Design
description: You have an opportunity to design swimsuits to produce and sell in store - what type of swimsuit do you think would be the biggest seller? Use your taste and imagination to design a great looking swimsuit!

title: Perfect Proposal Ella
description: Jack Frost is planning a special wedding proposal for his beloved Queen Elsa, but he could use a bit of guidance. first of all, help him choose a really cute outfit! Go through his selection of colourful shirts, pants and sporty shoes, mix and match them and pick the right mix to dress him up for this special occasion. Choose a lovely blanket to lay on the grass, select one picnic basket filled with all sorts of delicious things and do not forget to also bring some champagne to celebrate the big event. Next you will have to help Jack propose to Elsa. Write in the sky those romantic two words and wait to see Elsa's reaction!

title: Princess of Thrones
description: If you like to design lavish dresses with multiple patterns, color choices and various details, you'll enjoy this game even if you've never heard of the TV show Game of Thrones! The show has characters from different places in the world, cold and warm. So bundle them up in the warm robes of the North. Or drape them in the lavish kimonos and dresses of King's Landing! Or mix them all to create your own ensemble worthy of the throne!

title: Mother Daughter Waterpark
description: These adorable mother and her daughter will be going out for their mother-daughter bonding. They will be going to the waterpark! Can you help the mother to organize everything and be fashionable on their trip?

title: Olympic Jump
description: Try to cross over the obstacles and reach the next level.

title: Pack the Graves
description: Classic sokoban game, this time with zombies. Help this witch to put the zombies in graves.

title: Plumber Duck
description: Play Plumber Duck and connect those pipes to get water flowing again. Someone has to do it and not everyone wants to be a plumber. But maybe there is something rewarding to it. Try for yourself, you may find you have a natural gift. It's also just a puzzle game, so have fun too.

title: Unmatch the Candies
description: Contrary of matching game, try to unmatch the candies and pass the level.

title: Stick Figure Badminton 3
description: The stickman are back to compete in panting and intense badminton competitions. Challenge the AI or one of your friends in the sports game Stick Figure Badminton 3. Try to score more points than your opponent by hitting the flywheel with powerful shots or deceptive cushings, dominate the opposing player by surprising him with your tactical choices. The adrenaline will be present when the matches are tight, will you be able to win the majority of your matches?

title: Chef Chicken Ramen
description: Cook this asian delicacy and savor the delicious chicken broth. Be the master chef in cooking the famous chicken ramen.

title: Burnout Drift: Hilltop
description:
Burnout Drift is back! This time, you will have a time limit to make drifts! And to render things even more complicated: bad climatic condititons are part of the party!
There is always a wide choice of customizable cars with which to have fun! Burn your tires and  enjoy!

title: Tanks Battlefield
description: Drive and control this metal behemoth. Search and destroy your enemy tanks. Complete all the missions or fight with your own team in Arena mode. Unlock all achievements and compete with others in the leaderboard!

title: Kim Jong Un Funny Face
description: Kim Jong Un Funny Face - A Fun game for everybody. Just for fun this games makes funny faces for the ultimate supreme leader. Drag the yellow points on the face to make facial distortions. Use your mouse to make a funny face of Kim. Be creative and make Y8 screenshots and post it in your profile. Enjoy playing Funny Face game brought to you by Y8.com!

title: Armored Kitten
description: Play as a great kitten warrior, and beat the horrible monsters that come out of hell, zombies and other aliens in this shoot'em all game. Several missions with different objectives like a survival time or bombs to drop and a wide range of weapons and armor to unlock! Enjoy!

title: Adventure Time Dress Up
description: Dress up these famous characters of Adventure Time.

title: Bead Smith Jen: Tribal
description: Help Jen create her own tribal bracelet. Match those beads and choose an outfit for her.

title: Bonnie Pregnancy Care
description: Bonnie is about to become a mom. She's looking for an assistant to help her catering her needs. You will be a good fit for this role so take good care of her until she give birth.

title: Family Weekend Outing
description: It's the weekend and the family decided to go on a trip! Help them to grab all the necessary items and choose how to get dress for the occasion! Enjoy!

title: Emily's Diary: Beach date
description: During the hot, sunny, summer day all you want is to splash in the water and drink refreshing cocktails. Ni and Ani got together for a double date on the beach. Girls looked stunning in their colorful swimsuits and stylish accessories.

title: BubbleQuod
description: You need to free yourself from the bubble in which you are imprisoned. How to do this? The bubble can be pierced by a nail which is situated in the wall. Fun adventure game with many interesting puzzle levels. You can also play the second part of this game on the Y8 and have fun!

title: Denim Hairstyles
description: If your fashion is hair  styling, then this game for sure you will love it. Hair style your avatar and dress her up to look more stunning and lovely.

title: Draculaura Blind Date
description: Do you love playing with dracula? Well, in this game you just not play with him you can date him. Dress up to have a date like dracula.

title: Kendal Friends Salon
description: In this you will pick one character which is Kendall and her friends and you will style their hair. Once you done on hair styling, dress them up to look more beautiful.

title: Tanks Html5
description:
Tanks is the best game out there. Prove that you and you alone are the best tank pilot by blowing your opposition to smithereens. 
Play against AI opponents of varying difficulty, or challenge your friends to a duel, a duel of Tanks. Take the turn launching hunks of explosive metal into the air, and then smile as then come crashing down on your opponent, obliterating terrain or the enemy tank itself. But you’ll have to make sure you have the angle just right, or the only thing you’ll be feeling—rather than a sense of victory—is embarrassment. Succeed, though, and you’ll not only get a nice sense of accomplishment for angling those attacks just right, you’ll also earn money! Spend it on upgrading your tank, or buying additional items. 
Keep being victorious, and you’ll be the greatest tank in all the land.

title: Zombie vs Janitor
description: You are the janitor of the college and the only one who survived after the apocalypse. Now you have to defend yourself against the students and teachers who turned into zombies. Try to survive as long as possible Good luck!

title: Funny Zlatan  Face
description: Zlatan Funny Face - Fun HTML5 game for everybody. Use your mouse to make a funny face of worlds best footballs player Zlatan.

title: Girls' Summer Vacation Travel
description: Nina, Jolie and Beth are best friends. This summer vacation they plan to travel together. Let's go! First they arrived at Maldives, the summer paradise. Help them dress up for the beach and have fun! The next destination is Paris, the world fashion center. Let's create the best fashion looks for our girls. Oh don't forget to pick gifts for their family and friends, too! Select souvenirs and pack them with love. This is the best summer vacation ever!

title: Spiders Arena 2
description: Are spiders scaring you? And what would you say to explode a few spiders? Awesome, isn't it? Take a gun and shoot them all! Welcome to Spiders Arena 2! You will have to survive as long as possible, wave after wave, against big spiders and other machines. You can buy ammo and new weapons in the arena shop. The more waves you pass, the harder the survival. Have fun!

title: Princess Yoga
description: These princesses is having their daily yoga routine. They've decided to do it together. Before doing the yoga, they need to wear a comfortable outfit so they can comfortably perform the yoga routines. Can you help them dress up?

title: Monsterfy: Lady Gaga
description: Lady Gaga is one of the famous stars in this generation. She's going to have a concert in Monster High and she needs your help in preparing everything she needs before the show started.

title: DIY Galaxy Shoes
description: Galaxy shoes are probably the coolest must have items of this sunny season, but what if the ones you use on a daily basis are just a trivial pair of black snickers? Well ladies, I suppose you should learn how to give them a splash of color and some glittering bits while playing latest shoe decoration game called ‘DIY Galaxy Shoes’! title: 8 Ball Pool
description:
8 Ball Pool brings the classic cue sport experience to your browser with smooth controls and straightforward gameplay. The game focuses on precision, planning, and steady aim as you take turns hitting the cue ball and trying to pocket your balls in the correct order. It is easy to start playing, but learning how to control the table takes practice and patience.
In 8 Ball Pool, you aim your cue stick and choose the power of each shot to strike the cue ball. The goal is to pocket all of your assigned balls and then sink the black 8 ball to win the match. Every shot matters, because the position of the cue ball after each hit can either set you up for success or make the next move more difficult. Thinking ahead and choosing smart angles is an important part of the game.
The game offers two main modes. In Play Against Time, you race against the clock to pocket as many balls as possible before time runs out. This mode rewards quick thinking and fast reactions, pushing you to line up shots efficiently while keeping accuracy under pressure. It is a great way to practice and improve your control over the cue ball.
The second mode is 1 vs 1, where you play a full match against an opponent on the same table. This mode focuses more on strategy and careful planning. You take turns, watch how the table changes after each shot, and decide when to play safe or when to go for a difficult pocket. Every decision can change the flow of the game, making each match feel different.
The controls are simple and easy to understand. You adjust your aim with the mouse and choose how hard to hit the cue ball. This makes the game accessible for new players while still giving experienced players room to refine their technique. Learning how much power to use and how angles affect ball movement adds depth to the gameplay.
Visually, 8 Ball Pool is clear and easy to follow. The table, balls, and pockets are well defined, making it easy to focus on your shots. Smooth animations help you see how the balls move and react after every hit, which helps you learn and improve with each game.
8 Ball Pool is well suited for short sessions as well as longer playtimes. You can jump in for a quick timed challenge or settle into a full 1 vs 1 match when you want a more thoughtful experience. The balance between simple controls and skill based gameplay keeps players coming back to improve their accuracy and strategy.
If you enjoy classic pool games that reward careful aim and smart decisions, 8 Ball Pool offers a satisfying and familiar experience that is easy to enjoy and fun to master.

title: Rooftop Snipers
description:
Rooftop Snipers is a fast and funny stickman duel game played on tiny rooftops where one good shot can win the round. You only have two controls, jump and shoot, but using them at the right time is what decides everything. The challenge comes from combining simple controls with physics based movement and very small platforms, so every jump and every bullet matters.
You move your character by jumping and letting the physics carry you. A well timed jump can help you dodge an incoming shot, land in a better position, or recover when you are close to the edge. Shooting is just as important. When your bullet hits the opponent, it pushes them backward toward the edge or off the rooftop completely. You have to aim carefully and choose the right moment to fire, because missing your shot gives your opponent a chance to strike back.
Each match is played as a series of quick rounds. The first to reach the required number of points wins. Rounds take place on different rooftops with fun variations, such as snow that makes the surface slippery or moving platforms that change your footing. These small twists keep each duel fresh and force you to adjust your timing and strategy.
Rooftop Snipers can be played alone against a computer opponent or in two player mode on the same device. The two player mode is especially fun, as both players share the screen and try to outthink each other with jumps, dodges, and well aimed shots.
The simple graphics, exaggerated animations, and short rounds make Rooftop Snipers easy to start and hard to put down. It is all about timing, aim, and staying calm when you are standing just a few pixels away from falling.
Rooftop Snipers delivers quick, lighthearted duels where winning feels great and even losing often ends in a funny moment that makes you want to try again.
