description: Practice your sprint and your dash and compete against other pro players in a 100 Meter Race! Tap furiously and timely to avoid falling over! Try to be the fastest and aim for the first place and make your mama proud!

title: Playful Kitty
description: The kitty wants to play and you'll have to find a way to give her the ball of yarn. Click on the breakable bricks so it'll give a way for the ball to fall towards this cute kitty cat. Collect gold coins for added bonus!

title: Flicking Soccer
description: You’ve never played a soccer game quite like this one. Take control of the players on this tabletop field and see if you can flick the ball into the goal before time runs out.

title: Swing Jet Pack
description: Your mission in this game is to control this jetpack flying to higher place. You need to tap the screen to let the hero survive as long as possible avoiding the obstacles. How high can you go? Let's enjoy!

title: Puppy Fun Care
description: The puppy is in need of some special cute care. He is muddy and dirty from playing outside. Give him the best bath of his little puppy life.

title: Coinz!
description:
Have you heard about new learning game Coinz! ? Are you curious and always trying to be up on the latest news? Try our addicting game Coinz!  and be up to the mark! Your goal is to clear the field of the more expensive currency by exchanging it with the less expensive. Click on a coin and see its exchange rate on the bottom. Select required amount of less expensive coins to make them disappear. 
So, do not be behind the times, play the cognitive game Coinz!

title: Tako Bubble
description:
Octopus Tako's beetle collection was blown away by a magical swirl of bubbles! Could you help it pop all the bubbles and find them back?
Tako Bubble is a turn-based casual puzzler; as soon as three glittering colored bubbles are popped, Tako can get to the next level by magic! Please help it crawl through deep-ocean environments, defeat ferocious monsters, pop all the bubbles, and find back the hidden beetle gems!

title: Tattoo Party
description: Welcome to the Tattoo Party, your task is to be the tattoo artist. So prepare the picture which is ordered for making a tattoo, and make an unique tattoo art on skin of your client.

title: Sportsman Boxing
description: Schedule a fight, pick a boxer and get into the ring. If you are crushed, try to get up before the count gets to 10!

title: Warzone Online MP
description: Your base was taken by your enemy and you need to do everything you can to clear the area from your enemies. Kill your enemies and find a way how to finish the game. We believe that you'll be able to make it and that you'll finish the game without that many problems. Try your luck!

title: Lead Rain
description: Try to survive and end every next mission, because in every mission you need to eliminate the certain number of enemies and get money, which can use to buy a new weapon or ammo.

title: Tile Remover
description: Tile Remover is the mix of classic bubble shooter and falling down block puzzle. Try to remove all tiles from the playground. Colored tiles are falling down one by one in each round and you must place them how the same colors shall be alongside. If you make a group of tiles [by at least 3 tiles] from same color then them will be removed. When you skip more than 1 or 2 round(s) without making a group then a new line with tiles will appear of the bottom side of playground.

title: Atari Breakout
description:
Breakout is an arcade game developed and published by Atari, Inc., and released on May 13, 1976.
In Breakout, a layer of bricks lines the top third of the screen and the goal is to destroy them all. A ball moves straight around the screen, bouncing off the top and two sides of the screen. When a brick is hit, the ball bounces back and the brick is destroyed. The player loses a turn when the ball touches the bottom of the screen; to prevent this from happening, the player has a horizontally movable paddle to bounce the ball upward, keeping it in play.

title: Supergun
description: Supergun is a fast-paced arcade racer with simple controls, retro-styled 3D graphics and nice electronic music.

title: Alpine Ski Master
description: Welcome to the best skiing competition the "Alpine Ski Master". Slide down on snow-covered hills, balance yourself on steep turns and beat the others by increasing your speed! Play as single player or compete with your friends or other players by playing in multiplayer. Unlock all the characters and tracks.  Get all the achievements on three difficulty modes: easy, medium and hard. Collect all the coins for added bonus. It will add up on your total score and you might end up being on the top of the leaderboard!

title: Space Arena
description: All alone in a space station, where the residents were turned to mindless eating flesh creatures. Surviving is slim but you got to do what you have to do and that's killing every single zombie! Survive every wave, earn money in every successful stage. Buy guns, grenades and ammunition. Unlock all achievements and be the one on top of the leaderboard!

title: Cyber Tank
description: Welcome to Cyber Tank, a very challenging puzzle game that will test your thinking skills on solving a way to get your tank out to the exit. Before that you need to collect all the energy cubes that were scattered around the map that will give you extra points. Make use of the objects that you can move and the mirror that can help you do things by using it's reflective property. Enjoy solving all this 42 mind breaking puzzle stages!

title: Monster Rampage
description: You are Wolfein the ancient guardian of Mother Earth. You were awaken by her because she needs to punish all the mortals who destroyed her beloved land and ocean. Your only mission is to eat all those ungrateful people and never leave anyone alive! Destroy all the things that will block your way and be that unstoppable eating machine!

title: Dave's Album
description:
Old Dave needs to go on with his life, but he is not strong enough, not alone.
He needs help from his past, using the photos he had made when he was younger to find the strenght to continue on his journey.
Why won't you give Dave your help too?

title: Couples Valentine Date
description: Aha! The most romantic day of the year has finally arrived! Valentine's Day! You know, Anna and Kristoff became lovers, and surprisingly, Elsa and Jack also fell in love. Today, the two couples decide to spend their Valentine's day on a double date. Of course, the first thing is to dress up, hurry up, come on!

title: Ladybug Valentine Date
description: Happy Valentine's Day! How to spend this romantic day? Of course, it must be a sweet date! So, the couple Cat Noir and Ladybug are both preparing for their date, could you give your fashion advice to them and help them dress up. Oh, great! The day is very perfect! Let's take a photo to post on Facebook.

title: Princess Gothic Dress Up
description: Princesses can also rock a gothic style. Dress them up with these gothic-inspired outfits. Have fun choosing and mixing outfits.

title: Princess At Fashion Week
description: Fashion week is coming and all these Disney princesses want to prepare for this activity. Help them choose the most suitable and beautiful dress and make them shinning in the stage. You can do it, come on!

title: Princess Rococo Fashion Trends
description: Princess Anna, Princess Rapunzel, and Princess Jasmine want to try a Rococo fashion. Help them mix and match some outfits and make the Rococo fashion looks good on them.

title: Princesses Fashion Competition
description: Princesses Fashion Competition is a dress up game where princesses have a fashion competition and they need your help. Can you select an outfit that fits them well?

title: Queen or Lover
description: Queen Elsa has been cursed by the evil queen. She can only choose between being a queen or be the wife of Jack frost. You can choose her destiny as well as her outfit!

title: Winter Fashion Street Snap
description: Winter is fast approaching, so Anna and Elsa are preparing their winter outfits. Can you help them?

title: Princess Bohemia Style Fashion
description: Recently, princesses Anna, Rapunzel and Jasmine are very interested in Bohemian style, Bohemian style represents an unprecedented romanticization, folklore, and liberalization. Layered lace, batik printing, cortex tassels, handmade embroidery and beads are so beautiful! Now, let's help the girls try on the Bohemian style clothing!

title: Princess Fight Evil
description: Princess Fight Evil is an online Kids game, it's playable on all smartphones or tablets, such as iPhone, iPad, Samsung and other Apple and android system. The Evil Queen will attack Disney land this evening. Now you need to help the princesses to put on battle suits. When you did that, let's help our princesses practice their superpowers by shooting down 5 flying saucers and then battle with Evil Queen. Justice will prevail over evil!

title: Princess Hip-hop Battle
description: Princesses Rapunzel, Ariel and Jasmine are all hip-hop masters, tonight a hip-hop battle between them will be shown, who will be the winner? It will be a very wonderful show! Enjoy!

title: Defender of the Base
description: Defender of the base is a survival game in which you will pick guns to save your self against the attackers. You have plenty of time to ready against the wave of enemies. Shoot them all and make a high score.

title: Fun Dentist
description: Oh nooo! Sally has a toothache and it's time for her to go to the dentist and have it check. You are the designated dentist and you need to treat her quick. Remove all the cavities, the decayed part and extract those bad teeth. Whiten her teeth and put some fancy decorations on it too!

title: Super Nanny Emma
description: Mrs. James called Emma because she needs someone to babysit her kids when she's away. Finn and Chloe are picky eaters and doesn't want to do household chores. Help Emma on taking are of these kids. Make them food, teach them how to clean and take care of themselves also don't forget to have fun!

title: Taz Mechanic Simulator
description: Customize your own vehicle and test drive it. You can change the color of your car as well as the appearance of the car such as frame, coils, tires, engine, and body panels. Once you have created your own dream vehicle, test it out and check what else you can add to make it look cooler and run faster. You can always change its parts or even building it from scratch again.

title: Cox
description: Looking for an easy platform game? Well Cox isn't the game for you. This game might look simple with it's blocky graphics and basic obstacles but once you play this you'll be playing the most challenging game of your life. There are 30 stages and every stages gets harder and harder as you go forward. Unlock all the achievements and see if you can be one in the leaderboard!

title: Ghost Town WebGL
description: Welcome to Ghost Town where the only living thing is you! Survive in this hell hole, use all the weapons available and kill all the monsters, abominations, undead and all the creepy creatures that will eat you alive! There's no where to run so you better gear up and fight for your life. Challenge yourself more by unlocking all the achievements and have your name in the leaderboard!

title: Olaf The Jumper
description: Olaf The Jumper will take to a challenging adventure. Jump over the  glacier and volcano platform. The more successful jumps you get, the higher your score.

title: Moto X3M Winter
description: What better way to celebrate the holidays than with tons of death-defying stunts? Jump on this bike and get ready to dodge gigantic saw blades while you blast your way across a winter wonderland. Can you make it across each finish line without crashing into a dozen boxes of TNT or some other totally insane hazards? This crazy, wintertime racing game could keep you busy until spring or even beyond!

title: My Zombie Classmates
description: My Zombie Classmates is an exciting html5 game where you need to target the teachers inside the obstacles. Use zombie balls as a bullets and a big werewolf as shooter.

title: Free Cell Solitaire
description: Free Cell Solitaire is a fun and challenging solitaire game. Drag and drop the cards according to the descending order of the cards.

title: Soap Ball Craze
description: Soap Ball Craze is an HTML5 physics game where you need to pop the bubbles using limited numbers of balls. In the later levels, you will discover different kinds of special balls and weapons.

title: Hostages Rescue
description: There are 10 hostages in the area. Each hostage is inside a tent that's heavily guarded by armed men. Your task is to rescue all of them. Sneak and infiltrate every tent, get all the hostages out and make it out alive in this game, Hostages Rescue!

title: The Sorcerer
description: The Sorcerer is a nice bubble popper game. We shoot some balls with the help of our sorcerer on the colorful chain of balls to match 3 same colored balls. Thus will be removed from the field than. Our goal is to remove the whole chain before it reaches the end.

title: Truck Legends
description: Race with the biggest and meanest trucks in town in Truck Legends! 20 challenging stages that will put your driving skills to the test. Unlock all the achievements and trucks. You can also race against your friends or other players,1vs1,  in the multiplayer mode. Beat them all and be in the leaderboard!

title: Footgolf Evolution
description:
Footgolf! Combining two of our favorite sports into an even more beautiful game. 
Click the ball and drag, to set the power and direction.
Avoid obstacles and get the football down the hole with the lower number of kicks possible.

title: Lee Kee Child
description:
Lee Kee Child is the classic rocks and diamonds game
Who is this little boy in the cave among diamonds, stones and brick walls? 
He is Lee Kee Child. His mission is to collect diamonds in the caves. If he was collecting all of diamonds what he needs, the door will open and he can continue collecting diamonds on the next level.
Maybe can you help him to collect enough diamonds and completing levels? 
Try it out!
In this work maybe little enemies will be disturbing him. These are flies and butterflies. Them are useful bugs for breaking brick walls and disappearing/isolating acid.
Try how it works!
The butterflies are the sources of diamonds. If he is dropping a butterfly with a stone it will turn into diamonds, and Lee Kee Child will gain up to 9 diamonds. In some levels has been another source of the diamonds by the isolated acid. The acid will increase randomly on its neighbour green fields and empty fields. If he can isolate successfully the acid by stones or diamonds before it reached up a big size, it turns into diamonds, else it turns into stones.
Try what happens when the bugs are impacting into the acid!
You can see a small diamond icon and two numbers in the top left corner. The first number means how many diamonds collected by Lee Kee Child, the second how many 
diamonds need to completing the level.
Have fun!

title: Penalty Kicks
description: Hey you soccer fans out there! Want to practice your kicks? Well Penalty Kicks is the game for you. This game can be played on both computer and mobile so you can practice anytime you like. See if you can goal more than the others in the leaderboard!

title: The Running Champion
description: The Running Champion is an endless running game. Try to run as long as possible and avoid all the opposing players.

title: 2048 Defence
description: Get same number tiles together and make it bigger. Attack monster with same or bigger number. Don't let them to stop on your mission, defense your field from in coming monsters and reach 2048.

title: Color Tunnel
description:
Color Tunnel is a fast-paced reflex game where you race through a long tunnel filled with bold colors and constantly changing geometric obstacles. Your goal is simple: stay alive for as long as possible by dodging shapes that block your path while moving forward at increasing speed.
The tunnel is built from bright, high-contrast color patterns and clean geometric designs, making obstacles clear and easy to read even when the game speeds up. As you move deeper into the tunnel, the shapes become more complex and appear more frequently, pushing your reaction time and focus to the limit.
Gameplay is smooth and continuous. You only need to move left or right to avoid incoming barriers, but timing and positioning are everything. A small mistake or late movement can instantly end your run, which makes every second feel intense and rewarding.
Each run is different. The tunnel layout changes dynamically, creating new combinations of shapes, gaps, and narrow paths. Sometimes you’ll glide through wide openings, and other times you’ll need sharp, precise movements to slip through tight spaces. This variety keeps the game exciting and highly replayable.
Color Tunnel rewards concentration and consistency rather than memorization. The longer you survive, the faster the game becomes, encouraging players to improve their reflexes and beat their previous distance records. It’s the kind of game where you instantly want to try again after failing, just to see if you can go a little farther.
With its clean visuals, smooth controls, and nonstop forward motion, Color Tunnel delivers a focused skill challenge that’s easy to start but difficult to master. Perfect for quick sessions or longer streaks of high-speed play, it’s a great choice for players who enjoy fast reaction games and endless obstacle dodging.

title: Monkey Jumping
description: Inspired by the kid's song "five little monkeys jumping on the bed", Monkey Jumping is a game that will really keep you active all the way up! Yes, it's all the way up because in this game your only objective is to not let your monkey fall out from the bed while it jumps its way all the way up. Remember to avoid the fire and collect bananas for added bonus. This might sound simple but once you play it with your desktop or mobile, you'll definitely find this very challenging. So what are you waiting for? Let's get jumping!

title: Ultimate Swish Mobile
description: Ultimate Swish is an excellent sports game that will delight all basketball lovers. Stand in the role of a player on the board and try to throw the balls in the basket from different positions. For each position, you have a total of five balls, with a classic basket with one point and a basket with a 2-point ball.

title: Kitty Fun Care
description: Allow this kitten full attention and care, first clean it from the leaves and branches. Than take care for his bath, grooming, feeding. At last you can choose the clothes and accessories which will finish the look of this cute little cat.

title: Love Diary 1
description: Help the girl in her task to clean the beach from the rubbish. Than to take care of her injuries from sea urchins. After finishing all task, you need to choose clothes in which she will be look amazing for the night party, where she will met with her love.

title: Anti-Terror Strike
description: Anti-Terror Strike is a new FPS game where your military specialty is rescuing hostages and keeping the neighborhood safe and clean from all lethal threats, regardless their origin whether is domestic or foreign. Join the special military forces and try to rescue your city by eliminating all enemies and defending the invaded houses. There are four mission to complete where there are lot of weapons, guns, enemies and shooting fun. Buy armor upgrades, refill the gun bullets as often as you can, sneak into the darkness to ambush and neutralize your target and try to keep your town to be Anti-Terror free.Good luck soldier and keep up your Strike high!

title: Princess in Prom Night
description: Princess Ariel, Princess Rapunzel, and Princess Moana are going to attend a prom night. Since it is their first time to attend such event, they're very excited to do shopping for their prom. Help them select a prom outfit that will make them look more stunning.

title: Star Fighter 3D
description: Join the airborne forces of Star Fighter world! Fly into intense dogfight war where the most experience jet pilots are competing to survive. Your only action is to survive as long as possible by eliminating enemy planes and earnings tons of points. Countless waves of hundreds of enemy planes will burst towards you, trying to destroy you as fast as possible. So improve your flying maneuvers, shoot down enemy planes, and good luck becoming the bet Star Fighter from all new airplane games!

title: Evil Money
description: If you want to see your computer again, you have to pay a ransom of 1 000 000. So due to this blackmail, you are forced to become a thief, who will steal the money to pay the ransom. But you need to be careful, because if you are caught you will end in jail. So steal the money, don't let to be caught, get away in the car and you will reach the next level.

title: Pou Wedding Preparation
description: Pou will be having her one of the most wonderful moments of her life, her wedding! Give her a nice makeover and choose the best wedding gown and accessories for her to be the most beautiful bride on her special day.

title: Monster Truck Soccer
description: Monster Truck Soccer is a fun arcade game that combines two awesome genres – Monster truck racing and soccer! Drive your monster truck and try to score goals against your opponent! You must attempt to control the ball and score as many goals as possible in the given match time!

title: Alice Jump
description: The little girl Alice likes running and jumping. In this sport game Alice Jump, your job is to help Alice jump higher and reach the porker cards. Move your mouse and click to jump. Jump over the porker cards to collect points. Alice can jump higher with the poker as her supporting point. The springs will increase her power of jumping.

title: Aliens Invasion
description: Aliens Invasion is an adrenaline pumping first person shooting game that will test your shooting skills to the highest level! Survive from the waves of aliens that will attack and shoot you in any possible way. Defend yourself and don't let them kill you. Use any weapons that will help you eliminate these unearthly creatures. Challenge yourself by completing all the achievements and be one from the list of high scores! So are you ready for some action?!

title: Valentine's Day Mix Match Dating
description: Happy Valentine's Day! Disney princess Moana, Anna and Elsa are going to celebrate valentine's day! Of course! They have some special plans for this Valentine's day. yes! They are going to interchange their boy friends for this valentine's day dating. So,Help them to choose their boyfriends and give the suitable makeup and outfits for this Valentin's Day!

title: Watermelon Arrow Scatter
description: Watermelon Arrow Scatter is a tricky arrow shooting game where the goal is shoot all the watermelons using the given number of bows. Be a sharp-shooter and don't waste your arrows.

title: Ultimate TicTacToe
description: Tired of the same TicTacToe game? Well if you want a greater challenge and a new way of doing the regular then this game is for you. The Ultimate TicTacToe will give you not just the regular 3x3 but also 5x5 and 7x7. In these new grids your objective is to make 4 matches. And the best part of this game is that you can play it with your friends! Compete with them and be in the high score list!

title: Tripeaks Solitaire
description: Tripeaks Soiltaire is a new take on solitaire game. Your goal is to clear the all card in the board. Click the card that has a rank higher or lower than the card in hand, regardless of the suit. The faster you finish the higher the score. So what are you waiting for? Try the new solitaire now!

title: Christmas Balloons
description: Christmas balloons is a game where you will be given a certain numbers of balloon for you to pop. Pop as many balloons as you can and beat your last highest score.

title: Tetris Cube
description: Tetris Cube is a highly addictive 3D tetris game. Make order out of chaos, arrange the blocks and destroy the layers perfectly by using one piece. How far can you go? How high can you reach? Play it now and have your name in the leaderboard!

title: Carnival Ducks
description: Welcome in this carnival shooting game, where you need to shoot as many requested ducks and fish as you can and get more points on your account. Only avoid the ducks which bring white flag, because if you shoot them you lose the points.

title: Cyclops Ruins
description: Play as a hero who needs to avoid incoming rocks, thrown by a might Cyclops from the Cyclops Ruins game. Every avoided the falling stone is a an extra coin for you, which are also awarded as bonus points. Collect the shield and healing beverages, so you would last long in this action avoiding game.

title: Fat Boy Dream
description: This fat boy is dreaming his big sweet temptation. You need to keep him longer in his dream till the end of the level, by jumping on donuts and reaching the sky.

title: Swipe Basketball
description: Swipe the ball and get it in the hoop. Try to get the star for bonus points and don't miss a hoop or else you'll lose a life. Have fun and enjoy!

title: Super Cowboy Run
description: See that cowboy run! There's no stopping him not even wild dogs, trolls, skeletons and even bombs! Play this addicting running game Super Cowboy Run and see how far you can go!

title: Speed Racer
description: Speed Racer is all about being cautious in driving too fast. The race will take place in an oval track and after passing with the other racer which is driving in the opposite side, the speed will increase little by little. You need to be careful with swerving or else you might crash to the other car. Take the challenge or compete with your friends in a two player mode!

title: Fish N Jump
description: Throw the falling fishes in the anemone by bouncing them on the starfish and reach the target of every level.

title: Bad Teeth Makeover
description: Today we are going to introduce you an extremely beautiful girl who has a big problem: her teeth aren't in the best shape, so she has decided to contact you, her super talented personal dentist and ask you to help her out a bit! Our brand new 'Bad Teeth Makeover' game will start with a short visit at the dentist (you), because only him can help us and remove the calculus deposits from the teeth. Once the teeth cleaning session is complete, you get to deal with the whitening session! Apply two chic braces, as well, so she can have not only a bright smile but also a perfect teeth! Remove them one year later and then create the best make up look and choose the chicest outfit she needs to accessorize her celebrity smile up with! Have a great time, girls!

title: Fishing Frenzy
description: Fishing Frenzy is a very popular game about fishing! You in it to fight for its prey, fish, blow rabid sharks, sea horses, collect starfish, seashells, catch bubbles with bombs, worms, treasure, watches and gifts! You have to collect everything in this game as possible as you can! Dial your top score and be top player in this sea battle! Tap on the buttons or arrow keys to move and fishing.

title: Stranger Things Squad
description: Gather up Stranger Things fans! We might have a situation here and it requires your expert advice. It’s not a new supernatural event, not even a trip to the Upside Down world but a challenging dress up task.... and you’ll love it! Are you ready to help Eleven and four playful lads to prepare for their new adventure in search for Will? Then get the ‘Stranger Things Squad’ dress up game for girls and see what comfy chic looks you can put together for each of them. Choose the character you want to begin the given task with and then start mixing and matching different clothing items and accessories into 80’s inspired looks but with a modern twist. Enjoy!

title: Bike Trials: Wasteland
description: Try to survive this motor tour in the wasteland, as a pro motorbike rider, you need to be capable of conquering every course. You must maintain balance while accelerating over tires, concrete barriers, and other obstacles. Your ride depends only on you and how skilled you are in this extreme motorbike racing challenge. You have to be careful and always maintain your balance in order not to crash, or you will have to restart the last checkpoint or the level all over again.

title: Snake and Blocks
description: Get your thinking caps ready because we're gonna take this snake game in a new level. Snake and Blocks is a new take on the classic game snakes. In this game, your mission is to go as far as you can. You need to collect all those balls which will add up in your snake's length. You need your snake to be longer so you can go through the blocks. The number of balls in your snake should be greater than the number indicated on the block because after passing though it your snake's ball will be deducted by the number indicated on the block. It's highly addictive, enjoyable and mind enhancing!

title: Neon Pong
description: Neon Pong is not just your typical game because aside of the classic mode it has this boosted mode which separates it from the other ping pong games! We all know how classic ping pong works but in Neon Pong boosted mode the ball has its own mind and there are things that will pop out that will make your game more interesting. Unpredictable and challenging! And for sure addictively enjoyable!

title: Mastermind
description: Mastermind is not just an ordinary guessing game. It's something that will test your deductive skills. In this game you'll have to find the exact position of the colored balls in the sequence. Each ball can only be used once and you'll have limited attempts so think carefully. After placing all the balls the Mastermind will respond to you by saying if you got the correct colors (gray ball) and which colored ball is in the correct position (black ball). To get the correct answer you'll have to base it all to Mastermind's clue. Guess the sequence in the least amount of attempt and you'll get higher score!

title: Bob's Burgers
description: This family owns a hamburger restaurant. We represent the family in full composition: Bob, Linda and their children Tina, Gene, and Louise. Your job in this game is to take care for their look and choose the clothes for their work day in their family restaurant.

title: Happy Dessert
description: Hire the best chef, research your delicious recipe, and don't forget to prepare the ingredients you need.

title: Goose Game
description: The Goose Game is a classic and a very famous game. Take your turn by throwing the dice. Your fate is decided on your dice throwing skills because you'll never know which square you'll land!

title: The Gold Miner
description: Dig for gold before the time runs out! The bigger the gold the greater the value. Jewels' price is more valuable than gold so you better choose which one you'll need to reach the quota just remember to avoid those dynamites!

title: Miley Cyrus World Tour
description: Miley Cyrus is going on a world tour. Get her tattoos and hair done by following each step. Also, decide on what outfit she'll going to wear for each country that she'll be performing.

title: Four Colors
description: Four Colors is a fun card game which is all about getting rid of all your cards at hand. Match the card by colors or numbers to get rid of them. The first one who got all their cards gone is the winner!

title: Kwiki Soccer
description: Kwiki Soccer is a sport based physics game where the only goal, is to score a goal. Featuring a football cup, practice mode, and a local multiplayer soccer match where up to four players can play at once, Kwiki Soccer is a fun game to play a one button based soccer match. Choose your soccer representation, improve your game skills, join the cup and good luck winning the golden trophy!

title: Battleship War
description: Battleship War is a web based game adopted from the famous strategy game Battleship. You have to guess where your enemy ships are hiding. It's a search and destroy kind of game that will put your deductive skills to the test!

title: Tap My Water
description: Help the little plumber connect the pipes and try to score as many points as possible in this challenging puzzle game! Create a path from the tap to the end piece and watch the water flow. Green pipes can be rotated, yellow ones swapped and red pipes can't be moved at all. Be quick as your time is limited and try to clear as many levels as you can!

title: Fliptris
description: Create squares of blocks by moving the pieces to the side of the world to flip the world around.

title: Frozen Figure Skating
description: Choose the best outfits for the Frozen couples and prepare for their skating performance.

title: Winter Snow Fairy Day
description: Dress up this beautiful Winter Snow Fairy with these winter-themed outfits. Also, do some makeover for her and match it with her outfit. Enjoy!

title: White Water Rush
description: White Water Rush is all about kayak racing down on a rocky river. Collect all the gold coins. Finish all the race in first place so you'll unlock all the characters and the tracks! Accomplish all the achievements and be one of the high scorers. Play solo or compete with friends!

title: Snow Storm WebGL
description: Snow Storm is a 3D snowmobile race. Race through a slippery snowy terrain. Collect coins and speed boosters. Avoid those annoying stop signs that will destroy your vehicle's engine making you lose the race. Play solo or with friends in multiplayer mode.

title: Park of Horrors
description: Grab a gun and survive in the Park of Horror shooting game! Time: midnight, date and locations both unknown. What is known that hordes of zombies, and vivid ghosts, will puck your fear for life, so the only thing to do, is to survive as long as you can. Good luck!

title: The Saboteur
description: The Saboteur is a game where only the finest soldier can survive! Survive the waves of enemy soldier coming to your base. You have limited ammo, grenades, weapons and med kits so use it wisely. How long can you stay alive?

title: Relaxicon

title: Master Checkers
description:
Master Checkers brings the classic board game of checkers to a smooth and easy-to-play online experience. This timeless strategy game is simple to understand but offers deep gameplay for players who enjoy thinking ahead and planning their moves carefully. Each match becomes a test of logic, patience, and positioning as you try to outsmart your opponent on the board.
The game is played on a traditional checkers board where each player starts with the same number of pieces placed on opposite sides. Players take turns moving their pieces diagonally across the board, aiming to capture opponent pieces by jumping over them. If a capture move is available, it must be taken, which adds an important layer of strategy to every turn and forces players to stay alert.
The main objective in Master Checkers is to remove all of your opponent’s pieces or block them so they have no legal moves left. Achieving this requires careful planning. One wrong move can open up opportunities for your opponent, while a well-placed piece can control large sections of the board. Success often comes from balancing offense and defense and thinking several steps ahead.
As pieces advance across the board, reaching the far side gives them an important upgrade. These upgraded pieces gain the ability to move both forward and backward diagonally, allowing for greater flexibility and stronger control. This change can dramatically shift the balance of the game and plays a major role in the later stages of a match. Protecting these advanced pieces while trying to limit your opponent’s movement becomes a key part of winning.
Master Checkers allows players to take their time and think through each move. There is no pressure to rush, making the game relaxing while still mentally engaging. Every match feels different because strategies change depending on how your opponent reacts, encouraging creative thinking and adaptation.
The clean board layout and clear visuals make it easy to follow the action and focus on strategy. Moves are smooth, rules are straightforward, and the overall design keeps distractions to a minimum. This makes Master Checkers accessible for new players while still offering depth for those who enjoy refining tactics and improving their skills.
Whether you are practicing strategy, enjoying a classic board game, or looking for a thoughtful challenge, Master Checkers delivers a satisfying experience. With simple rules, strategic depth, and endless replay value, it remains a great choice for players who enjoy classic checkers gameplay and smart decision-making.

title: Snake And Ladders
description:
Snake and Ladders is a classic board game brought to life with simple gameplay and cheerful visuals. The objective is straightforward. Roll the dice and move your piece from the start of the board to the final square before the other players. Along the way, ladders help you move ahead faster, while snakes can send you backward, creating surprise and excitement in every match.
The game offers two visual game modes, both following the same automatic gameplay rules. In both modes, players roll the dice on their turn and the characters move automatically across the board based on the dice result. There is no manual movement, keeping the experience easy and relaxing for everyone.
One mode features cartoon-style characters and a colorful board, designed to feel playful and fun. This version is especially appealing for kids, with bright characters and clear animations that make it easy to follow the action. The lively presentation adds charm to every dice roll and ladder climb.
The second mode uses a paper-style board design, inspired by the traditional look of the classic Snake and Ladders game. While the appearance is simpler and more traditional, the gameplay remains the same. Dice rolls, snakes, and ladders all work automatically, just like in the cartoon mode.
Snake and Ladders supports multiple players, allowing you to choose how many participants join the game. You can play with two up to six players on the same device. Each player is represented clearly on the board, making it easy to see turns, positions, and progress toward the finish.
Because the game is based on chance, every round feels different. A single dice roll can change everything, whether it sends you climbing a ladder or sliding down a snake. This unpredictability keeps matches exciting and encourages replay.
The simple rules and automatic movement make Snake and Ladders accessible for all ages. There is no need for fast reactions or complex controls, making it ideal for casual play with friends or family.
If you enjoy classic board games with colorful presentation, multiple player options, and easy gameplay, Snake and Ladders offers a timeless and enjoyable experience that is fun every time you roll the dice.

description: Mall Dash is a 3D racing game of remote controlled cars inside the mall. Go through the cinemas, food courts and into different stores. It's a very fun racing game in a very unique setting. Play solo and unlock different cars and tracks by winning races or compete with friends and other players online in multiplayer mode.  Unlock all the achievements and be in the leaderboard!

title: Bloody Zombie Cup
description: Stuck inside the football stadium and under attack of waves of zombies, your goal is to grab weapons and ammo and be ready for facing the zombies that come along your way. This is not the league of champions, this is the league of zombie kills!

title: Alien Warfare
description: Planet Earth has been invaded by hostile aliens that want to take over the world. Your area has already been seized by them and you're the only one left. Your mission is to stay alive as long as you can and kill all those aliens together with their humongous bosses. Make use of the weapons and med kits that were scattered all over the terrain. Destroy them all and live as if it was your last day on Earth!

title: Dead Lab 2
description: Dead Lab is an 3D horror game with a creepy zombie-monsters apocalyptic story about a man who wakes only to find himself as the last survivor in an infected laboratory. Your main mission is to survive and clean that laboratory from the monsters which are more numerous in each next wave.

title: Rescue Six
description: Rescue the hostages in house from the terrorist. Your responsibility is to make sure that the house and the neighborhood is clean from terrorists which hold the residents as hostages. So, use all the weapons and ammo which are available and end your mission by freeing all the hostages.

title: Sector 7
description: You are stacked in Sector 7 and you need to handle with the zombies, monsters and spiders which are around you. Try to you master every attack and stay alive, how you can continue cleaning Sector 7 from this evil forces. Good luck!

title: Attack of Alien Mutants
description: Alien mutants are about to conquer the Earth and your mission is to destroy their base. Kill all those extraterrestrial monsters and save our planet! You'll be rewarded with cash on every alien that you will obliterate. You can use that money to buy yourself  bigger and better weapon. Unlock all the achievements and head your way to the top score!

title: Attack of Alien Mutants 2
description: After clearing your area from those dreaded alien mutants, you found out that they have taken over the city! Knowing you're the only hope of humanity, with a simple gun in your hand, you head up to the city not knowing what the outcome will be. Your only mission is to destroy the alien's mothership! It will be one hell of a fight and you're not the one who's gonna back down! Play Attack of Alien Mutants 2 and experience how to obliterate those alien scums!

title: Bartender The Celeb Mix
description: Another installment of the hit series Bartender Mix! Now our pretty suave bartender Miguel will be working in a 5 star hotel bar. Can you help him make the perfect mix for his picky costumers? Or will you make his career flushed in the drain? Mix and match the drinks the make that ultimate cocktail that your costumers will die for!

title: Cute Cake Baker
description: Be a great Pastry Chef in Cute Cake Baker! Bake your own cake whether it's a round or square  layer cake. Put some colorful icing and cute little toppers. Take a screenshot of your creations and share it with your friends and other players of the game.

title: Fun Lip Care
description: Sarah got her lips infected after getting some lip fillers! You better remove all the pus and treat her lips before it becomes worse. Do whatever you can to help her and give back her self-esteem. After the surgery give her a make over that will compliment her brand new lips!

title: Fortnite Dress Up
description: Fortnite is a battle royal where our characters needs our help to be dressed up. Choose among the four jobs and get your gears for preparation on the battle.

title: Kawaii Cake
description: A cute cake wants to become a delicious and more cute. Choose among the choices provided and select what is best. Let's see how it looks like after the process.

title: Knee Surgery Simulator
description: Poor Sarah is experiencing so much pain because of her Knee Osteoarthritis! Medication and other treatment won't work anymore so her only chance is surgery. In this surgery you will completely replace the knee joint so it will prevent the bone to bone friction which causes her tremendous pain! Perform the surgery perfectly and successfully. After that, dress up Sarah in a festive clothes to celebrate her recovery!

title: Hearty Chocolate Cake
description: Do you ever wonder how they make those cake that when you slice it, you'll see a heart inside. Well it's one of the artistry of baking and in this game you'll bake your very own Hearty Chocolate Cake! Decorate it with fun and colorful icing and toppers! Share your creations with your friends and to all the players of this game.

title: Princess Silver Hair
description: The silver hair trend has been everywhere this year and recently it landed to the great fantasy land where skillful Rapunzel is going to try it on three of her famous Disney girls. Elsa, Tiana and Belle will be trying some of Rapunzel’s 20 shades of grey and you are invited to lend a helping hand. Play this brand new hair game for girls called Princess Silver Hair and help Rapunzel design some jaw-dropping, trendy hairstyles for her friends. Pick the princess you want to begin the hair transformation with and then start preparing the magical mix which is going to turn her hair grey. Wash out the hair dye, dry her hair and then continue by highlighting the roots and ends in different colors: you can select from different shades of grey, blue, purple and green. When you’re satisfied with the look of your client’s hair you can then go on and choose a cool outfit as well and some accessories, too. Great job, ladies! Now don’t forget to also create some stunning silver hair looks for the other two Disney girls eagerly waiting for a change. Have a great time and feel free to share your creation in a comment below. Have fun!

title: Star Mission
description: Wander around a complex maze, filled with mutated aliens and traps, all located inside a big galactic spaceship. Grab a pistol, shotgun, and some bombs, and head on surviving throughout Star Mission. Have fun!

title: ColorCube
description: ColorCube is about being fast. Rotate the cube until it is the same colour as the wall in front of it. If you are bored and looking for an addicting game, then this is it! Its easy to compete against other players just login. And remember to have fun!

title: Potty Train Baby Elsa
description: Baby Elsa is a big girl now and her mom wants her to start behaving like a like. She’s too old for diapers so your main task while playing DressUpWho’s brand-new Frozen Game is to guide Elsa though the potty training process. But first of all, let’s find a couple of things you might need for Elsa’s training session. Using your magnifying glass spot the potty, the toilet paper, baby Elsa’s favorite book, the soap and a soft towel. Great job, ladies. Now step by step teach her how to use the potty and then make sure you also teach her a valuable hygiene lesson. Wonderful, now could you help her select a colourful outfit to wear today? Have a great time playing the ‘Baby Elsa’s Potty Train’ game for girls!

title: Masked Shooters: Assault
description: Masked Shooters Assault is a fun multiplayer first person shooter game. Join the room, or create your own, and play with your friends. You can choose from three maps that represent different game modes.You can kill in an abandoned factory, or in an arena where you can effectively cover, or shoot on enemies from high towers. You can choose from two basic modes of play. First one is FFA, there are no rules and everyone is against each other and the second one is the classic mode of two teams that fight each other. So do not be afraid to try something new, with great graphics and lots of fun. Enjoy the game.

title: Save or Die
description: You have a mission to rescue 15 hostages, which are in a difference cottages, guarded by enemy guards. You need to reach in each cottage and release every hostage who will find in that cottage. Buy new weapon or heal from the weapon shop when you have enough money. Good luck!

title: Pixel Rally 3D
description: Push the pedal to the metal and go as fast as possible to win this exciting rally. Win the track and earn money who can use for upgrade your car, how you can get more wins in rally.

title: College of Monsters
description: Attend the College of Monsters where you will study how to eliminate monsters in various ways of shooting mastery. Headshot, bomb-blast, shotgun, and even a knife will be your favorite school lessons.

title: Friendly Fish
description: Lead this Friendly Fish to release other fish who are in a bubble, but careful because you way is not clear and safe. You need to avoid the other fish, jelly fish and spikes.

title: Mutant War
description: In a dark apocalyptic city, where no one is around, you have been lurked by various mutated creatures, all anxiously wanted to eat you. Coming out of everywhere, and in every form you can possible imagine, your only hope against the monsters is to grab a gun and shoot your way through their brains!

title: Diet Flappy Bird
description: Diet Flappy Bird is fun html5 flappy bird with a twist. This time you need to take this fun yellow bird home, but on the road there will be a lot of obstacles waiting for you. You need to avoid the poles and the black bird, it will kill you and the game is over. Avoid the food and drink as well, because it will make you bigger but you will have a turbo and fly faster. Click or tap on the left screen to fly and on the right side to use turbo mode. Have fun. On computer use UP arrow key to jump and RIGHT to use turbo boost.

title: Arena of Screaming
description: Welcome to Arena of Screaming, where the undead are coming for your flesh! This survival horror will give you the chills and the creeps as you play along. There are so many abominations, monsters and zombies that will definitely make it more challenging for you on your survival! Unlock all the achievements and try to kill as many as you can because you might end up being in the leaderboard!

title: Toby's Adventures
description:
Toby's Adventures is an HTML5 game for PC, tablet and mobile devices. Collect all the food and reach the door to finish the level. Break bricks, avoid obstacles and enemies on your way.
It's ads free and always will be.

title: Jojo Frog
description: Use mouse to control a green object. Keep frogs out of water, make them jump on island.

title: Air Fighter
description: You are at war, in the Air Force, and you need to show your pilot and shooting skills. As you piloting your aircraft be careful to avoid the enemies projectiles, and try to get down more of opposite planes.

title: Desert of Evil
description: Have you ever heard of the wilderness of evil? Well, here you are, in the Desert of Evil, evil is everywhere around you, epitomized with zombies and monsters which you need to kill all of them. After each wave you have time to refill your ammo and health, and start to kill another wave of evil creatures.

title: Lost City of Dragons
description: Throw the dice and step into the Lost City of Dragons game! Monopoly alike, the objective of this board game is to travel around the globe, buying streets and building hotels onto them. Going to jail, pulling bonus cards, paying fees to the king, and paying overpriced when you stay at your competitor houses, are parts of the game. Collect rents, upgrade your hotels, and have fun traveling around.

title: Hobin Rood
description: Hobin hood is a mouse-skilled shooting game where you need to target an apple in order for you to proceed to the next level. Every time you hit the target, you need to step one foot away from the target. Make sure to sharply target the apple to avoid terminating the game.

title: Safe Haven
description:
You have wandered into the forest and you find that it has been inhabited by a host of vicious bugs and monsters! Luckily there is a safe house in the middle of the forest and you must use this as your safe haven to survive from the hordes of bugs!
Go out into the forest at night and try to fight off the waves of bugs – use whatever weapons you can find! You must continue to survive day after day and gather resources and gold. You can use the items you gather to create new objects and tools to help your survival and provide you a more effective means of fighting the bugs. How long can you survive for against this unwelcome threat? Can you survive in the safe haven?

title: Inversion of Rules
description: Inversion of Rules is a 3D game where you need to conquer every obstacle in order to kill the running person. You need to be very careful when jumping over these obstacles courses because there are some surprise obstacle courses you will encounter. Each level has its own difficulty so have fun playing this exciting 3D game.

title: The Wasteland
description: Try to survive in this Wasteland, where are deadly creatures appear from everywhere and you are all alone. So show desire for life, grab the weapons and collect ammo as much as you can and try to clean this Wasteland and survive this horror.

title: Battle Castle
description: Battle Castle is a survival game in which you are from the future with modern weaponry, who got lost in medieval time! You have been thrown in the arena inside the castle and you have to protect yourself from all the knights that are going to annihilate you! Given just two minutes for every level, you'll have to keep yourself alive until your time is up and you'll go to the next level. You'll be using different kinds of weapon in every stage. Enjoy this survival shooting game and unlock all the achievements and challenge yourself to get into the leaderboard!

title: Survival Arena
description: Survival Arena is a melee combat survival game. You'll be given a melee weapon good for hacking and slashing your opponents. Your only mission is to survive every wave. Each wave, you'll have different weapons that you can add up to your stash. Be mindful of your health and be on the look out for med kits because you'll badly need it for sure!

title: Survive the Night
description: You have 5 minutes before day break with a few ammos left in your hand just one med kit available. You need to get out of your so called safe house because the zombies are  going to get you. Search around the premises for guns, ammos and med kits. Waiting for the sun comes up seems like eternity when you know you probably end up dead anytime.

title: My Little Hair Salon
description: My Little Hair Salon is a fun and interactive game where you'll be able to groom these adorable My little pony characters. Select among these characters and give them a nice hair makeover and an outfit. You can do some mix an' match or have a color theme for the three of them. Enjoy!

description: The adorable beauty Kendall Jenner is getting ready for the party tonight. She decide to design her own shoes with beautiful color and decoration. Could you her to design the awesome shoes for the day?

title: Princess Spa World
description: There is a brand-new spa world opened in the great fantasy-land and the these gorgeous Disney girls can’t wait to relax in onsens from around the world. There’s no wonder why they all rushed to the spa today... they have Jacuzzi, saunas, exotic massages, great facial masks and professional mani-pedi treatments. Care to help Belle, Cinderella, Jasmine and Elsa discover the magic of getting spoiled in the best treatments gathered from around the world? Then let’s play this brand new game for girls called ‘Princess Spa World’ and spoil your favorite Disney girl from head to toes beginning with a short detox session at the sauna, then continuing with facial rejuvenation treatment and ending by giving her toes a professional care. Next you get to dress up your girl in a cute outfit that you can accessorize with the right pair of shoes. Go ahead and discover the other procedures prepared for her friends. Have a great time, ladies!

title: Candy Shooter
description: Candy HTML5 Shooter is a fun candy shooter html5 game that you can play online for free. The aim of the game is to save all candies from getting into the lava. Shoot candies with the bubbles and be aware of the falling lava rocks. Get as many points as possible. Have fun playing.

Hit the play button of the Harley Quinn And Friends game for girls, deal with the very first given task and collect all the achievements. In order to open the first one we have prepared at your disposal in our free to play game for girls, you’ll have to choose some stunning costumes for each character. The first one to discover your great styling skills will be Harley Quinn, of course. Browse thought the wide selection of tops, buttons and dresses available in her wardrobe and select the one you fancy the most to dress her up with. Then look for the best accessories needed to complete her stunning look, do her hair and don’t forget to also deal with her make up look. Great job, ladies! Now let’s see what equally chic look you can put together for her gorgeous friend Poison Ivy. Green is her signature color so we made sure you will find plenty of green clothes in her wardrobe… mix and match your favourite items and come up with a jaw-drooping look. The third cutie pie to join the crew is Catwoman. In this character’s wardrobe you will find a lovely collection of animal printed and black clothes as well as matching accessories, shoes and head wears… feel free to select your favorites. Look girls, the three friends are now ready to haunt the city :)

title: Disney Princess Tandem
description: Come and join your favorite princesses in getting this brand new Disney Dress Up Game for girls started and see what lovely casual-chic outfits you can create for each of them! Make sure to also match each clothing selection with the right accessories and shoes! Have a blast!

title: Yukata Girl
description: Dress up this cute girl in a traditional Yukata, a light kimono, that's always been worn on summer and on some Japanese holidays.

There are different styles for the kameez top available at your disposal in our fun game, so you just have to find the one that looks the best on your pretty model girl. On the next page of our fashion designer game you can choose from a wide variety of playful prints and bold colors the ones you find appropriate for the chosen shirt. Great job, ladies!

description: The Frozen Queen Elsa, the Tangled Princess Rapunzel and beautiful Cinderella are waiting for their favorite fashion adviser to join them in and carefully take care of their amazing looks. They all want some modern looks to flaunt during this lovely summer day so for sure you are going to find it pretty challenging to find the right stylish pieces of clothes and accessories for these sweet blondies. The first in line is surely the beloved Queen Elsa. While dealing with Elsa’s new look, you girls have to make sure you’ll pick a new hairstyle for her, a chic mini-dress and the right heels to complete her modern casual look. Next, you get to work your amazing skills on Rapunzel, the adorable Disney princess who is surely looking for a daring new hairstyle and a more comfy outfit. One of those two colors jumpsuits or a pleated miniskirt and a ruffled top would make a fine choice for princess Rapunzel. Great job, ladies!

description: These colorful clouds are all mixed up! Can you rearrange them in this cute and cuddly match 3 puzzle game? Link them together into groups of three or more to earn a high star rating on each challenging level.

description: The Frozen sisters Elsa and Anna, together with their cousin Rapunzel, have decided to join a surf contest. They all need cute clothes to wear.

But this also introduce some problems that interfere its privilege to the users. However, an army of a mobile phone and its clones from a systematized architecture entitled "Signal Explorer" will help on making data transmission better.

description: Let's wake her up and make her ready. We need to prank her first and wake her up, then we will make her up. Lastly, we choose a nice outfit for her.

description: Four princesses wanted to go out and they need your help with the outfits that best fit for them. Can you help them to pick any dress that can make them more attractive?

description: Karly and her friends went out to play a lovely game of soccer. Unfortunately she had an accident, the ball hit her eye and fell and got splinters all over her body. Treat her wounds and remove all the splinters and put some bandages on it. Make her feel better by dressing her up for the next game of soccer!

title: Traffic Surgery
description: You're an Emergency Medical Technician or EMT. You got three calls for today and all of them are vehicular accidents. A pedestrian who got hit by a car while crossing, a bike rider who just crashed his bike and a car driver whose car collided with another car. They all needed surgery so you need to give all your best to help them. After giving them first aid and a very successful surgery, dress them up to lift their spirit!

title: Canvas Friends
description: Canvas Friends is one of the first games to use a traditional neural network in the context of a game. The algorithm calculates the players artwork and provides a canvas for them to grow the skills while sharing their art. A score is calculated based on how detailed and how cute the art piece looks. Aspects like color and depth play a role in how details are perceived. For cuteness, big eyes and a fun facial expression will go a long way to boost your score.

description: A new generation of FPS game which you can play as campaign or multiplayer against online users. Gear up your avatar and win the different modes by earning a highest score.

description: Perform awesome stunts and combine flips with other exciting tricks! Collect money and spend it on upgrading your car or buy a new one.

title: Peppa Pig: Find The Difference
description: Spot the difference between these two Peppa pig pictures and click on it. After finding all of the differences, you'll be able to proceed to the next round. This game has different pictures in each level so better be alert when choosing. You only have 5 chances so every wrong click on the picture will give you lesser chances to successfully finish the round.

description: The Jenner girls are going to Spa for the lip care treatment. They want to make them lips more pretty and hot. So, Help them to take the lip care treatment smoothly.Have a great Fun!

description: These three princess are our brides in this royal wedding. They must be elegant looking and beautiful as always. Show them the real bride's outfit.

description: These celebrity sisters loved fashion specially when it comes to hairstyles. Pick a hairstyle you want for our spooky theme and dress them up.

Run from one to another end of this stone arena and try to distract the Viking attack.

title: Mayhem Racing
description: There is a long line ahead of you and all the dangerous obstacles.  Get down on the track and try to be as precise as possible in every turn, let it not happen that you are unnecessarily delayed.You can play the game in solo mode or go with your friends from the same keyboard and play it in 2 player mode. Split the screen and split the fun and the adrenaline while you race 4 different cars in 5 intense and awesome 3D track levels. The beautiful levels will take you to the mountains, in the desert, industrial zone and rocky fields.

title: Kids Secrets: Find the Difference
description: Behind these pictures are small differences. Can you find them? They are fun designs for you to play with. A game that is fun and educational because it will help you improve your observation and concentration skills. You have 10 levels and 7 differences, for each level you have one minute to finish the same.

title: Aluminium Foil Ball Maker
description:
This is a famous Japanese challenge that is taking the world by storm - you must use a piece of aluminium foil and carefully squeeze and fold it until you make a perfect shiny ball!
This might sound easy but you must have great patience and keep clicking to find the right sequence of moves. Can you conquer the foil and create the perfect ball?

title: Baby Princess Halloween
description: The baby princesses are really excited for Halloween. They love to go trick-or-treating and this year they want to have the most amazing costumes, so everyone in the kingdom will give them lots of candy. Help these little girls make some hard fashion choices in one of the most adorable dress up games. Combine the clothes and accessories in their wardrobe for a spooky look! When you're done, choose the perfect background and take a lovely picture with the girls!

title: Bonnie Princess & Popstar
description: Bonnie has a lot of talents but mostly she loves to sing. She has been invited to perform to a private party and she can’t wait to go up on the stage and feel like a real popstar. But before stealing the spotlights, Bonnie has to firstly decide on a very important thing: should she put on ones of those gorgeous, floor sweeping princess dresses or should she rather pick a pair of leggings, a tank-top and a really cool leather jacket? Let's see.

title: Frozen Elsa Gives Birth
description: This is the most happy day of Elsa's life because she will have a baby. She feels that she needs to go to a hospital right now but first you should help her with packing. After you arrive the hospital support her while she is giving birth. Once baby is born, give the necessary medical support to the baby.

title: Contranoid
description: Contranoid is the fast-paced chaotic hybrid of Pong, Tetris and Arkanoid that literally pits you against your closest friend as you play against each other on the same device. Players control a paddle to catch balls bouncing back after ravaging the opponent's game field. White must destroy Black and get a ball across, while Black is trying to do the opposite.

title: GravNet
description: GravNet is a Zen puzzle game in which you bend beams into the goal using gravity.

title: Brave Bird
description: Use your mouse or finger to move the bird. Avoid all the wooden crates and collect the coins to unlock new birds. Have fun with BraveBird.

title: Donutosaur 2
description: Donutosaur is here again looking for those yummy donuts ready to be devoured! Solve all the new sets of challenging puzzles and collect stars for that added bonus!

Now, you can play as one of them, as you are forced to juggle making sure the hero gets what they need, with making sure you make enough money to pay the King's unfair taxes.

title: Cherry
description: Apocalypse is here; everything has perished. The only survivor is Cherry. Take her as far as you can.

title: Color Rush - Fischne
description:
Guitar hero like color matching game.
There are 3 main colors for press. For each main color you should press same color. And for example if orange is coming you should press red and yellow together.

title: Kitty Sick Care and Grooming
description: Help this poor kitty who has been sick lately. Check her health and cure her wounds immediately. After doing such, dress her up to make her comfortable.

title: Spiders and Deads
description: Spiders and Deads is an exciting shooting game that let's you kill those scary zombies and spiders. Be careful to your surroundings because they can just pop out everywhere.

title: The Ironic Zombie

Even if the adventurer young man doesn’t understand most of what zombie says, he decides to struggle against bad zombies by taking his gun near of him and the adventure begins. On the one hand the mocker zombie can carry the rocks and can throw them because of its strength, on the other hand the adventurer young man kills the evil zombies by using his gun and brain. The result which can be expected from this unity, depends on you…

title: Bavarian Apple Strudel
description: Create this delectable treat, Bavarian Apple Strudel! Follow the directions and when you complete it as early as possible, you'll get bonus points!

They led a bored mode of life with no pleasures of life under the cover of the darkness in puzzle games online. One day the trio of vampires got bored and one was hit with upon an excellent idea. He inspired his vampire-mates to have parties in their castle. Only three was not enough for hangouts, they decided to gather people from the town in puzzle games online. Help the trio to turn townspeople into the vampires because of the party dress code.

title: My Dreamy Car Makeover
description: My Car Makeover! It's your first car and it was covered in mud. Time to clean that car and get it looking great again. You want to take care of your ride, so everyone knows your social and economic status in life. I'm kidding, though it is good to take care of your car so it will last a long time.

title: Dream House Designer
description: Be the designer of your own home by choosing among these adorable house designs. You also get to design the inner part of the house. Have fun playing this game!

title: Moto Trials Beach
description: Test your motorcycle driving skill with this all-new 3D trials quad bike game. Reach the end of the game without crashing but if you crash, there's a checkpoint so you don't need to start all over again.

title: Baby Care New Year Look
description: Help these beautiful mommy and her baby prepare for the New Year's eve. Make them look stunning among the crowd with these elegant dresses and accessories that will surely fit them both. Enjoy playing this game here at Y8.com!

title: Tropic Adventure
description:
You were captured by an unknown tribe! Escape and run for your life!
You must avoid obstacles and crazy animals, fight enemies on your way and collect as much money as possible to buy new wacky characters; Enjoy!

title: Christmas Connect
description: Match 3 or more of the same colored Christmas Ornaments to make new ornaments. Earn as many points as possible before time runs out. Connect as many as possible. Have fun playing this game here at Y8.com!

title: Shoot N Scroll 3D
description: Pick your favorite aircraft and shoot your way in this local multiplayer game of top-down shooting fun! Featuring game campaign with 10 challenging missions, the objective in Shoot N Scroll is to take down enemy planes while utilizing your machine gun and special bomb launcher. Play single player, or enjoy in 2 player more and even 3 players adventure!

title: Ashley Face Care Treatment
description: All of us wants to have a clear, smooth skin. Well, in Ashley's case, it's kinda difficult to achieve since she has lots of bumps and wounds on her face. Can you help her with her problem?

title: Masked Forces: Zombie Survival
description:
The action packed game Masked Forces, now has a sequel! Your main goal is to eliminate the zombies and survive as long as possible, wave after wave using all necessary weapons. You have an online game mode that you can use to show your potential. With Masked Forces: Zombie Survival, you test your shooting mechanics and enjoy a unique and frightening experience.
Like the previous game, you can find included in the game, an armor shop / weapon and numerous improvements for a better experience of survival. If you are a fan of action games and zombies or just want to enjoy an immersive and exciting gaming experience, you will be impressed by Masked Forces: Zombie Survival!

title: LOL :)
description: LOL Game - Play around, make some funny faces and try not to laugh.

title: Summer Patchwork
description: One beautiful Disney princess, the Fairest of Them All, is now ready to order her very first designer dress. Her name is Snow White and we all know her from the famous Snow White And The Seven Dwarfs story. Well girls, it seems that Snow White’s satin blue and yellow dress got all messed up while our beloved princess was picking the apples so she would love something new as adorable as the previous was. The only thing she would change is the fabric and this time she would love to try the playful patchwork patterns. As her personal designer, will be your task to come up with the right top for our cutie pie and the right skirt to pair the upper part. Dare to propose her a different type of blouse with long sleeves, bows or bodiced tops beautifully adorned with buttons and once the main decision was taken, you can go to the next page of the game and choose some bright shades for it or even some playful patterns. Then, for the skirt you have two options: the block style skirt and the pinwheel skirt, so just take a closer look and decide which one fits. Cover it in your favorite colors and prints and once you’re done with your work you can accessories it with a new hairstyle, shoes and mind-blowing jewelries. Have a great time playing the ‘Summer Patchwork’ game!

title: Paper Battle
description: Paper Battle is a snake like game that allows you to play with a lot of other players. Your goal is to gain more surface by closing your area. You can kill your opponent by touching their tails or stealing their surface by enclosing their area. Just remember not to touch your own tail or let your opponent touch it and stay away from the playfield border!

title: Ella Ice Skating
description: Ella got wounds and need to threat immediately. Help Ella until she heals and fully recover and dress her up to look more pretty.

title: Me Alone 2
description: In "Me Alone 2" you are awakened by strange noises and discover that the world is infested with zombies ... Take a pistol and try to survive on story or survival mode. Enjoy!

title: Warrior vs Zombies
description: Warrior vs Zombies is an exciting 3D game that let's the player fight against these scary zombies. Be very alert when attacking the zombies because they come in group! When you're running out of lives, collect some health potion or run as far as you can to regenerate your life. Have fun and survive the waves!

title: Zebras Connect
description:
This is a classical connect game with 3 special features. You can choose from 8 picture sets, 2 picture sizes and 3 difficulties, so there are 8 x 2 x 3 = 48 challenges. Each challenge has 13 levels, 10 have basic and 3 have special moving styles.
You can remove 2 tiles by clicking on them, if they have the same pictures and can be connected by a line with max. 2 breaks.
To finish the level, you have to remove all the pictures from the gamefield within the given time.
If you can't connect more tiles, press the shuffle button, which will mix the pictures.
Enjoy the game and have fun!

title: School Braided Hairstyles
description: This young lady loves styling her hair. She needs your help in selecting a hairstyle that will fit her outfit for today.

title: Space Lab Survival
description: Your space shuttle has gone out of orbit and you're all alone amongst the undead! For how long can you survive in this hellish place? Defend your self from those creatures that are out to get you. Will you be one in the leaderboard or you'll be the one who's going to unlock all the achievements? Play it now and see how far you'll go!

title: Drive Your Car
description: Drive Your Car is a HTML5 running game. Your aim is to drive your sports car avoiding the other vehicles as long as possible, each crash costs you a life (you have three lives by default). The game has an unique level that gradually becomes more and more difficult.

title: Bionic Race
description: Fly and run and avoid the steams and gears at Bionic Race. Collect all the coins and go as far as you can and be at the leaderboard.

title: Burger Time
description: It's Burger Time! Make burgers according to what the costumers want. Arrange the ingredients correctly and serve it as fast as you can so your costumers won't get mad and they'll give you some tip at the end.

title: Rapunzel Wedding Dress Designer
description: Rapunzel is a famous wedding dress designer, today, she has two customers, Elsa and Anna. Elsa and Jack Frost, Anna and Kristoff will hold a double wedding next month, now, the sisters come to Rapunzel's studio to customize wedding dresses. You are Rapunzel assistant, come to show your fashion talent, to help Rapunzel design the most beautiful wedding dresses for the two brides.

title: Zombie Exterminators MP
description: Team up in a multiplayer shooting battle against the living undead. Zombie Exterminators is a new 3D shooting game where you use pistols, guns, shotguns and snipers, as you battle against hordes of incoming dead.

title: Frog Rush
description: You are an elite scientist working at a secret lab! It wasn't your fault that the spill happened and contaminated the local lake with toxic chemicals, and made all the frogs into killer amphibians! OK maybe it was but we all have our off days. But now you need to solve the problem and DESTROY ALL FROGS. You can do this by drip feeding the frogs some precious "Chemical K". The frogs love this and grow larger with each drop until fully primed and "SPLURGE!" they explode shooting lethal frog blood all over the place. Any frog hit, if primed, will explode too so you need to ensure the perfect chain reaction using the tiny amount of Chemical K you have available.

title: Jewel Duel
description:
Jewel Duel is a superb crossover game that combines match-three gameplay together with RPG battle elements. Before you start playing, you can choose to fight as a Warrior, an Assassin or a Wizard. Each character type has different moves, appearance and weapons. To make your character fight, you must play the match-three puzzles. Each time you successfully match three symbols together, your character will perform an attack – simple!
Try to make big combinations and clear as many symbols as possible in one move. The more you clear, the greater your attack damage will be! As you slay different enemies, your character will level up and you can allocate skill points to improve their statistics – this in turn will allow you to take on more difficult monsters and enemies! You can also spend the gold you collect to purchase new weapons and armor! Start dueling today and guide your character to glory!

title: Car Speed Booster
description: Car Speed Booster is a vertical runner game. Beware of other incoming cars and collect as many coins as you can.

title: Boulder Crash
description: This is a Atari Boulder Dash clone with a classic retro feel. The levels are unique.

title: Bike Rider 2: Armageddon
description: In Bike Rider 2 Armageddon race to champion status by using speed, strategy, and brute force. Knock your opposites off their motorcycles for the ultimate advantage in this adrenaline fueled bike racing game. Win races to unlock new hogs in your mission for glory in the leader boards.

title: Devrim Racing 3D
description:
Each race included in the pages are different than each other. All six races are different types. In a page, you will often see the race types:
Circuit,Sprint,Drift,Lap Knockout,Elimination,Speed Trap.
Of course, all these levels and race types could not be playes with a single car. 10 different race cars are waiting for you in Devrim Racing. Not only the visuals are different but also the acceleration, brakes, handlings, and weights are different… In short, these cars are completely different than each other. Design, performance, and sounds of the cars are based on the real cars. Though, we may have favoured Devrim car in terms of performance. :) 
You can upgrade the visuals and performance of your car in Devrim Racing.

title: Rise Up
description: Rise Up is a never ending running game and the only thing that you have to do is to go up! As you gain level the speed increases which makes it harder and harder to continue. How far can you go?

title: Domino Block
description: You can challenge up to three virtual opponents in this online version of the classic game. Strategically place your dominoes on the table and find out if you can beat them.

title: Pottery Store
