description: Felicia has just opened a pottery painting shop. During her school vacation, she molded a lot of variety of pots in different shapes. You have to help her paint the pots as the customers demand and pack and sell it to them. Buy new pots, designs and upgrades your shop whenever you want.

title: 3D Parking Bridge
description: Your mission in this game is to take the car drive through the narrow streets and try to park it in the highlighted spots. Have an incredible time playing this awesome game!

title: Brick Out
description: The aim of the game is to destroy all the bricks and collect any falling power-ups to move to the next level.

title: Space Purge
description: Protect the Earth from asteroids and small planets as long as possible! Use your mouse to move and shooting. In each level you have of ammo which increases the number of hits, get the extra score and ammo at the end of the level.

title: BFF Spring Fashion Show 2018
description: Choose one of the Disney's princess for this spring fashion show, let her fit into amazing makeup and dress up and let's she will win the title or not.

title: Timber Guy
description: Chop off as many logs from the tree as you can. You have to be quick but watch out for approaching branches! Switch your position to avoid danger and continue cutting. Keep tapping left or right part of screen to chop on that side.

title: Princess Mix
description: To make princess more beautiful looking, we need to to do makeover on her face. Create a disney princess look by selecting the proper makeover and facial features for your desired character. Have fun playing this Princess Face Mix game!

title: Water Scooter Mania 2 : Riptide
description: Choose from a variety of different scooter models and tracks. During each race, there are several exciting jumps and also a nitro tube power-up that provides a speed boost. You can play against AI opponents in single player mode, or you can test your skills against other online players! Do you feel like conquering the waves? If so, check out Water Scooter Mania today!

title: Radical Assault
description: You will engaging a place that full of terrorists. Inside here, you will collect all the money and survive against the attackers each wave. Collect the med kit, ammo, and other power ups to survive longer. Explore all places to find a bunch of money.

title: Kardashians Graduation
description: Try to keep up with the most famous graduation of the year! Four gorgeous reality stars of the notorious Kardashian clan are now getting ready for their graduation day and it seems that you have been chosen to deal with their amazing looks. Do you think you have what it takes to style up Kim Kardashian, Khloe Kardashian, Kylie Jenner and Kendall Jenner? Prove your skills while playing our brand new dress up game for girls called Kardashians Graduation! The first girl you’re going to style up today is the one and only Kim Kardashian. Now we all know that this gorgeous diva’s wardrobe is ruled by body-fitting dresses, high heels and diamond jewelries… so feel free to take a look, mix and match them and select your favorite combo to dress her up with. Wrap Khloe’s killer body in a sheer dress or choose a hot looking one with cutouts and accessorize your selection with high heels and with a statement necklace. When it comes to dressing up Kendall… you can choose literally anything you want ‘cause any dress you pick will you perfect on her supermodel body. Don’t forget about Kylie! She’s the fourth in line in our dress up marathon and she also needs a jaw-dropping look for this event. When you’re done choosing their dresses and jewelries, go ahead and complete their graduation looks with colorful academic dresses, matching graduate caps, personalized academic scarves, with diplomas and flowers. Have a great time playing the Kardashians Graduation Dress Up Game!

title: Princess Fall Flannels
description: Get ready to discover the best of the best fall flannels in this brand-new dress up game for girls on DressUpWho.com. The Frozen Sisters, Aurora and Moana have their wardrobes ruled by these must have clothing pieces of the fall season and they still need your great fashion advice to properly pair them and turn these plaid shirts into some girly chic outfits in no time. Come and join the girls in getting the ‘Princess Fall Flannels’ dress up game started, browse through their wardrobes and create a fabulous fall look for each of them. Whether you decide to pair your favourite flannel with a tee or to tie it around the waist, feel free to pair it with a ragged pair of jeans or with a lovely pleated mini-skirt, sneakers, fedoras and other accessories you might want to use to complete each look with. Send the stylish princess out in the woods for a walk and make sure to also capture a photo of your work and share it with your friends. Have a great time playing the ‘Princess Fall Flannels’ dress up game for girls!

title: Princess Met Gala 2018
description: Met Gala is happening tonight and these gorgeous Disney Princesses have already started preparing for it. Rapunzel, Ariel, Elsa and Moana are super excited about participating in this glamorous fundraising ball and they could use your expert advice to deal with their statement, red carpet looks. So here is your chance to let your creativity run free and to put together four looks that will help them wow the audience. There are spectacular floor-sweeping gowns available at your disposal in their wardrobe, some of them covered in glitter others adorned with playful prints, there are see-through dresses as well as hot looking mini-dresses for you to choose from. Have them try on all your favorites and don’t stop until you find the right dress for each of them. Once the main decision was taken, go ahead and accessorize their dresses with designer heels, with oversized jewelries, statement hair accessories and with elegant evening clutches. Have a great time dressing up the Disney Princesses for the fashion's biggest night out!

title: Princess Sweater Weather
description: The chilly autumn days are here and that means it’s time to put on your favourite sweater and hit the streets in style. And if you still need some inspiration for the sweater weather, feel free to join four of your favourite Disney princesses in this brand-new dress up game for girls on Dressupwho.com ‘cause they have prepared an impressive collection of super trendy sweaters for you. Princess Rapunzel is a huge fan of knitted sweaters and among her favourites you will find the loveliest off the shoulders blouses ever seen. Find one to dress her up with and pair it with the right plaid shirt, a pair of jeans and with a pair of flat shoes. Princess Merida loves to pair her knitted blouses with turtleneck tops, ragged jeans and knee-tall boots… can you help her find the right mix? Next in line is Princess Cinderella. Find a long sweater to pair her favourite pair of leggings with and then look for a matching pair of high heeled boots as well. Make sure to also look through princess Ariel’s wardrobe as well. You can mix a white shirt with a knitted vest and a lovely mini skirt to create a feminine look to dress her up with. Have a great time playing the ‘Princess Sweater Weather’ dress up game for girls!

title: Iron Suit: Assemble and Flight
description: Iron Suit: Assemble and Flight is an infinite running game that will let you create your very own robot. Collect all the stars on your way and watch out for power ups that can help you boost up your score. Take some awesome screenshots and share it with your friends. Challenge fellow players to beat your high score! Unlock all the achievements to reveal all the hidden pictures.

title: The Mercenaries
description: The Mercenaries is a shooting game. Enemies will chase you down and you must shoot them before they get you. Keep using the firearm to unlock achievements.

title: Extreme Moto Run
description: Rev up your engines and make sure you're in complete gear because this game will give you a sure fire of adrenaline rush! Extreme Moto Run was made for risk takers. So if you got the guts and the skills to do those daredevil and death defying stunts then it's high time you play this game! Unlock all the achievements and complete all the 20 action packed levels. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Battle Tank
description: Take control over a military tank and approach the hostile land filled with devastating bombs and enemy tanks! Accompanied by ally tanks, your objective is to attain victory over the battle by eliminating all enemy tanks. Strategically move across the 3D terrain, aim precisely and shoot fast, otherwise the enemies will ambush you and destroy your tank. Good luck!

title: Arena Zombie City
description: Welcome to Zombie Arena City! Population: living, just you. Dead, hundreds of future you! The waves of zombies are rushing toward protecting their city and keeping the life down to zero. Grab some guns, take the best hiding spots, and see how long can you survive in this zombie survival game!

title: Blood and Meat
description: You need to defend your base, from the waves of angry zombies, which you should not let to pass the red line. So try to aim as precisely as you can, because these zombies are too fast. You need to stop this evil by trying every shot fired should be a hit. Good luck!

title: Y8 Penalty Shootout 2018
description: Aim good an try to score a victory goal in this new Y8 Penalty Shootout 2018 game. Won't be easy to stand against the most experienced goalkeepers in this football cup, and see how many goals can you deliver in this fan penalty kicking game.

title: Combat Zone
description: You're on your own soldier! Your plane just crashed to enemy territory and help won't be coming anytime soon. So it's up to you to survive. Good thing it's dark, use that as an advantage to sneak up on enemy soldiers. It will be an army of soldiers coming your way so better look for some weapons and ammunition around the area. Because a soldier without a weapon is a dead soldier! Play "Combat Zone" now and survive! Unlock all the achievements and kill as many soldier as you can and have your name in the leaderboard!

title: DownHill Rush
description: In front of you, there is an extreme bicycle challenge. Warm up the pedals and reach the finish within the top three positions, in order to complete the current level. For extra help in reaching the finish on time, you can use water battles, baseball bats, and all means necessary to outrace your opponents even if you have to literally eliminate them out of the competition.  Watch over your back, as all these items can be used against you.

title: Kill Them All 5
description: Welcome to the newest chapter of Kill Them All, the fifth edition of killing monsters. In this first person shooter game, your objective is to survive against waves of incoming enemy monsters. Use a pistol and a machine-gun to complete your shooting job, and take down as more enemies as possible.

title: Alien Planet
description: You are given a mission that will test your survival skills. You need to search and destroy the five alien cocoons that are scattered around the area. It will be a hard mission because you are out in the open and a lot of alien soldiers are coming to kill you. Do you have what it takes to finish the mission? Or will you just end up like the others, blasted to smithereens!

title: Alien Aggression
description: Your town is invaded by hostile aliens! You need to destroy all their spaceships so you can put an end to this. Look out for some med kits scattered around the place. Destroy the ships as soon as possible or else your town gets destroyed or you ended up dead!

title: Town of Fear
description: In this town own fear, there are monsters and spider, also soldiers, which on first look, you will hope that they are on your side. But, you are wrong. Everybody come against you, and you need to handle with this Town of Fear. To choose the weapon, press I and inventory will be open, select the weapon which you want with arrow keys.

title: Voxel Tanks 3D
description: Voxel Tanks 3D is a retro arcade tank game that can be played up to 3 players! There are 3 levels in this game and each level has 8 stages. You can either go solo and finish the game or play it with your friends. Watch out for crates because it has bonuses that can give you an edge in the game. Unlock all the achievements while having fun playing this nostalgic yet challenging game!

title: Roof Shootout
description: In this FPS shooting, unity game, you need to clean the roof from the soldiers which are from the opponent tabor. Grab your weapon and bombs who are on the box, and start with the "cleaning". Be fast shoot and find the place for hiding when the waves of enemies will come for you.

title: Cargo Drive
description: Try to reach the finish line as quickly as you can while finishing individual missions. You need to move your cargo to the designated location, earn money and improve your truck. It won’t be easy, so start playing and do everything you can to get as far as possible. Don’t forget to pick your preferred difficulty level.

title: Apocalypse Drive
description: Drive through the bloody streets of the Apocalypse! Multiplayer enhanced game where your objectives are to drive across zombie filled towns, cruising above their bodies, eliminating as more zombies as possible. Armed with a machine gun on the roof, all terrain tires, and an upgraded v12 truck engine, you are about to dive into the swarm of the living dead! Good luck!

title: Pirates Aggression
description: Your island is under attack by hostile pirates! You need to kill 'em all and take down their ship. Survival is the key to this game if you want to win. Be mindful of your health because there are lots of pirates coming your way. You'll earn as you kill so purchase all the weapons that will help you on your survival. Unlock all the achievements and earn a lot of points so you can end up having your name in the leaderboard!

title: Bunker of Monsters
description: Bunker of Monsters is a horror survival game where you have entered a bunker filled with monsters. You have five minutes to survive every bunker and a door will open to a new one. The only goal is to survive! There are weapons and ammunition that are scattered around the bunker, get those! It's a matter of life and death so you better act fast!

title: Robots Arena
description: Survive inside an arena full of AI enemies. Waves of super smart and hi-tech robots are awaiting for you there. Grab a gun or two, try your luck with a wooden bow, use the maximum out of the machine gun, and see how long can you survive in this first person survival game.

title: Silent Sniper
description: You have given five minutes for a killing spree. Get your sniper gun ready and zoom in on those dead walkers and put a bullet in their head if you can. The goal in this game is to kill as many zombies as you can. The further your shot the bigger the score. Body shot is easy but head shot is the best!

title: Medieval Castle Hidden Numbers
description: The numbers have been hidden in the Medieval Castle, try to find all as fast as possible.

title: Wedding Dress Up
description: A fun and complex exotic wedding creator,you can create Indian,Chinese and African wedding dresses and outfits and change even the girls skin color,eyes and hairstyle.Have fun creating unlimited exotic wedding looks!

title: Famous Dress Designer
description: Annie is an famous dress designer and she is participating in a wedding dresses contest,she must design three types of wedding dresses and present them to the judges at the end of the day.Your job is you help Annie design the three dresses an hope to win the contest!

title: Frozen Wedding Ceremony
description: Elsa and Jack are getting married today, but Elsa still hasn't decided on her outfit. But it's ok, her future husband Jack will patiently wait for her at church while she figures out what to wear. So help her pick the perfect wedding gown. It can be white, ivory, pink or ivory, it can be a princess style gown, a mermaid shaped one, a short dress or one full of ruffles. It can be decorated with embroidery, lace, pearls, gems or bows. So many options! And they all look gorgeous on her. When you have decided complete the look with a delicate veil. Finally she will also need some jewelry, so choose a small pair of earrings and a necklace to match. Because all her dress options are strapless, the necklace can be a statement one. Finally pick a fresh bouquet of flowers. Have a wonderful time playing Frozen Wedding Ceremony!

title: Glam Girl Busy Weekend
description: Glam Girl Busy Weekend is a outfit creator game,you can create outfits for different events and location.You you will create casual outfits,party outfits,vacation outfits and many other styles of outfits.Take care of our girls make up and hairstyle and create wonderful fashion outfits.

title: Kendama Battle
description: Kendama is a very popular game,and our princess want to practice and participate in her first kendama contest.In this kendama contest everyone must come with a personalized kendama designed for this contest.There are three types of kendama games and you must help our princess design three different types of kendama games and help her practice for the contest.Have fun playing Princess Kendama Design!

title: Street Dance Fashion
description: These adorable sisters love to dance. They compete in every contest and they always win. This time, the girls are getting ready for a street dance competition and they are a bit worried. They don't know much about street fashion and they are afraid that people will judge their clothes. Can you help these lovely ladies dress up? They need to look really stylish and cool! You can try some casual dresses or ripped jeans and t-shirts. Don't forget the accessories! A hat or a head band can keep the hair in place while the girls are dancing. Make sure the two sisters look amazing for this competition, so they will feel confident. Have fun with the pretty girls in one of the cutest girl games!

title: American Football Challenge
description: American Football Challenge is an interesting online sport game about American football. If you are a football fan, don't miss this game. In this game you need to catch the ball shoot from your opponent. If you catch enough balls, you can pass this levels and get to the next level. Enjoy it!

title: Apples
description: In this matching HTML 5 game your task is to clean the basket, from the apples, by match the colors. Aim, shoot and try to end every 50 levels who are in composition of this game. Shoot fast don't let  the chains of apples fall on you and ended your level  before you.

title: Balloon Paradise
description: Very simple and cute HTML 5 game. The goal is to crushes all the balloons, except the red one! Try to be enough fast to press all other colored balloons before they go upper. Every crushed balloon help you to have a better high-score. Touch or click as fast as you can. Made in Construct 2. Enjoy the game!

title: Dinosaurs World Hidden Eggs
description: Find the hidden dino eggs for a limited time only. You have five levels to accomplish and you're eye skills is needed to finish each level.

title: BFF Spring Beach Holiday
description: Bff Princess girls are getting bore and dull on their regular life. So, they are planning for beach holiday for this weekend in this amazing spring season. Obviously, spring brings blossoms and fun on all of their holiday. Are you interested to dress up them for beach outing? Then let’s do it, they are waiting for the best outfits today.

title: Princess as Los Vegas Showgirls
description: Dress up this princess as Los Vegas Showgirls. You can choose colorful impressive costumes with feathers and jewelry who will fit with overall appearance.

title: Bike Speed
description: You need to tap left and right repeatedly to increase cycling speed, avoid distraction like rock, hole and cones, reach checkpoint to earn extra time for longer distance.

title: Fifa Rewind: Find the Ball
description: Fifa Rewind: Find the Ball is a hidden object game for boys where they need to find the hidden balls in this Fifa-themed background. Make sure to beat the time allocated in this game to proceed to the next round.

title: Can I Eat It?
description: This is a fun game for kids and adults too! This game is about a girl who asks if she can eat certain things. You'll gonna lose the game if you let her eat things that aren't edible or you won't let her eat things which are edible. You better choose fast because the time becomes shorter and shorter...

title: Cartoon Candy
description: Cartoon Candy is a cute matching game where you connect 3 or more cute candies according to their shape and color. You have 30 seconds! Make a longer connection so that you'll have bigger points and it will also extend your time. Challenge yourself and have your name in the leaderboard!

title: Cheesy Run
description: Cheesy Run is a fun and exciting running game. In this game you're a mouse whose in the run after stealing cheese from the cat. Jump over the cactus and mouse traps. If you ever get caught by it, you'll have to choose your faith. You'll choose from three chests and only one of it has a bonus points so choose wisely. Play the game now and see how far can you go!

title: Christmas Match 3
description: Play this fun Christmas themed matching puzzle game. Swap the Christmas icons to group the same icons all together. Match 3 or more to get a bigger score.  You have limited time so match as many as you can. Every successful match will increase your time a little. It's a game that will give you that Christmas feels.

title: Slime Laboratory 2
description: Our slime ended in a mysterious genetic laboratory. Are you brave enough to face all the traps and enemies hiding in this lab?

title: Easter Memory
description: Easter is the time when you need to use your creativity skill and make your eggs look unique. Well in this game your task is to memorize the place of two equal eggs, and clean all board with the less tries. You are not limited with time, but your high score defend from the matches which you will done.

title: Engineerio
description: Put your thinking caps on for this puzzling engineering physics game thingies. Try to get the rolling thing to the exit if you can! It's a tricky puzzle that will test your ability to think quick and to react faster. Timing is key to success in many levels, so u better know when to click something and when not to.

title: Fast Numbers 2
description: In this game, main point is to click the number in order. Each ball have one number and goes around pretty fast, and you need to consistently click the balls. In every next level the count of balls and numbers are bigger for one more. If you press the wrong number, game over.

title: Flappy Ball
description: The aim for this game is to get the highest score in leader board. You need to focus controlling the ball and pass through the tunnels with out touching them.

title: Flappy Bounce
description: Another fun game that you have to be careful on bouncing the ball. Beat the highest score and make your name as the top one of the leader board.

title: Fidget Spinner Revolution
description: The aim of the game is to spin the fidget as long as possible to collect coins and buy all the spinners in the Shop. Upgrade your spinner and go on, try to reach the best high score.

title: Galaxy Domination
description: As riding the spaceship, you need to hop every planets and each planets has asteroids. Avoid hitting the asteroids and hop safely. Let's see how high your score is.

title: Forest Game
description: Try to finish every mission in each levels, before the end of time. Your job is to match three or more fruits in a row and collect the numbers of fruits, which are given to you as mission. You can use the three give items like help, use it when you are most needed. Good Luck!

title: Gravity Run
description: Get the high score by hopping each platforms using the gravity change. Use your skill on changing the gravity. Beat the score of other players and your name will be on the top of leader boards.

title: Wanted Dead or Alive
description: Most Wanted is a funny html5 game for kids. Make your own most wanted person and have fun. If you take your time you may make a celebrity!

title: Girl Dress Up
description: Dress up this cute girl from head to toe! Suit her up in a class or hip clothes. Choose her skin color and her nail polish. With lots of clothes, shoes, and modification to choose from. Play this game now and create your ultimate look!

title: Great Air Battles
description: Play this fun airplane shooting game Great Air Battles! Shoot down enemy planes, collect all stars and power ups from crates on parachute! Survive for as long as you can to get the highest point and have your name posted at the leaderboard!

title: Halloween Match3
description: This Halloween Match3 game is a very enjoyable game  good for all ages. Connect three or more Halloween monsters, horizontally, vertically, diagonally or even the combination of the three. Make a lot of matches before your time ends to gain a lot of points. Challenge yourself to be in the leaderboard!

title: Hexagon Fall
description: Hexagon Fall is physics puzzle game on where you have to balance the hexagon and not let it fall while you remove all the blocks. You need to be very careful on which block you'll remove because in one mistake the hexagon will surely fall. A simple yet challenging game that everybody will enjoy!

title: Sliding Bricks
description: Sliding Bricks is an easy yet fun game perfect for all ages. Move the block and match the color on the block below it to clear the line. Move as fast as you can because the longer you play the faster the block adds up. Don't let it reach on top of the screen or you're done!

title: Leaves Boy
description: Leaves Boy is a very challenging game that would put your skills to the limit. This dashing cute little boy can run on walls and he's quite fast too. Try to change walls quickly and avoid all the obstacles. Go as high as you can so you'll have higher points giving you a better chance to be in the leaderboard!

title: Math Game For Kids
description: Math Game For Kids is the best math game suitable for kids who are starting to learn about basic arithmetic. In this game, they will learn addition, subtraction and the math symbols, greater than and less than. It's very kid-friendly, giving the kids clues by using soccer balls to show the answer. Prizes awaits for them for every cleared level!

title: Schitalochka
description: In the game, you are given mainly 15 levels through that you have to go. In each level, the difficulty of the game increases as there is much harder numbers are given to be calculated. Either you are given the addition of numbers or given the subtraction of numbers. These are the games that will make you proud of the increasing performance of your children and increasing interest in mathematics if it is studying in lower classes. In the game, you just have to give it the game and put the right answer at the right place. For example, if you are given the question to solve like 1+1=? Then you have to drag 2 from the options given on the right side of the question. It will make the question correct and will give you some points according to the performance and time took. The game is a simple game and you just have to put the right thing in the right place.

title: Robotex
description: Drag and drop the correct jigsaw piece onto unique Robotex model. Featuring total of twenty different levels, the goal in this puzzle game is to complete all transformer robots while having loads of fun. After you assemble the twenty robots, a bonus stage will appear where you need to complete a super car model.

title: Quick Dice
description: All you have to throw the dice on the color of the wheel that the edges show. This will make your score up. For example, if the edges are showing green color at the sides of the dice, you need to throw the dice on the green part of the dice. It will easily make you experience the game with better experience. There are thousands of people that use to play such cool games and experience the most immersive game play. Try being skilled and forecast the upcoming color of the dice to be perfect. Hit the right color each time with the dice to make no mistakes. Only a single mistake will make your game over.

title: Bonnie's Valentine's Patchwork
description: This gorgeous fashion designer named Bonnie is going to create another set of clothes that will surely loved by many ladies out there. She decided that she will create a Valentine-themed outfit for herself because she's going on a lovely date with her boyfriend.

title: Princess Pride Day
description: The most colorful event of the year is happening today! These lovely princess is going to attend the Gay pride parade. Dress them up with a matching colorful outfits that will surely standout from the crowd!

title: Princess Mermaid Parade
description: These gorgeous Disney Princess are getting ready for the Mermaid Parade. Help these lovely ladies on deciding what outfit should they wear on the said parade.

title: Princess Back 2 School Lockers
description: It's back to school time and these lovely princesses are excited to decorate their own lockers. Help them out in choosing the color and motif for their lockers. You will have to arrange their things inside their lockers also.

title: Princess Eskimo
description: These faux fur and leather outfits are perfect for this cold and freezing weather. Elsa, Rapunzel, Moana and Cinderella decided to still have a fashionable outfits despite the freezing weather. They just need to choose the perfect outfit that are also perfect for the weather.

title: Moana's Christmas Tree
description: It's Christmas time! Moana and her friend Maui found a beautiful island and they've decided to put a beautiful Christmas tree there. Help them decorate the said tree and make it a sparkly and shining Christmas tree.

title: Elsa Make Up Removal
description: Queen Elsa was busy entertaining the guests who attended her party earlier. And now that the party is over, she now have time to have a relaxing time for herself. Help her remove her makeup and select a comfortable clothes before she sleeps.

title: Smiles
description: The goal is to crushes all the smiles.. except the red one! You can reach that, so simple with click  on the smiles. Click as fast as you can, because they are falling down, and you will miss the points with every missed smile. So be fast and watch out on the red ones, if you click 3 of the red smiles, you lose.

title: Will You Be My Monstertine?
description: Valentine's day is coming and these handsome monsters don't have a date yet. Jackson Jekyll, Porter Geiss and Slow Moe are looking for some handful hands to help them look for a partner and that will be your role. Select among the three handsome guys and dress him up to look more presentable when his date comes.

title: Sokoban
description: Sokoban is a type of transport puzzle, in which the player pushes boxes or crates around in a warehouse, trying to get them to storage locations. If you make a wrong move, you can undo your move, but if are really stuck, than you must start again. Good Luck!

title: Spect
description: Spect is an endless vertical space shooter game where your goal is to protect and survive your space ship for as long as you can. Destroying as many enemies and asteroids as you go will pump up your score! In this game, you will have two special abilities – each with relatively long cool downs. These abilities are: Missile, and shield barrier.

title: Memory Game Html5
description: This Halloween themed Memory Game will put your photographic memory to the test. Match all the cards in the least amount of turns to earn a lot of points. The bigger the points the higher the chance for you to be in the leaderboard!

title: Mini Racer
description: Mini Racer is a very entertaining racing game. Race your mini car through highway traffic and swerve quickly to overtake all the cars and trucks a head of you! Drive as far as you can to earn points. The farther you are the higher the points you'll earn.

title: Mummy Candies
description: This mummy has a craving for sweet candies and it needs your help on fishing out the candies buried within the ground. Wait for the dangling bandage from his wrist to be in the right position before dropping it down to hook up the candy. You have a limited time so get as much as candies as you can!

title: Panda Love
description: Panda Love is an adventure platformer with more than 20 levels in which you need to guide the panda back to his girl. Tap with your finger or jump with the mouse to grab all yellow blocks and open the gates for the next levels.

title: Speedy Boats
description: Make sure that you do not hit a boat along the way or else the game will get over. You will get assistance in the way in form of shield. As you will increase the toughness of the game, the number of boats will increase and your concentration will be put to test. Your score is equal to the number of boats you cross in the way.

title: Supercars Puzzle
description: In this game, you are given some figures of some super cars and the picture is cut in many small parts. You are also given a layout of the cut parts. You just need to put the right piece in the right place so it could be a complete image in the same manner.

title: Sweet Match3
description: This is a very colorful and fun game, in which the main task is to match 3 or more same color eggs. You need to click and pull the line to connect as much eggs as you can. The game has 50 levels. For each of them you can set a separate number of points to win.

title: BFFs World Cup Face Paint
description: The 2018 World Cup tournament will soon reach its end and we are offering you a very cute game to celebrate it! Elsa and Ariel are huge football fans so for the big final of the World Cup they are going to fly to Russia to support their favorite teams. You girls were chosen to help them prepare their special looks for this occasion so get ready for the ultimate face painting and outfits picking challenge.

title: Tetroid
description: The rules of the first part of Tetroid are very simple. Drag the familiar Tetris figures on the grid to build up shapes that form lines. If you score a line you will score points. Have fun playing this game which offers an original twist on the Arcade classic!

title: Puzzle Animal Mania
description: Puzzle Animal Mania is a very enjoyable thinking game. Place the blocks available on the shape provided to be filled up. You need to figure out which block should be placed in an specific area. Complete the whole puzzle to go the next level. There are  25 challenging stages for you to complete. Play now and see how far can you accomplish!

title: Touch Ball
description: The game play is easier as you just need to click and keep clicking on the ball that appears on the screen as soon as it arrives. It will also give you a better concentration skill so it could be better with the same respect. You just need to hit it with the clicks and you would get more and more score. With each click, the ball will change its color.

title: Zombie Buster
description: Zombie Buster is a crazy zombie shooter in which you have a bomb-gun you’re not afraid to use! The zombies in this game don’t move around much, but neither do you. The only way to get these ghouls are the time-delayed bombs that shoot out of your shotgun. Aim them at a spot where they will take out lots of bad guys when they explode.

title: Jail Prison Break 2018
description:
Be ready to the classic police chase game with Jail Prison Break 2018. The mission in this game is to help your friend escaping from Jail, who sentenced to death for a crime he did not commit. Use the best strategy to overcome difficulties on the way to exit.
Play the great survival game with an elaborated plan. This escape mission is a bigger test for your true friendship. Gather your strength and do whatever it helps to save your friend. Breaking the chain and releasing a lockdown is not an easy task, be alert in every steps of action. Attack and kill the nasty police guards before they catch you. Try to move and hide without being detected. Collect the available things in the cells you go through and solve the mini puzzles to open locks and gather some money from other lockup rooms.

title: Impossible Bike Stunt 3D
description: Welcome in the Impossible Bike Stunt 3D, where your challenge in this game is to handle with the traps in each levels. Try to survive the deadly obstacles and finished the level. With every passed level you will earn money, which you can spend to buy new faster motorcycle.

title: Avocado Toast Instagram
description: Avocado toast is not only popular on Instagram these days but it is also a popular healthy breakfast! So if you are already curious how those colorful plates on Instagram are made… stay tuned! we are going to share the best avocado toast dish with you. Begin by preparing the star ingredient of the dish: wash the avocado fruit, open it and mash it in a bowl until creamy. Toast the bread and then use a knife to spread the avocado paste over it. Now get ready to work out your food decoration skills too as you get to beautify the two slices with fried eggs, tomatoes, cheese, shrimps, mushrooms, fresh cucumbers or with parsley. Add as many extra ingredients as you want and when you’re done feel free to capture your creation and to post it to Instagram but not before adding the right filters. Have a great time playing the ‘Avocado Toast Instagram’ game!

title: Punch Boxing Championship
description: Let’s become universal champion of punch and fist punching and boxing after beating all heavy weight champion kick boxers in the world. You can choose one of the three modes, Quick mode, Tournament and Career and try to become a champion in this action and adventure sports game, so do not hesitate to face your challengers.

title: Operation Assault 2
description: Operation Assault 2 is a first person shooter game, in which your aim is to keep save your tower, from the demolishing bombs who are placed from the enemies tabor. Be precise, aim and shoot, and kill the enemies bomb keepers, and reach the bombs to deactivate them. Good luck!

title: Burnout Drift 3 : Seaport Max
description:
Burnout Drift 3: Seaport Max is the third installment of this awesome car racing game. In this episode, you must test your driving skill in an immense and busy seaport. The port is packed full of containers, ships, cranes and other obstacles that you must try and avoid. Before you start racing through the port however you can customize your vehicle – change its color and also fine-tune its handling to suit your driving style.
Once you are kitted out and customize you can start racing and drifting!

title: Monster Defence
description: Walk through the valley of the shadows of death, where monsters rampage around and bombs explode for fun. Armed with pistols, snipers, other guns and bombs, you should fear no monsters as you rush towards the red goal. Shoot down everything that moves, and good luck staying alive in the Monster Defense shooting game.

title: Alien Attack 3
description: Since you liked the first two Alien Attack, we now give you the third installment of the game. In this game you have to survive all the wave of aliens coming your way. With unlimited ammunition, go into a shooting frenzy and kill all these extraterrestrial beings. Earn lots of points and use it to purchase weapons. Play now and see how far you can go and how long you'll survive!

title: Winx Club Hair Salon
description: The adorable princesses from across the land are coming to your salon and require your skills to create a stunning new hairstyle for them. Once you have made their hair look picture perfect, create a stunning outfit for them to wear to create the perfect look complete.

title: Funny Throat Doctor
description: This cute girl have bad throat ache, and she need a treatment by some good doctor. So you as her doctor should try to clean her mouth from the layer of batteries, and to remove the fish bone that is stuck in her throat and tonsils. Do it like a real professional doctor.

title: Jazzy Car Parking
description: Hop on the driver's seat and drive your car to designated parking spot. Avoid objects and other cars at all costs or you will loose. You can finish each level with three stars if you don't hit your car in any objects. In one level you need to park properly on two places. Good luck!

title: Modern Fashion Designer
description: Try your designer skills in this fashion HTML 5 game, where your job is to create a perfect clothes in each level. Choose the colors that are in vogue and use like as an addition for the design you are making. You need also to complete the look of the model, which are wearing your fashion designed clothes, with hair style, shoes, accessories and jewelry. Enjoy!

title: Bonnie Lice Control
description: Oh no, no… this is really bad! Bonnie’s gorgeous blonde hair locks were invaded by lice and their eggs and now she needs your precious helping hand to get rid of them! There is a new special shampoo on the market and she plans to try it out today, hoping that she will manage to exterminate these creatures in a way that is supposed to be less damaging for her hair locks.

title: Ice Skating Competition
description: The ever beautiful Princess Elsa and her daughter just recently joined an ice skating competition. We all know that this is going to be easy for them knowing that they really love ice skating. But, they need the right outfit and equipment for competition. So, for this matter, they will be needing your help in selecting the right outfit for them to perfect their exhibitions without any discomforts.

title: Neon Blitz
description: In this game, you are a neon cube that must be tracking all the stars that appear throughout the game. However, you will have to do it in jumps, throwing yourself from one side of the stage to the other and dodging bullets or other threatening objects that could wash the party completely.

title: Punk Eye Surgery
description: In this game you have an obligation to take care of patients with eye problems. In fact, you do not need any major involvement, first you need to clear their face and put drops. Push the dipstick, place the lenses to improve their appearance. At the end you just need to choose some clothes for your cute patients.

title: The Archers
description: "The Archers" is a fun shooting game whereas you'll have to shoot the apple using your bow and arrow. In the 2 player mode, you'll have to shoot the apple from your opponent's head. The first one who'll shoot 5 apples wins the game. If you think you're still not good at shooting, there's a training mode that can help you practice and increase your accuracy. Invite your friends to play this fun game and see which one of you is the better shooter.

title: Wheely 7: Detective
description: After his fairytale expedition in Wheely 6, our friend is back again for more exciting point and click adventures. This time he sets out as a detective, and travels around the world. Good luck in Wheely 7!

title: Atari Centipede
description: Centipede is a vertically oriented fixed shooter arcade game produced by Atari, Inc. in June 1981.  It was one of the most commercially successful games from the video arcade's golden age. The player fights off centipedes, spiders, scorpions and fleas, completing a round after eliminating the centipede that winds down the playing field.

title: Atari Missile Command
description:
Missile Command is a 1980 arcade game developed and published by Atari, Inc.
The player's six cities are being attacked by an endless hail of ballistic missiles, some of which split like multiple independently targetable reentry vehicles. New weapons are introduced in later levels: smart bombs that can evade a less-than-perfectly targeted missile, and bomber planes and satellites that fly across the screen launching missiles of their own. As a regional commander of three anti-missile batteries, the player must defend six cities in their zone from being destroyed.

title: Princess Urban Outfitters Summer
description: These lovely disney princess are going out for shopping. They are going to buy some new clothes for summer. Select the perfect outfits for them and make them the most stunning ladies this summer season. Have fun!

title: Summer Braided Hairstyles
description: Summer is such a lovely season to bring out that fashionista in you. Aside from having a stunning outfit, you should also decide what will be your summer hairstyle. Select among these cute and cool braided hairstyles to match with your outfit.

title: Pie Realife Cooking
description: Do you love pies? Well, this game will surely make you feel happy because it will teach you how to cook your favorite pie. Just follow each step and don't forget the required ingredients.

title: Kawaii Lemon Dressup
description: Dress over the cute kawaii character with lemon inspired clothing and accessories and even a cute pet to match! Awesome!

title: Aliens Enemy Aggression
description: You have infiltrated the enemy ship and your mission is to destroy 3 alien teleports! Kill all the hostile aliens coming your way as you search the whole ship. The faster you destroy the teleports the higher the points you'll have. Use the points you've earned and buy powerful weapons. Play now and see how fast you can complete the mission!

title: Pizza Realife Cooking
description: Bake your very first virtual pizza with these given ingredients. Just follow each steps and you're good to go.

title: Girly House Cleaning
description: Oh no! Someone's coming over to your house but your house is so untidy and unorganized. Clean your surrounding and put those clutters to its original arrangement.

title: Brutal Battleground
description: Brutal Battleground is a horror survival game in a hellish arena! Kill all the abominations and try to survive every wave. Survive for as long as you can so you'll earn bigger points. There will be powerful weapons that will spawn in the arena that you can use killing all those demonic monsters easily. Remember that you are in hell and the place is filled with hot lava. Play this game now and survive, just don't get burned and die!

title: Medieval VS Aliens
description: It's the middle of the 15th century, Earth was invaded by hostile aliens eager to take over the world. You as a knight, vowed to defend your land to any invaders and kill those who will resist. With just your bow and arrow for you long range weapon and a shield and a sword for your melee, you have to defeat all the aliens and destroy their mothership!

title: Ice Cream Donut
description: Create your very own ice cream donut. Start from baking your donut from the scratch. Measure and mix the ingredients and bake it at the right temperature and time. Add a scoop or two of ice cream to your donut. Top a bit of sprinkles, nuts or even pretzels. Garnish it with fresh strawberries, marshmallows or even some candies. The possibilities are endless, so what are you waiting for? Play this game now!

title: Ellie Artist Makeover
description: Oh no! Today is Ellie's entrance test to her future art school. She needs to finish her drawings for her portfolio. She also needs a make a over because she can't show her face to that school looking like a hot mess. Help her finish her drawings, give her that radiant make over, dress her up in a hip and stylish clothes. Make her look a smart but playful artist.

title: Fun Basketball
description: Fun Basketball is a fun game that you can play with a friend. It's a simple game of basketball which makes it more fun and enjoyable. You only need to score more than your opponent to win the game. Every score earned can be used in unlocking new balls and characters. Play this game now and you'll see that having fun is not complicated as it may seems.

title: Fun Football
description: Fun Football game is a simple take on the game football. It's an uncomplicated fun game that you can play against a friend. You need to win more in order for you to unlock new ball designs and cool characters. Playing this game is absolutely fun!

title: Fun Volleyball
description: Play this simple yet enjoyable game Fun Volleyball! Challenge yourself or a friend in this delightful game of volleyball. Watch out for stars because you need those so you can purchase new and colorful beachballs!

title: WWII:Seige
description: In a war of chaos, you are left in the trench where you have to hold the line and let your fellow soldiers leave this hellish place. Do your duty as a valiant soldier, sacrificing yourself for the safety of others. Survive the waves of enemy soldiers coming your way. Purchase better weapons to increase your rate of survival. Play this game now and see how long you'll take before your enemies conquer your trench!

title: Captured City 3D
description: Captured City 3D is a very challenging first person survival shooting game. Shoot all enemy soldier and survive every wave. Look for med kits, guns and ammunition around, it will help you a lot on keeping yourself alive. This game needs speed, accuracy and a lot of shooting skills! So do you have what it takes to play this game?

title: Grand Race
description: Grand Race is a 3D formula 1 racing game. You can choose between Career Mode or Free Mode. Win every race and earn, so you can purchase upgrades for your vehicle. If you have the skill to drive and a speed junkie then this game is for you! Play now and see if you can even finish a track!

title: Baby Princess Birthday Party
description: Today is Erika's birthday and she is preparing for the event! Help our baby princess decorate the room for her birthday with balloons,gifts and many other party ornaments and then you can pick some nice dresses and accessories for her! Have fun playing Baby Princess Birthday Party.

title: Doll Creator Spring Trends
description: Doll Creator Spring Trends is a great fun game where you will have to create doll and dressing them up for different events.After you create the dolls you will have to pick outfits for a walk in the park, a walk in the city or a simple school day.Have fun creating your perfect doll.

title: Princesses World Championship 2018
description: Join our two princesses to a world championship match tonight.Help them prepare for the event!

title: Prom Queen and King
description: Tonight is a very special one,it's Prom night and everyone is preparing for this special event.Tonight the prom queen and king will be chosen and we all wait to see who will win it. You can take part in the preparation for tonight prom by helping our princess in choosing the best dress and shoes and take care of her hairstyle.Have fun taking part in the preparation of the feature prom queen.

title: Nightmare Creatures
description: This monsters you have no seen even in your worst nightmare, but you will need to handle with them in this game and kill them as much as you can to stay alive. For the beginning you have a gun, but with every killed monster you will earn the money, which you can spend on a better guns. Stay alive and be fast to run away from the monsters. Good luck!

title: Soviet Sniper
description: You have a perfect location for your duty as the hit man. The enemies will appear in waves, separated with 10 seconds pause between each wave. So your task is simple, you need to kill all opponent soldiers, but you have to be precise or you will be killed.

title: Dinosaurs World Hidden Eggs 2
description: Behave as the most professional archaeologist looking for dinosaur eggs in the shortest possible time. You will find them using the magnifying glass and sliding it carefully over amazing images of dinosaurs in action.

title: Warzone
description: A great WebGL shooting game, Warzone! This action-packed thrilling game will test your survival skills to the limits. On a mountainous terrain, your mission is to survive and kill all the enemy soldiers. There will be guns, ammunition and med kits that will spawn in the area so be aware of your surroundings. The number of rival soldiers will increase every wave as you progress in the game. With great 3D graphics, this game will give you that great feel of a first person shooting game. Use the terrain as your weapon. Go to the higher parts of the area and try to snipe the enemy. It’ll be hard for you to take them all at once because of the limited ammunition so better take them one by one. You’re just a one-man army and you need to be smarter and quicker on how you execute your actions. There are achievements that you can unlock. The achievements are, “The First Blood(easy)”, “Elite Killer(easy)”, “Hard Target(medium)”, “Legendary Soldier(hard)”, “Unlocked Potential (easy)”, “Survivor(easy)”, “Survivalist of the Dead(medium)”, “Overkill(hard)”, “Unlocked Potential(hard)”, and lastly “Living Nightmare(hard)”. These achievements will really challenge your shooting skills. Kill as many as you can and earn lots of points and maybe you’ll end up having your name in the leaderboard! Play this game now and see how far you can go!

title: Princess Synchronized Swimming
description: We all know that synchronized swimming is not an easy sport to do. It needs lots of discipline and dedication and will take years before you can actually master this sports because it's like doing some acrobatic stunts in the water. But once you master this sport, it can be the most fulfilling achievement ever! In this game, this group of lovely and hardworking Disney princesses is professional synchronized swimmers. They are practicing for their upcoming synchronized swimming competition and they need your help with regards to their swimming styles, and as well as their appearances. As their synchronized swimming coach, you need to carefully choose their stunts. Choose those stunts that are difficult to perform but still, can be properly executed by these ladies and stunning to look at. In this way, it will highlight their ability to synchronize with each other despite the level of difficulty on their stunts. Aside from choosing their stunts, you also need to choose the best outfits for the ladies. Choose a swimwear that has glitters, lovely embroidered beads, and bright-colored fabrics for the ladies. This kind of eye-catching swimwear will make them stand out from other competitors and can also make them look even more gorgeous and feminine at the same time. If you wonder why they have the uniformed swimwears, it is because they need to create an illusion that they are moving as "one". And because of your great choices of stunts and outfits, it is already an assurance that these gorgeous ladies are on their way to their goal - to be the champion of this year's synchronized swimming contest. Don't forget to choose accessories for them such as medals and jackets. These stylish jackets will surely look stunning on these ladies. Also, you can choose gold, silver, and bronze as their medals. Have fun playing this dress up game!

title: Ice Cream Pancake
description: Making ice cream pancake sounds fun, but first of all we need to pick some ingredients before we start our cooking. Grab the ingredients that we need and let's proceed to the cooking once they are prepared. You have to beat the egg gently so it would not splash. Lastly, you have to pick your toppings and flavor of ice cream you want.

title: Cute Car Repair
description: This car repair game teaches the kids on how to value things that are abandoned already. Even if the car is already worn-out, full of mud, and has lots of disgusting cockroaches, when you repair it, it will become an ideal car for you and can still be as useful as it used to be. First, we need to take out those muds and wash it away. Make sure to clean those edges to make sure that both the outer and inner parts of the car are squicky clean. After cleaning, we need to patch the tires and inflate those flat tires. Then, you have to repair the parts now and replace the battery that is not working anymore. You will also need to add the missing parts so that the car will work fine. After fixing the machine parts, you can now proceed with the broken radio. The speedometer is also an important part to repair because it determines the speed of the car and the engine's status. We must repair its wires and replace the old gauges in order for them to work well. Lastly, we can now proceed with decorating the car. Decorating the car is such a fun part because you can apply that inner artistic side of you. You can pick any color and designs for every part of the car to make it look brand new and unique. You also get to choose among these well-designed and colorful tires that will surely make your car look cooler and edgier than ever!  As you can see, it is actually possible to turn a muddy and worn-out car into a colorful and useful one. We actually don't need to buy a new one if we can just clean and repair the old one. Have fun repairing old cars!

title: Death Squad: The Last Mission
description: Death Squad: The Last Mission is a first-person 3D shooting WebGL game that will challenge your shooting and survival skills to the test! In this game, your chopper has crashed down to an abandoned area which is near at the enemy base. Your team has survived the crash but will all of you survive the attack of your rival soldiers. Together with your team, you need to hold your position as long as you can. With limited supply of ammunitions, you need to get though every wave of attack. There will be a 20 second warm up time before every wave. Use that time to loot for weapons, ammunitions and med kits that will spawn around the area. Your enemy will increase every wave, so you need to gather more ammunition and med kits as you can for it will help you survive. There are 12 achievements that you can unlock from easy, medium and hard. Get points by killing your opponents and earn as much as you can so you can be listed together with the pros of this game in the leaderboard. Take part on this mission and be one of the unstoppable Death Squad!

title: Monsters Invasion
description: In the empty city, in which rules fear and creepy creatures, you are the last living man, who need to find the way and stay alive. You have enough weapons and ammo, but you are on a siege of Monsters Invasion. Your live depend from your shooting skills, kill all monsters which will appear on your way. Good luck!

title: Time Shifting
description: The action in this game is located in the castle yard, where from all sides of the castle crosses are coming enemies against you. You should handle with skeletons, zombies, werewolves and spider. You have various available weapons, don't lose your time during reloading, choose next weapon.  Run away from them, find a good position and kill them all.

title: Demolo
description: Have you ever solved a Rubik's cube? Well, you have an opportunity to solve one, but not on the classic way, but with matching other color pieces, on the gived one. Rotate your Rubik cube and place the colored block in place where will be connect the most same colored blocks. You can choose different shapes, like cube, sphere, pyramid and diamond, also you can choose whether they will contain 3, 4 or 5 colors. Enjoy!

title: Bike Riders 3: Road Rage
description: Bike Riders 3: Road Rage is a combination of the first 2 games of Bike Riders, getting the element of driving through traffic in Bike Riders 1 and the brutal action fights in Bike Riders 2. With new bikes to unlock and to make it more interesting, this game includes police bikes too! You can play in single player mode or in multiplayer. In single player, you are going to finish 10 different missions in which you can be one of the goons or be the policeman who’s chasing them.  Every mission complete will let you unlock one of the awesome bikes in store for you! The missions get harder and harder as you progress. There are power ups along the road that will help you in taking the lead. You can also play this game with your friends or against other players of this game in multiplayer mode. Choose between the bad guy or the good guy and drive whichever bike you like. Beat your opponent with a club and make sure they’ll never get you. This game is not just about racing but also about survival! Finish the race and unlock all the achievements. Earn a lot of scores and be part of the list of the Pros in the leaderboard!

title: Semi Driver 3D Trailer Parking
description: A new 3D parking game which you will drive a big and long truck. Drive and park it yo the destination pointed by the arrow. You can change the camera view by clicking or tapping the arrow icons on the top right. You can also click or tap the reverse sign to move the truck backwards.

title: Elsa Swimsuit Design
description:
In this game you need to be a good designer, and make a perfect swimsuit design for princess Elsa.
Choose the model of the swimsuit, complete or two part swimsuit, also the color and some swimsuit details. After you will choose this segments, you need to dress Elsa in your creation and choose accessories for her.

title: Princess Claw Machine
description: You have all collection of puppets, which you can try to catch in this claw machine. Try until you pick up all the dolls in the collection, you are not limited in your attempts.

title: Paired Car Parking
description: This is car driving-parking html 5 game, which in every level you need to park two cars. Take care to avoid obstacles which are on your way, because with every hit you lose one star. If you loose 3 stars you will need to start again. Practice your driving and parking skills and try to reach every car in the proper parking place.

title: Sniper Mission
description: Sniper Mission, a 3D first person shooting game, is about to take your sniper skills to another level. This game will hone your sharp shooting ability because of the time pressure, you'll have to make sure every bullet counts. It's easy to take down an enemy soldier by taking body shots but where's the fun in that? Shoot the head if possible to make it more challenging besides head shot gives you higher score than the rest. You have only five minutes, so you better kill fast. Speed and accuracy is what you need. Score as high as you can and be in the leaderboard and unlock all the achievements in this game if you can. Play now and practice your sharp shooting skills!

title: Swords and Sandals: Champion Sprint
description: Sword and Sandals: Champion Sprint is an action packed gladiator game set in the world of Brandor. You must choose one of three legendary gladiators and enter a fast-paced tournament where you will battle one Arena Champion after another in furious one vs one arena combat.

title: Funny Nose Doctor
description: Funny Nose Doctor is a fun doctor simulation game where you have to treat 2 patients namely Hellen and Aaron. Hellen is a very active girl, who just had an accident where she broke her nose after slipping on a banana peel. She didn't inform her parents until it got worse already. You need to clean and fix the broken bones. Give her the right treatment that she needs in order for her nose to heal. Aaron on the other hand is a very lazy boy who doesn't want to change his bed sheets until it got infested with bugs that later crawled inside his nose. Aside from that Aaron tends to put stuffs in his nose too! Remove all the foreign objects in his nose and exterminate all the bugs! It's a nasty job to do but someone's gonna do it and fortunately it's you! After all the treatment, dress these kids in a very cool and hip outfit to make them feel happy after their operations.Take a screenshot of them and share it with your friends here at Y8.com.

title: Emergency Surgery
description: Oh no, Doctor we need your help! Three patients are currently in need of medical attention and you're the only one who can help them.  Edgar fell from the tree and broke his collar bone. You need to operate on him and fix the broken bone and put a stainless steel brace just to hold it back into place. While Betty needs a knee replacement after getting in a severe accident resulting to her crushed knee joints. Lasty is Albert, he too fell from a tree and unfortunately his stomach was stabbed by a pointed branch. They all need some medical assistance and you have to do it fast. Their lives are in your hands! After their successful surgery, dress them up in cool and hip clothes to make them feel better after all the misfortune that had happened to them.

title: Fun Tattoo Shop
description: Welcome to Fun Tattoo Shop! In this game you will have to create different designs of colorful tattoos to different costumers. We have 2 modes for you to choose from. The CAMPAIGN mode where there are different customers and you'll have to choose the right tattoo based on their lifestyle and personality. While in the FREESTYLE mode, you'll choose which customer you want to put on the tattoo which you have picked. There are colorful designs to choose from which you'll definitely like! Share your artworks to your friends via screenshots and unlock achievements as you play this very fun game!

title: Kungfu School
description: Welcome to Kungfu School, the home of the great kungfu masters! Start your avatar fighting its way to easy mode so you can purchase some upgrade that will help you enter the next level of difficulty which are normal and hard mode. You'll be fighting different opponents in each mode that have different skills and abilities. Finish all the stages in every single modes and unlock all the achievements along the way. This action packed game will make your gaming worthwhile.

title: Cat Jump
description: A new fun game which you will play as a cat jumping and evading those animals along the way. You need to click wisely as the animals are in different speeds. Once they caught you, the game is over. Get and beat the highest score become top 1 of this game.

title: Piggy Roll
description: This game is so fun that you have to roll the piggy creature inside the candy box. But that's not so easy, you have to collect the stars first in order to proceed with the next level. Getting the three stars means you get the highest points of that level.

title: Spaceship Survival Shooter
description: As a fighter of the space, you have to save your self against the enemies. Your main goal in this game is to survive the attacks of the enemies approaching by destroying them. Evade their deadly attacks as soon as they are destroyed. They will leave some power ups that you can collect for upgrade of your weapon and get a health points to repair your ship.

title: Arrow in Your Knee
description: Arrow in Your Knee is a mouse skill game that needs your fast reflexes and dodge all the arrows coming towards you! If the ARROW gets you, it will deduct 15 life points while the ROCKET will deduct 10. FREEZE in the other hand, will slow down your movement while the RECOVERY will award you with 20 life points. And lastly avoid the BAD GUY in any cost because you'll definitely die for sure! How long can you hold up? Can you top the leaderboard? Play this game now and see if you have the skills to pay the bills!

title: Clever Frog
description: Jump from leaf to leaf! You must pass only once over every plant until you complete the level using all the leaves! Challenge your brain! Touch a plant to jump there, and you can jump forward, left and right, no backwards jumping and no diagonal jumping.

title: Rabbit Jump
description: Try to get the new score in this Html5 jumping game, with avoiding the dangerous, deadly obstacles, like, fire cannon ball, stone bridge, spike blocks and so on. Like a bunny in this game you can hop higher enough, but you need to jump on time and avoid the dangerous.

title: Plumber Soda
description: Would you like to drink soda? Well, if you want some, you need to complete the mission each level. Click on the straw pieces to rotate them and connect the soda keg to the bottle. This game is not easy because the move is limited. Keep trying and help those two kids drink soda!

title: Fruit Slasher Html5
description: Another one slasher game in which your job is to cut the fruits. Try to chop as many pieces of fruit as possible and win points. You can make a mistake only a few times, you should, for example not hit a hamster.  Reach the place up on the leader board.

title: Hungry Frog Html5
description: This frog needs to be fed. Click on the flies and the frog will show all sizes of her tongue. She will stick off the flies on her tongue and will eat them. Also you can collect the watches and fly hitter, which will help you have enough time and eliminate all flies.

title: Funny Faces Match3
description: Your job in this matching game, is to connect three or more animals and get points. Time will start with counting after your first move. You can earn seconds with every matching move. Make a combo match and get extra time.Enjoy the game!

title: Gunmach
description: Gunmach is a dynamic top-down shooter about military drones testing. Game have endless game play in one arena. you have to go through the maximum number of enemy attacks. The game has a bonus, such as an energy shield, repair drone, mines, 4 level for the gun. Arrows to move and collect gold, tap to shoot.

title: Blocks Super Match3
description: Blocks Super Match3 is a fun matching HTML5 game. You are given a minimum time to match those colorful monster blocks. As you make matches successfully your time will automatically increase, so, match as many as you can so you can stay in the game. Play this game now and play longer than the rest and be in the leaderboard!

title: Toto Adventure
description: Welcome to Toto Adventure game! Toto is a boy who search for hidden treasures and his quest is to find all 24 of them. Every stage has a lot of obstacles and some zombies to kill. Kill the zombies by jumping over them and collect all the coins and keys. If you collect all the keys you can now unlock the treasure that will lead you to the next stage. It's a very challenging game that needs your focus and fast reflexes. Earn more points and have your name posted in the leaderboard!

title: Halloween Parade
description: On each Halloween Hall, there is usually a skeleton, a vampire, a pumpkin for Halloween, Zombies, Frankenstein, just like in this Halloween game. Your job is to match the points as far as you can, till the end of time. Try to get a better score before the time expired.

title: The Office Guy
description: John and his Boss had a meeting with one of their competitor. In that meeting John's boss declined the offer and as a result he was shot in the head! Now John has to get out of their rival's office which is filled with armed goons and security. Help John survive from the them and get all the things he needs in every stages. It's a bloody quest but it needs to be done. Finish all the tasks and have your revenge! Earn lots of points as you play along and you might have your name posted at the leaderboard!

title: Happy Chef Bubble Shooter
description: Welcome in this sweet cake, bubble shooter game. The boys ended up putting his favorite foods to sell unintentionally into small balls that are flying above his head. Shoot the bubbles to match with another one, same like the bubble who you shoot. Help him to make a extra points and get the place higher in the high score list.

title: Jelly Pop
description: This game is additional game, quite similar to 2048. The difference is that here you are playing with jelly. Your job is to connect the same jelly touch, they will merge into new one. Continue the process of merging the jellies and get to the last tile. Enjoy.

title: Little World Jelly's
description: You are in the Little World of Jelly's and your job is to eat the jelly. Tap to switch your hero color and eat jellies as many as possible. Watch out! Each hero can only eat the same color jellies as its own. Carefully the game is getting faster and faster.

title: Santa Girl Runner
description: Santa girl runner is a game which your character will run through the ice path. Collect all the rings along the way. You can jump to an obstacles by press the up arrow key and slide down by pressing the down arrow key. You will collect also the heart for an extra life to make you survive more longer and the gifts which make you invulnerable to any obstacles.

title: Sea Animals
description: The main goal of this game is to match the animals base on their appearance in a line by three or more. Every time you failed to match them more animals will pop out and become a problem for you because they can block your path to match with the other animals.

title: Super Color Lines
description: The point of this game is to connect and match the color by forming a line by five or more. You have to form it before the color will pop out and make your way blocked to other colors. By completing a perfect five colors in a line, it will not pop more color make sure on arranging the colors.

title: Pyramid Run
description: Explore the ancient pyramid as you jump your way through secret pyramid passages, collecting diamonds and avoiding traps and mummies. The objective is to ascend to the top of the pyramid, hopping from one wall to another. React fast as mummies literally fall down from the top, and the friendly walls are not so fun when hundreds of species are bursting to impale you. Good luck!

title: Space Shoot
description: We all have been in Luna park and take fun, trying to hit some aliens with balls and win the reward. Well, in front of you is the game similar of that Luna park quest. you need to throw the balls and hit the aliens which are moving around. This way your award is not some teddy, but a place on the high score list.

title: Stone Aged
description: Welcome in an Age of stones, in this endless runner game run as a cave man to collect coins and destroy as many Dinosaurs as you can. Simple game play. Just jump and throw your weapon to hunt Dinosaurs and bring home the bacon for your wife because she is hungry!

title: Switch Color
description: This is simple, but not easy game, in which you can try your visual ability. Click on paddle to switch the color, there are only two colors, black and white and a bunch of balls who fall down, on the paddle. You need to change the color depending from the ball who fall. Be fast but on time, because if you change the color early you will lose.

title: Tronix
description: Welcome in Tronix game where your goal is to move all the points of the graph in such way that the lines cross and no point is sitting on top of any of the lines. Use the mouse or your finger to move the points.

title: Zombie Shooter
description: The task in this game is to kill all the zombies in each level. Use direct bullet hits or rebounds to eliminate them all! You can break the chains and let the load fall to smash zombies which are under them. Use everything in the levels which can help you to clean the level from the zombies. Good luck!

title: Snake 2
description: Welcome to another one arcade, HTML5 Snake game, where you need to collect each pearl which will appear on the playing arena. You can go in every direction, but not to touch the walls, because if you will, the game is over.

title: Snake Blast
description: Snake Blast is the HTML5 arcade game, inspired by classic snake game, but modified  with colorful and modern graphics. Avoid from the other biggest snakes which are around you, collect pots and grow enough, so you can eat the snakes smaller then you.

title: Square Crush
description: Square Crush is a fun and simple HTML5 game on where you have to crush all the squares. It might sound easy but this game is very challenging. It gets harder and harder as you play longer. Just a tip, you'll notice that there are different colors of squares. Each color has a corresponding action or movement. So be alert and be fast on squishing and squashing those squares!

title: The Flash Adventures
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of The Flash Adventures! Help Flash arrive to his destination. Be careful on your way, there are monsters and vicious birds that will cross your path. Take them out by jumping on them. Collect coins and stars for more points. Look out for flags for those are checkpoints.Checkpoints are a great help for you because when you lose a life, you don't need to start all over again. You'll respawn to the last checkpoint that you have made. It's a simple yet challenging HTML5 game that will surely test your skills.

title: Candy Pig
description: The pig was not careful and ate a devil fruit! And then he lost his feet but with a stretch of his arm, he can reach a sufficient length to move. It is so amazing! Enjoy helping him to collect the sweet candies! You can tap or click the point of wall to move.

title: Big Blocks Battle
description: Big Blocks Battle - Launch balls into the stacks of block as you try to knock the right ones off. Don't score too low! Each game level has special task be careful to not lose and complete all levels with best game result. Have a nice game!

title: Magic Run Frog
description: Magic Run Frog is a fun HTML5 running game. Run as fast as you can, look out for witches that will throw some magic potion that will turn you into a frog that can easily be killed by crows. You'll be back into your original self once you get that green potion so better watch out for that! Play this game now and see how far you can go and you might end up getting listed in the leaderboard!

title: FPS Agency: Forest
description: Your squad is dead, but you need to complete the assignment. This region is full with army, keepers of the dangerous man, which is on top of this criminal group. Find and kill the drug dealer Ramirez. To pass the first level-task, go to the right side, and you will have more opportunity to pass the armed army.

title: Kill Monsters
description: Welcome to a world filled with monsters and you're here to slay and kill them all! In this game, Kill Monsters, you will have to survive all the waves of monsters coming your way. You need to obliterate them all, meaning no one gets left alive so you can proceed to the next stage. There are four heroes that you can unlock as you progress in the game. Unlock all the achievements and earn lots of points to be a part with the high scorers in the leaderboard!

title: First Defender
description: You have only one main task in this FPS game, grab the weapon and aim every zombie who will appear on your way and kill it. Collect the weapons and ammo and you can change when the waves of the bloody zombies come against you. Good luck!

title: Steel Fists
description: Steel Fists is an action packed street fighting game. In this game, Luke Steel is about to have his revenge and he wants everyone in his rival group dead after what he had done to him. Help Luke beat all his opponent and survive every stage. Watch out for wooden boxes because there might be some weapons that can help you eliminate your enemies. Your enemy gets stronger and stronger as you progress in the game. Unlock all the achievements and rule this game by being on top of the leaderboard!

title: Pinnacle Racer
