description: Rev up your engine because your are about to play the race of your life in this game, Pinnacle Racer. Be on top of every race. Unlock all the tracks and max all the upgrades on all 4 cars. Use your boost at the right time and make sure to do clean turns on every corners of the track. Pass all your competitors and be on top of the race and you'll end up being with the pros on the leaderboard!

title: Stray Dog Care
description: Wanda was on her way home when she heard something by the garbage bin. As she put away the boxes she saw a puppy in the box. She couldn't bear to see the poor dog being so dirty and hungry at that time so she took it in. Help Wanda clean up the stray pup and give it the make over that it needs. Give it food and some love to make the poor puppy happy and healthy again! Dress it up in a fancy and cute clothes for its third month anniversary party!

title: Math Puzzles CG
description: You need to calculate the number of each pattern according to the information provided in the game. Finally, the final answer to the question is obtained. This game can be as addition, subtraction, multiplication and division and requires strong logical thinking. Have fun.

title: Speedy Math Race
description: Solve math equations from addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division and try to win the race with your yellow car. The more math equations in your answer correct, the faster your speed by your opponents. Test your math skills and race against your opponents. Tap the right number to answer math questions correctly. Play fast to get higher scores.

title: Vincy's Fairy Style
description: This is Vincy and she will need your help about her look. Take care about her make up and choose some fairy dress to complete her look.

title: Vincy Cooking Rainbow Birthday Cake
description: Vincy is going to have her birthday tomorrow. Now could you help her to make a delicious rainbow cake to make her birthday colorful?
Join the numbers by sliding the same numbers together. Slide the numbers by left, right and down. Join the numbers and get to the 4096 tile!

title: Western:Invasion
description: Western:Invasion is a first person shooting game taken in the wild wild west era. In this game you're the sheriff in town and you need to kill all 100 outlaws coming your way. Just with your trusty shotgun, defend yourself and kill all your enemies. The faster you kill them, the higher the points. So play this game now and see if you can finish it and get listed in the high scores.

title: Hidden Gold Stars
description: In this game, enjoy the beautiful autumn images, which coming soon in nature, and search the hidden stars. All you have to do is find all the hidden stars in the autumn background. Here are five different levels. Have fun play with Hidden Gold Stars game.

title: Disney Crossdress Wedding
description: Jasmine, Elsa and Mulan are preparing for the cross dress wedding. They hope you can help them to choose the cross dress outfit. Princesses heard you are the best fashion adviser. Is it true? What outfit would be the best for cross dress wedding? You decide! Have a great time with princesses!

title: Minion Maker
description: You have various types of hats/caps, shoes, shorts, accessories to choose and create your favorite and unique minion. This yellow, cylindrical creatures are adorable with their own appearance. At the end, press finish and you are able to save the picture of minion you’ve created in your computer. Enjoy! Bananaaaaaa

title: Drop Dunks
description: In this game you need to get the points, by bouncing the ball with moving paddle and throw it through basketball circle. By the way, you can collect the stars which appears during playing and it will count it like a points. Don't let the balls fall down, with every fallen ball, you lose one life.

title: Mech Aggression
description: You need to win this war against mechanical enemies, who is coming from the six portals. With every killed robot, you earn money, who can spend later to buy new weapons. Won't be easy, there are too much "Mech Aggression" in game, try to survive and share the experience.

title: Tanks Battleground
description: Your job is to destroy the opponent tanks tabor, before the time expired. Switch the weapon and shoot on the target while is still on your aim. Is not so easy, but try to win this battle.

title: Masked Forces 3
description: Another chapter from the Masked Forces edition, which you can play as campaign or multiplayer against online users. You have enough available weapons who can use in your battle against the army from the opposite side. One of the mods in the game, includes the popular battle Royale fights where you find yourself in an arena with other players, with the best one surviving till the end. Try to survive and dominate the other players.

title: Cave War
description: You were abducted and taken to a man made cave. Fortunately you got out from your cage and with a knife, you'll have to start your escape. Pick up all the ammos that will be dropped by the enemy soldiers that you've taken down. Look out for weapons that will give you that edge in killing all your enemies. Be very careful on opening every door because there are also abominations in the premises which are harder to kill. Can you survive the horror of this game? Can you unlock all the achievements along the way? And can you be able to have your name listed on the leaderboard? Play this challenging first person shooting game now and see how long you can survive!

title: Forest Invasion
description: In Forest Invasion, alien spaceships have crash landed to the forest. You and your men were given the mission to eliminate them all before they can get to the city. Take them all out and leave no one alive. It's your sole duty to protect the human kind against these hostile aliens. Lead your team to victory! Unlock all the achievements in this game and kill as many as you can to earn points. The higher the points the greater the chance for you to be listed at the leaderboard!

title: Multigun Arena 3D
description: Play in a multiplayer world where elite shooters are playing to eliminate you. Featuring death match, team battles, Multi Gun 3D game is the best multiplayer FPS for you! Grab a gun or two, create a room, with or without a password, and invite your friends for playing this best shooting game.

title: Bff Matching Tattoos
description: They said a best friend is your sister from another mother. These lovely princesses have this special bond that makes the best of friends. They get along so well that they are so inseparable. And when you have this kind of relationship, never let it go. These princesses have decided to have matching tattoos because this is their ultimate goal.

title: Darth Vader Hair Salon
description: These three lovely Star Wars feminine characters - Rey, Leia and Padme, decided to go to Darth Vader's salon to have some makeover. Darth Vader himself will be the one who will give a makeover for these lovely ladies. With his exceptional skills, these ladies will absolutely have the best makeover ever!

title: Hyper Jelly
description: Hyper Jelly is a fast-paced and endless 3D platform game where you must control the ball and collect the jellies along the way. It may look easy on the first part, but as the time goes by, the speed will also increase which leads to some difficulties in controlling the ball.

title: Pumpkin Muffins
description: Pumpkin muffin recipe are made with cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, brown sugar and pumpkin puree. A combination of brown sugar and granulated sugar in the recipe creates a crunchy topping that contrasts with the moist, tender muffins. Pumpkin Muffin has a lot of nutritional value and tastes great. These spicy pumpkin muffins are good for a quick breakfast or to include in bag lunches. Serve these moist and flavourful muffins hot, with butter if you like, for breakfast or a snack. Learn how to make pumpkin muffins by following this easy recipe. Enjoy!

title: Rich Girls Mall Shopping
description: Today our three rich princesses decided to go for a new shopping experience and you are welcome to join them.Visit different mall fashion shops,try different outfits for every princess and in the end decide what to buy.Try unlimited outfit combinations and choose the one's that you like.Have fun playing our new girl game called Rich Girls Mall Shopping!

title: Ice Princess Doll Creator
description: Ice Princess Doll Creator is a great fun game where you will have to create dolls and dress them up for different events.After you created the dolls you will have to pick outfits for different events in their lives.Have fun creating your perfect doll.

title: Marry Me Kitty
description: Kitty is preparing for her wedding day and all her friends are invited to the wedding.Help Kitty prepare for her dream wedding,pick the best wedding dress,nice shoes and accessories.After you finish creating Kitty's outfit,help her decorate the garden for the wedding.Have fun playing Marry Me Kitty!

title: New Girl In High School
description: Our beautiful princess is the New Girl In High School and today she will join her new school.Help her prepare for this special day in her life.Start with the make up and choose some proper make up colors for school and then help her find the perfect outfit.Have fun playing our latest game called New Girl In High School!

title: Princy Throat Surgery
description: The adorable girl Princy had lots of ice creams on her birthday party. Unfortunately, she go her throat infected and she needs surgery on her throat right now. Could you help her for the surgery?

title: Cyber Dog Assembly
description: Enrich your collection of toy war robots, with the new one Cyber Dog. Your job is to assembly the dog with all protect and weapon enhancement. Then you can go and teach your Cyber Robot Dog in the training arena to refuse the bombs, jump obstacles and how to shoot. At the end, the take the last challenge and make your dog robot unique, by choosing colors and texture for him.

title: Garage Apocalypse
description: In the distant world, the end of the world came and the third world war began. Our character was able to hide in the garage and survive it all. But the trouble is that all the dead people rebelled as a zombie. Now we are in the game Garage Apocalypse will have to help our character survive. He will be in the garage where the car is. With the help of a special toolbar you can help him to do repairs. Also pay attention to the doors and windows and if you need to repair them. If your garage is attacked by a zombie, you will need to use your weapon. Point your way at the zombies and shoot them accurately with a pistol.

title: Swipe Skate 2
description:
Swipe Skate 2 is the skateboarding game in which you control your board and create the most radical tricks and stunts. This is the prequel to the much loved Swipe Skate! You must control your board using swiping motions, master your swipe to create awesome tricks.
There are 2 cool game modes to play including: free skate where you have complete control to perform stunts at your leisure. You also can play time trial mode which requires you to perform as many tricks as you can in the time limit. Buy upgrades and unlock more levels for added fun. Have fun!

title: Trial and Terror WebGL
description: Trial and Terror is the basic puzzle game In which you must control a small pixel square and navigate it out of the game area without colliding with any obstacles. Sometime the classics are simply the best and this game holds true to that value. Use your reaction and planning skills to successfully escape from the puzzle.

title: Jewel Burst
description: Jewel Burst is an HTML5 jewel matching game in an intergalactic theme. Swap jewels to match 3 or more identical jewels. As the jewel get destroyed the blue box will be destroyed too. You need to destroy all the blue box to get to the next level before the time runs out. If you do it in a least amount of time, you can get the three star bonus. If you take so much time when clearing the blue box, the star will be deducted one by one. Watch out for dynamites because it will help you blast the jewels easily. Cross arrow icons will wipe out the row and column in which it was placed. Lastly the colored jewel, it can be match to any color of jewel. There are 200 levels to complete meaning there are a lot of hours of gameplay! This game is compatible to any mobile gadgets so you can play it with your phone or tablet. You can play it anywhere you want and anytime you like! Enjoy bursting these galactic jewels and complete all the challenging levels!

title: Hanger
description: It's cool to imagine what if you have an awesome power to hang around just like your favorite superhero such as Spiderman, right? Well, you will surely love this game! Hanger is an exciting mouse skill game where you need to help this poor ragdoll hang on to the rope for him to be able to collect coins and pass each level. The more coins you can collect, the more characters you can unlock. Be careful when it comes to hopping from one side to the other though because there are also obstacles that can cause your ragdoll to torn into pieces. Every time the ragdoll touches the upper and bottom part, or the obstacles, it gets torn into pieces by pieces until the game is over. You can control the size of the rope for you to be able to get your ragdoll safe from smashing its body. Hanger is an HTML5 mobile game that can be played on your mobile phones.

title: Bob the Robber 4  Season 3: Japan
description: Bob The Robber is at it again! And now he's going to conquer the land of the rising sun, Japan! With cool new buildings to explore, new locks to pick, lots of treasures, money and jewels to steal! There will be new characters like the guards, yakuzas and even some scary creatures like mummies! Make your way to your targeted object. Stealthy move around the building. Avoid tripping any security wires, getting caught by the camera or even getting noticed by the people inside the building. You can always buy gadgets from your trusty source Ablebaba, to make it easier for you to unlock doors or hide yourself from security. You can also buy new costumes that has special abilities that will help you in your quest! Just make sure to get all the money that are hidden in every building so you can use it to purchase all the gadgets and costumes. Play this Bob the Robber 4: Season 3 Japan now and see if you can finish this chapter of this wonderful series of Bob the Robber!

title: Bob the Robber 4 Season 2: Russia
description: Bob is at it again and now taking the adventure to the land of the reds, Russia! After this successful steal in France, he is now taking his robbery skills in to new heights! Help Bob sneak past all the Russian security guards in every level of the game. You will steal some money, treasures and precious objects along the way. It's all about timing in unlocking doors and you need to be completely unnoticeable by the guards. You also need to find the right path in going to the object that you need to steal because it's going to be a maze once you enter the building. You can buy high tech gadgets to your trusty friend Ablebaba that can help unlock doors, deactivate security cameras, hide and defend yourself from the guards! You can also change your costume and showcase your precious trophies. Play this fourth season of Bob the Robber and conquer Russia now!

title: Neon Biker
description: In Neon Biker you must perform crazy stunts while driving through the world of never ending roads! Choose a vehicle, perform flips and try to get as far as possible. Enjoy endless levels or play 40 separate levels.

title: Parking Fury 2
description: Driving is such an important skill that everyone should learn. It can take you anywhere you want without waiting for someone to drive for you. But don't you know that you also need to be good at parking your car? Because each country has its own designated parking lots and you need to park your car properly. Parking Fury 2 is an HTML5 parking game where your skills in parking new cars will be tested. It is a one player game where you can play it for free at Y8.com. In this game, you are assigned to park different kinds of car. Whether it's a tow truck or a high-end sports car, you need to park it inside the yellow rectangle box. Be mindful of the spaces to avoid crashing the car because you don't want the cars to get scratched, right? Have fun playing this parking game. You can also play this on your mobile touchscreen phones.

The Greek heroes Hercules, Perseus, and Achilles will help you. You can also choose one of three Greek gods will be your supporter: Hades, Poseidon, or Zeus.

title: Bubble Burst
description: Bubble Burst is an HTML5 space-themed bubble shooter game. You can enjoy different levels of difficulty since it offers 50 levels that will surely test how well you shoot and match these bubbles. On the first few levels, it has a few varieties of colors to match up, but when the game progresses, there will be more varieties of colors as well as tiny bombs that will give you advantages in bursting a few more bubbles. Even if this game is considered as classic and arcade, it offers this features called "burst mode" in which, once the meter is full, it will shoot tons of bubbles of any colors. Once you pass each ten levels, you will encounter the boss level. This game can also be played on touchscreen-based gadgets so you can now play this game on your iPhone, iPad, as well as Android mobile phones. Have fun playing this fun and exciting matching game.

title: Frog Super Bubbles
description: This is very interesting game. In this game frog has to match the same color balls. in every few seconds balls will come closer to the frog. So, by matching same color balls frog will survive in the game and it can make the highest score as well.

title: Basket Ball Run
description: Basket Ball Run is an HTML5 mouse skill game that can be played by one player for free at Y8.com. Basket Ball Run is a fun and exciting basketball game where it will challenge your skills in shooting the ball by tapping the screen using your mouse. Hold and drag your mouse to aim and shoot. You need to be very mindful of the distance to avoid miscalculating when shooting the ball. Just take your time in deciding when to shoot because there will be bonus points for those perfect shots. The higher the ball gets, the harder the obstacles. So you need to check if there are platforms that can cause your ball to bounce back. Also, the target ring will also move as the game progresses. This kind of obstacle will make the game more challenging to play since it will affect the targeted distance when shooting the ball.

title: Sky Troops
description: Sky Troops is a fun fly and dodge game in which you have to take on the space aliens and enemy aircraft. Pick up the crates containing bombs, money, and first aid kits. If you see any people waving at you from below, fly over them to rescue them. After each level, you can head to the menu to upgrade your plane. Once you've unlocked all the upgrades for one plane, you can move on to purchase the next one, boosting your speed and maneuverability. Score enough points to unlock the boss levels.

title: Tower Defense Old
description: Tower defense is an HTML5 strategy game where the goal is to defend your territory by placing defences from the enemy's attacks. You can protect your territory from the attackers by putting the right defensive towers on or along their path. You can purchase the defences at the shop, but you need to have enough money to be able to do that. The stronger the defense towers, the better, but it will surely cost you a lot. But, the amount that you will be spending in upgrading your towers is worth it because the enemies will also upgrade and will be much stronger as time goes by so make sure to have enough money for you to be able to upgrade your existing towers. Don't let these crazy enemies attack the peacefulness of your kingdom so make sure to plan your strategies and successfully finish each level carefully.

title: Cosmic Bee

title: Fruit Master WebGL
description: Be a sharpshooter and target all these fruits with a knife. Never miss a single fruit and be the most famous fruit master of all!

title: Jelly Madness 2
description: The cute jelly monsters are back in Jelly Madness 2. With cuter graphics and all new 125 levels to complete. It's going to be a fun adventure matching these adorable jellies together. There will be objectives in every level that you need to accomplish in order to go to the next one. You'll be given a limited number of moves so better use it wisely. Remember that when you match the jellies more than four you'll unlock special jellies with different effects that will help you in the game. There are 4 special buttons by the right side of the screen that will also help you in finishing your objective. These special buttons are the +5 (it will add five more moves), the colorful bomb (it will explode all the jellies with the same color), the multi color jelly (this jelly can be match to any jelly regardless to its color) and the hammer (this will destroy the jelly that you will tap on). Start matching now and pop up those cute little jellies one by one!

title: A Walk in the Night
description: A walk in the night is a puzzle game about exploring and solving ruins. The puzzles will become more complex over time. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Getaway Shootout
description:
Getaway Shootout is a wild physics based game where stick characters compete to reach the getaway point before anyone else. Instead of running smoothly, your character moves in short hops and awkward jumps, which makes every step feel unpredictable and funny. Learning how to control this wobbly movement is the heart of the game and creates countless silly moments.
Each round takes place on a different map with platforms, gaps, moving objects, and tricky layouts. Your goal is to move forward using careful timing on your jumps, keep your balance, and find a safe path to the escape spot, such as a vehicle or exit point. The messy physics make it easy to fail in a hilarious way, so even simple actions become tense and entertaining.
You can play solo against computer opponents or challenge a friend in two player mode on the same device. Rounds are quick and full of sudden turnarounds. A well timed jump or clever move can instantly put you in the lead, while one bad bounce can send you falling behind, turning every match into a fun and dramatic chase.
Along the way, you can pick up different power ups and tools that help you interrupt opponents or protect your position. Choosing when and how to use them adds a bit of strategy to the chaos. No two rounds feel the same, because physics, timing, and item use constantly change the flow of the game.
With simple controls, playful stickman animation, and fast, unpredictable rounds, Getaway Shootout is a great choice when you want a fun, competitive game that makes you laugh at both your successes and your failures.

title: Sheepwith

description: Rev up your engines! You are about to enter the race of the Beach City Drifters where you can be one of the Steven Universe characters! You’ll start as Stevonnie with his car Supremo Dondai. You’ll have to drive down the mountains, collecting all the stars and avoiding all the obstacles coming your way. Make clean drifts as you take turns on the curves, it will make you faster. Drive as fast as you can and be in the finish line with the shortest possible time so you can earn some cash. With that earned money you can purchase and unlock Greg Universe, Buck Dewey, Jenny Pizza and Kevin with his sports car! There are 13 levels to complete. Remember to always avoid the cones and obstacles because there will be a collision penalty that will be deducted to your remaining time.  Play this game now and see if you can be the drift king!

description: Rookie bowman is a platformer game with boss fights, collectible items, secret rooms, special abilities and much more.

title: The Zen Garden
description:
The Zen Garden is the clicker game all about meditation and relaxation. If you are having a stressful day and the weight and stresses of everyday life are bringing you down then this game is definitely what the doctor ordered. Explore the beautiful zen garden based on a traditional Japanese flower garden with relaxing features for you to interact with.
Listen to the beautiful relaxing music while you operate the items in the garden There is a water wheel that you can operate and a lake that you can grow fishes in. You can plant beautiful bamboo plants or go and meditate in the stunning temple. Enjoy this peaceful bliss.

title: Rio Rex
description:
Rio Rex is the rampaging arcade game in which you can run riot controlling a huge T-Rex! Run through the towns and settlements destroying everything in sight and causing havoc amongst the puney humans in your way. This time you are let loose in the beautiful Rio de Janiero but take a look back at the previous cities that have been destroyed at New York and Paris
It is time again to chew people, destroy cities and blow your horrifying fire breathe at everything in sight. Go cause mayhem and destruction because why not! Have fun!

title: Sisters Pool Party
description: Welcome our newest game called Sisters Pool Party. Our two girls are preparing for a pool party and to look good they decided to go shopping and look for new swimsuits and some nice accessories.Help them pick the perfect swimsuits for this party and buy some cool accessories for them.Have fun playing Sisters Pool Party!

title: Skater Kid
description: This cool skater is going in search of tons of golden coins all around town. Join him while he performs awesome stunts along the way.

title: Fly or Die
description: The world was taken over by the undead and you are the only hope the human race. You only have your aircraft to use in destroying the mother hive that is located deep within the zombie territory! They are scattered across the premises making it hard for you to fly. They will try to destroy your aircraft so better watch out for them. Kill as many as you possibly can so you can earn money which you can use in purchasing upgrades for your plane. You need to load up and improve your plane for better chance of survival. There are three main areas that you need to fly though and all of those areas are infested with lots and lots of brain eating creatures! First is the city ruins where you go through many destroyed buildings, then the eerie infested swap, last and not the least, the hive core where the toughest zombies will be! Play Fly or Die now and start flying for your survival!

title: Apple Shooter Remastered
description: Apple Shooter Remastered is an HTML5 archery game that will test your skills in targetting the apple without your friend getting hurt. You need to be a sharp-shooter in this game since the life of your friend depends on how well you target the apple. The difficulty will rise every time you successfully hit the apple. Please know that your friend's blood will surely pour once you miscalculate the distance between you and the target, you don't want to let it happen, right? So be brave and be sharp enough to target the apple. There will be a guide for you to be able to calculate the distance easily and will also help you control the direction and power when releasing the bow. This game is remastered so it has more advanced graphics than the first version - Apple Shooter. You can also play this exciting game on your mobile phones such as iPhone, Android, and even on your iPads, cool right? Play this addicting game and become an amazing Indian warrior!

title: Agent of Descend
description: Agent of Descend is a challenging turn-based RPG game. You’ll play as the Agent Doe and your only mission is to eliminate all the hostile enemies in the building. You will start from the top of the building making your way down to the ground floor. It will not be an easy task because as you go down the building, the enemies will be stronger and will increase in numbers. Every time you completed your mission in each floor you’ll be awarded with some cash and bonus items that you’ll need in the game. With your cash, you can purchase upgrades that will make your character stronger and better. Increase the stats of your skills, purchase weapons for your melee, upgrade your guns and buy ammunition for your pistols, shotguns and assault rifles and some cool items like grenade, medpack and handcuffs. There are 60 levels to clear, so better gear up and prepare yourself for an ultimate combat!

title: Square Shooter
description: Square Shooter is a WebGL survival shooting game. This minimalist top view arena game is a very simple yet enjoyable game that anybody would love. Easy controls, colorful interface and fun graphics. You will start as the green square, your mission is to survive every wave. Kill all the enemy squares so you can go to the next level. There are lots of levels and as the game progress it will be harder and harder because your enemies will be faster and will increase in numbers. This game will test your reflexes, accuracy and speed. There are some gun upgrades that will be available for you in every map, it's in a block with a question mark, so better search it and get it quickly because it will give you that killing edge. Play now and challenge yourself in this fun shooting game and see how long can you survive?

title: Space Adventure Pinball
description:
Space Adventure Pinball is the space themed edition of the classic online pinball game in which you must keep a pinball within the play area hitting everything in sight to get points. Use the left trigger and right flippers to hit the pinball around the machine collecting points as you hit the ball into bumpers, cushions and bonus holes for extra points.
To get a high score you must hit the pinball into various objects whilst not letting the ball fall into the gutter in between your flippers. If the ball falls down the middle you will lose life's and eventually the game. Have fun!

title: Fussy Furries
description: Fussy Furries is a fun and challenging cat themed match three games. In this game, you need to give what the cat demands by matching three or more of the same item. Every item that has been out of the screen will automatically deducted to the cat’s orders. You need to give it before the time runs out or else you will lose a life. As you play this game and make a lot of matches you’ll be able to unlock your power-up buttons namely “shuffle board”, “clear row and column” and “make the cat happy”. These power-ups will help you ease your game because as the game progress it will keep on getting harder and harder. You’ll also unlock new items and make new ones by matching 3 of a kind. If there’s no possible match you can also drag the item to the cat, making it easier for you to finish an order. This game has definitely raised the bar on any matching game by giving it some twists and fun innovations. It’s a game that everyone will really love!

title: Merge Jewels
description: The screen is full of beautiful rainbow gems! Match groups of at least 3 similar ones in order to increase your score. Are you ready? Stay alert and break the records!

title: Modern Combat Defense
description: Modern Combat Defense is a base defense game where your goal is to stop the bad guys from destroying your base. Use your powerful weapon to shoot them down. It is auto fire. Dodge incoming bullets. Collect coins on the ground when you defeat an enemy. Upgrade your weapon for faster fire rate and firepower. When thing become overwhelming use the special airstrike.

title: Zombies vs Halloween
description: It’s Halloween time once again and as you all know it’s the season of witches and zombies! In this game Zombies vs Halloween, you’ll be the cowboy known as the Mask Pumpkin. You are the defender of the people in your small town in the wild west against the mindless zombies! The zombies are really into their eating frenzy, so you better step up the game by purchasing some weapons in the Armory and upgrade it by using the reward money that you’ll earn in every stage that you’ll finish. You can also hire some help in the Saloon if you have the right amount on hand. There also some items available for you to buy in Support that will aid you in your quest. Unlock all the achievements so you’ll be able to increase your rank. Remember that the higher the rank the stronger you are! Play this survival horror game and show them that you are the greatest zombie exterminator!

title: Army of Soldiers: Team Battle
description: Army of Soldiers: Team Battle is a turn based HTML5 where you must defeat your enemy soldiers and bring your team to victory.  You will start by choosing between the two existing teams, would it be on Jane’s team or the Commando’s? Before the fight starts, there will be a control panel that will show just above your character’s team. You’ll see three different icons which are the Army, Upgrade and Special. In Army you’ll be able to add three kinds of soldier in your team. Two are attack soldiers and one is a defense type. The Upgrade icon is all about adding skills, attack and defense to your army. Lastly, the Special is where you can get special attacks from throwing grenades, immobilizing your enemy or even dropping bombs on their base! To get those, you need to select from the three icons then press the big red button to spin the three possible combination that you’ll have. There are 40 levels that will definitely give your hours of gameplay. Special weapons and bonus to unlock as you play these amazing battles! Play now and be one of the undefeated!

title: Gravity Linez
description: Gravity Linez is a basketball themed physics HTML5 game. You need to draw a path to get the ball in the basket. You need to be fast and accurate on where you have to draw your path. The very challenge of this game is when the ball is in motion and you have to time your drawings properly to make sure that the ball gets correctly in the basket. Remember that with only one mistake, you will have to start the game to the very beginning again! You need to act and think fast or else you’ll lose the game. This is one of those simple looking games but definitely a very challenging one, once you started playing it. Aside from shooting the ball to the hoops, you need to watch out for bombs. Make sure to avoid it in any cost or else you’ll have to start over again! Play this game now and you’ll see basketball in a very different light!

title: Sumo Saga
description: Sumo Saga is a fun mouse skill game that can be played by one player in Y8.com. Help this adorable Japanese sumo wrestler make his way to the top and attend the sumo wrestling competition. He is trying his best to get to the tournament, and you are the only one who can help him with that. To do that, tap the screen and get the best timing and direction of the arrow and hop on to the next platform. Don't let the Japanese sumo wrestler miss the platform and fall; this will only end the game. Also, you need to be fast when tapping the screen because the game moves up which also serves as a timer and adds a difficulty of the game. This game also has excellent graphics. Each time the game ends, the graphics and background also change, it's cool, right? This game is an HTML5 touchscreen game that can be played on mobile phones such as iPhone, iPad, and Android.

RustiE saw how RoBBie cleaned himself so he sneaked to the cleaning machine hoping that it will clean him too. But the machine broke and all its chips where lost and where scattered around the factory! Now every robot that will use the cleaning machine will turn to evil robots. It’s up to RoBBie to save the day! Help him find all the chips by solving all the puzzles and pass all the obstacles that will be coming his way. title: Gauntlet Html5
description: Gauntlet is a fantasy-themed hack and slash 1985 arcade game by Atari Games. Released in October 1985.The player select among four playable fantasy-based characters: Thor, a Warrior; Merlin, a Wizard; Thyra, a Valkyrie; or Questor, an Elf. Each character has his or her own unique strength and weaknesses. For example, the Warrior is strongest in hand-to-hand combat, the Wizard has the most powerful magic, the Valkyrie has the best armor, and the Elf is the fastest in movement. Upon selecting a playable character, the gameplay is set within a series of top-down, third-person perspective mazes where the object is to find and touch the designated exit in every level. An assortment of special items can be located in each level that increase player's character's health, unlock doors, gain more points and magical potions that can destroy all of the enemies on screen. The enemies are an assortment of fantasy-based monsters, including ghosts, grunts, demons, lobbers, sorcerers and thieves. Each enters the level through specific generators, which can be destroyed.

title: Bearied Treasure

After each wave you have time to find bombs and healing box. Try to be the partisan, won't be easy, liquidate all your enemies one by one.

title: Clash of Warlord Orcs
description: Clash of Warlord Orcs an action-packed fight featuring the warlord orcs! Select the best battle cards and place your orc heroes on the battlefield. Think carefully on your next step in order for you to one by one bring down your enemy's buildings. Choose the right combination of cards and also, do not forget to protect your castle by using spells and defensive orcs. Check on the green power bar at the bottom of the screen, and when you already have enough power, you can now release your warriors to attack the opponent's base. Once the opponent's base is destroyed, you can place a unit closer to it. There are three kinds of orcs to choose from, and they are infantry, ranged, cavaliers and heavy hitters. Take note that you only have three minutes to destroy your opponent and win the fight successfully. Get ready for a fun-addicting and exciting battle against the orcs!

title: Arcade Darts
description: Arcade Darts is a HTML5 Skill Game. Shoot your darts and aim the center of the target. Hit the bonus symbols to score more points and avoid the bombs!

title: Bikosaur
description: You're a dinosaur that rides a bicycle. Collect steaks to feed your family. Grab power-up items, and go as far as possible to beat the highest score.Beware of obstacles, and... Angry kitties!

title: Ante Hero
description:
The king had wealth, and power, but he wanted more. He wanted to live forever. To this end, he made a deal with devils—his lifespan would be tied to his wealth. The more money he possessed, the longer he would live.
In his pursuit of immortality, the king began to ransack his own kingdom. To this day he sends his monsters, looting and pillaging from helpless citizens, stacking his gold ever higher.
Protect the village, reclaim its gold, and eventually… take down the greed-fueled king.

title: Rebellious Robots
description:
In the distant future, the world has many economic and environmental problems. The technology of virtual reality has evolved so much that everyone is trying to escape from its difficult situation in real life.
The creator of this virtual world was a utopian and at first tried to create a perfect world without health problems or wealth, but it did not work. Human nature was too strong.
Disappointed, he decided to create this alternative world, where people must fight rebellious robots in virtual arenas for eternity.
Keep in mind that if this is not the reality, your brain believes it and you will really die.
Try to survive this first-person shooter WebGL game with awesome 3D graphics, mad robots, lots of cool weapons to buy, and an adrenaline rush. Enjoy and don't forget to unlock all achievements!

title: Emma Foot Treatment
description: The adorable Emma is always naughty and while her at tennis practice, she slipped down and got injured. Also, she didn’t have manicure for a very long time and she has lots of foot cracks too. This is the time for her to have the best foot care treatment. Could you give her the treatment and make her foot pretty again?

title: Bumper vs Zombies
description:
Who said that apoclaypse should not rhyme with fun? Once again, Y8 games will show you that this is not the case.
Bumper VS Zombies is a WebGL fast-paced action and driving game with nice 3D graphics where you play like a crazy driver with his car and you have to crush as many zombies and whatnot as you can (and as much as you want). Warning: the roads are not what they were and you must also avoid obstacles otherwise it is the explosion assured ...
Fans of supercharged cars and blood fountains will be thrilled!
Buy more efficient cars or pimp them with upgrades to make them stronger and have fun trying to get the best highscore and all the achievements!
Enjoy!

title: Princess Foot Doctor
description: Oh! Princess had a severe foot injury and infection suddenly on her leg. She is feeling heavy pain.So please help her recover from this infection and pain. And then make her happy by giving her an awesome foot care and decorate it with accessories and matching shoes. Have Fun!

title: Hexa Blocks
description: Hexa Blocks is a HTML5 tetris style puzzle game, simple and addictive block puzzle game. There is 2 game mode in this game: Level: Your mission is to reach target score without run out of moves, then next level will be unlocked. The higher the level, the harder it will be. Endless: Fill the grid lines as much as possible and reach high-score!

title: Protect the Kingdom
description: The enemy is upon our Kingdom! They are disciplined and they are many. With their wolves and swordsmen and archers and wizards, they will come at you hard.Build defensive towers on the field, to defend against the enemy. Build strategic towers at advantageous locations.Redeem energy by defeating each enemy. Use energy to build more towers.Don't let the invaders reach your Kingdom! .A variety of towers are unlocked as you progress. Use them strategically to win each level.

title: Solitaire Grande
description: Classic Klondike solitaire game with style. You can choose between 1-card or 3-card draw. Unlock achievements and earn coins to try out beautiful themes. Instructions and unlimited hints and undos included!

title: Dunk Shot
description: Dunk Shot is the super addictive arcade game in which you must score baskets with the free-falling basketball. You will earn points for every basket you make successfully. The baskets will be higher in the sky each time, score basket to basket to earn points. If you miss your shot the ball will fall out of the sky and you will have start all over again. Try to aim for the perfect shot and swish the basketballs without touching the rim for an added bonus. As you earn starts you will be able to buy cool new basketball skins to help you score in style. Have fun!

title: Motocross Trials
description:
Motocross Trials is a WebGL game from Y8 Games with impressive 3D graphics and incredible physics.
In this game, you have to prove your skills by controlling a motocross racer in various very rough and dangerous terrains filled with ramps to make flips and other stunts.
One error ... and you will fall. Heavily.
To prove that you are the best, you must try to get 3 stars in each level, but that is not enough: you must have the best highscore and get all the achievements. This is the only way to enter in the Hall of Fame! Enjoy!

title: Truck Trials
description: Get into your awesome monster truck, crush obstacles and reach the finish line as fast as you can! In this cool side-scrolling truck challenge it's all about your driving skills. You’ll definitely want to choose a super awesome rig before you get started on the crazy challenges.

title: Bus Parking 3D
description: Test your parking skills at each level of this 3D parking game, Bus Parking 3D! Do your best to perfectly park that bus and to avoid obstacles along the way, just to avoid start over again and again.

title: Command Ant Conquer
description:
Winter is coming and the ant colonies are preparing for gathering food.Unfortunately, there's not enough for everyone this year... conflict is approaching.
Assume the role of a majestic ant queen and command your forces to conquer Ant Island.

title: Sun Wukong vs Robot
description: Play trough to the old Chinese legend where you help Sun Wukong to fight against monsters and robots in a retro adventure platformer, the classic Nintendo style. Travel from one cave to another while you use ancient fighting technique and lethal Chinese attacks.

title: Halloween Horror Massacre
description: Halloween is near and also cold and spooky nights come along! Even monsters get cold at nights and have to add wood to the furnace. Be quick and avoid approaching branches! Unlock new characters and gain medals. It's time to chop!

title: Space Shooter: Search For The Devastator
description: Battle against giant asteroids and enemy ships. Fight bosses, gain new upgrades after each battle. Can you reach to the devastator and defeat it?

title: Island Dodge
description: Survival game on an island.

title: Run Bunny Run!
description: Run Bunny Run is a cute but challenging endless runner! A small bunny shows the world how far it can run. Bunny will run on its own, but if you see a gap, help Bunny jump over it by clicking/tapping anywhere on the screen. If you see a flower before a gap, you can still help Bunny jump, but this time you won´t know where Bunny will land. So watch its next steps carefully. Bunny likes carrots, and it will eat any carrot it runs across. They are tasty but will make Bunny run faster...

title: Geometry Tower
description: Build a tower of different figures and make sure they won't fall off. Collect stars and have fun!

title: Adam and Eve: Golf
description:
Adam and Eve: Golf is another installment of the Adam and Eve game series and this time Adam has found himself a stick to hit a ball around with. He keeps trying to get it into the hole in as little hits as possible, wait, this sounds a lot like golf! Perhaps he invented it all those years ago without even realizing.
This fun golf game requires to aim carefully and control your power to hit the ball into the hole, the more shots that you take the lower your score will be. There will be hazardous objects and obstacles to avoid so make sure that you aim carefully to get the ball into the hole. Have fun!

title: Stallion's Spirit
description: Hop on your favorite horse who will help you to win the race. You can choose one of the three horses that are champions in the races. Bronco , Steeder and Mustang will help you to win the rides in each new track, use the lasso to slow down the competitors. Good luck!

title: Cargo Crime Shooter
description: Welcome to another one FPS game, where your task is to stop the Cargo Crime and survive the waves of a criminal army which come against you. Grab the weapons and ammo and find the best position, because you are exposed from every sides.

title: Maze Lover
description: This is a romantic puzzle game where boy has to reach to his girl. As usual, there are many obstacles between both of them. Boy will have to survive from enemies. he has to face tricky ways to reach to her. After all these obstacles, he has to beat the time as well. this game is the pack of fun and entertainment.

title: Linker Hero
description: The monsters attack your kingdom: attack them, defeat them and become a hero! Armed with your little sword, you are not afraid to go into battle. In this strategy and matching game, you will have to connect identical symbols, remove them from the game and use their powers. Thus, you can increase your attack, your defense, or even your magic when your turn comes. Hurry, time is limited, and your enemy is waiting for only one thing: revenge! Defeat each monster and evolve your little hero between two battles. Good luck to everyone!

title: Happy Panda
description: In this cute animal makeover game you have to help a little baby panda. The cheeky bear has made a mess eating lots of chocolate. Clean its fur and feed it with its favorite snack to make it happy again. Afterwards, you can customize your little buddy and create your favorite fantasy panda. Color its fur and select a beautiful outfit for a party with its friends!

title: Burnin' Rubber: Cartapult
description: Cars are meant for a hassle-free transportation that can take you anywhere most especially on some long land trips. Burnin' Rubber: Cartapult is a catapult type of game where you will be throwing a car to attack the city and those cool vehicles. It's a physics-based destruction game where you will be shooting as many targets as possible such as buildings, cars, blimps, etc.

title: Adam the Ghost
description: Help Adam to scare as many people as possible. He is new in this role and needs your hand. Enjoy this lovely small game with your favourite character Adam.

title: Adam 'N' Eve: The Love Quest
description:
Adam has managed to create a potent and deadly love potion with which he can attract females and find his perfect Eve. The only problem is, is that he can’t use it as he has lost the potion and you must help him recover it!
You must help Adam recover his potion and find his true love! As usual, you must interact with the various objects on the screen and help Adam find a path through each level. Think logically and look at the different objects and characters and how they may interact. If you enjoy this episode, then why not try one of the other titles?

title: Apple Shooter
description: Apple Shooter is an HTML5 archery game that will test your skills as an Indian warrior. Being a sharp-shooter is what this game needs since the life of your friend depends on how well you target the apple. Every time you hit the apple, the distance between you and your friend will be farther. Also, there will be some sort of a barricade to make the difficulty more advanced. Your friend's life is at risk. There's no room for mistakes so be brave and be sharp enough to target the apple and try not to kill your dear friend. Take your time in controlling the power and direction of the bow to perfect the shot and save your friend. You can play this exciting game on your mobile phones such as iPhone, Android, and even on your iPads, cool right? Play this addicting game and become an amazing Indian warrior!

title: Go Kart Pro
description: Welcome to Go Kart Pro, a WebGL kart racing game with cute graphics and adorable characters. This game can be played in two modes, single player and the multiplayer. In single player, you will have to finish every race in first place in order for you to unlock all the characters and new tracks. Each character has a unique custom kart which has a special power-up. These power-ups will give you that winning edge to finish the game. Get all the coins for added points. Unlock all the achievements and get the highest score to be in the leaderboard! You can have fun playing against your friends in the multiplayer mode. Select the kart that you like and create the room for your friends to be in. See which of you can be the kart king!

title: Animal Shapes 3
description: Have fun playing this puzzle, fun, animal game in which your main goal is to place the pieces of animal in the right stations in way to assemble the jigsaw and complete the animal which you have chosen.

title: Sector Defender
description: You and your survived army friends are stuck in zombies ambush, where the furious zombies and monsters coming your way.  Try to kill all the zombies and survive for the next wave. The only rule here not to be eaten and stay alive as long as possible!

title: Crescent Solitaire Html5
description: Crescent Solitaire is an exciting new take on the classic game, played with two decks. Can you control the chaos of the crescent?

title: Soldiers Combat
description: Soldiers Combat is a action packed game with 8 LevelsTo clear each level you have to collect hidden keys which you can get under a box or from enemies. Collect more and more coins to unlock awesome guns and characters. Use Machine gun, bazooka, heat and cold gun to destroy the enemies.Be a real soldier. Start playing "Soldiers Combat"

title: Dark Times
description: You are in the dark world where the dark creatures, thirsty for blood and human creatures are ruled, and your goal is to grab the weapon aim and shoot on this bloodthirsty creatures. Waves are separated by time, which you can use to collect ammo and health and find the best position for the next wave.

title: Bubble Monsters
description: A simple bubble shooting game that you need to shoot and match the same colors but first, you need to select your cute monster. After finishing a certain level, you will receive a coins which you can use for purchasing another type of pet. After that, you will select the pet you want and fill the gauge seen at the upper left to proceed to another stage. Each pet has a power ups when it's full you can use it by clicking them.

title: Find Differences Bunny
description: Fun game "Bunny" helps to develop concentration of attention. Bunny has a lot of wonderful gifts, you will definitely want to see all his surprises.

title: Eternalist Beta
description: You are a simple human, a mortal weak creature, wanting to become a god. So you start hunting them, stealing their powers— to become one of them!

title: Wow Words
description:
Fun and educational game. Connect letters and form words. 30 levels to complete.
Drag and make connection between letters. Complete all words to proceed to the next level.

title: The Four Eyed Creature
description: You are an alien with 4 eyes who just crashed his spaceship on a planet. Hopefully you find a garage which propose a new one to whoever is able to finish their new deadly escape room.

title: Horse Racing 3D
description: Take your chances, test your luck and place your bets on this Horse Racing game. Trust your guts on which horse you think that will take you to victory. Will you be as lucky as the others whose name are in the leaderboard?

title: Fixed Point In Space
description:
Your ship's Light Speed Bypass Drive has suddenly stopped working, and the culprit appears to be a swarm of gravity anomalies.
You'll need to shoot them to avoid having your ship destroyed, but unfortunately they've also broken your targeting system such that you're always aiming at a single fixed point in space.
Position your ship at the correct angle to hit these gravity anomalies, and see how long you can last.

title: Cyber Basket
description: Cyber Basket is a challenging new skill game that tests your aim and quick-thinking. Dodge obstacles and harness a series of air guns to dunk a constantly falling basketball through the hoops. If your ball hits an obstacle it’s game over. You’ll want to play again and again to hone your skills and improve your score.

title: Block Up!
description: Do you enjoy games that test your reflexes and quick thinking? Then the BlockUp reaction game is for you. Move your block up the screen as a series of multi-coloured blocks scrolls down. Every time you think you’ve got it down, the blocks speed up and your challenge becomes more and more difficult.

title: Adam 'N' Eve: Sleepwalker
description: Adam is sleepwalking in the ice cold night. Help him to get back into the bed.

title: Adam 'N' Eve 4
description:
Adam and Eve 4 game is a fun and addictive Point & Click adventure game where you have to help Adam find his new beloved, Eve (the fourth!).
To do this, you will have to solve puzzles, interact with characters and objects, and explore various locations. The game is full of humor and surprises, and will take you on a journey through time to a funny prehistoric era where dinosaurs rubbed shoulders with humans.
Whether you're a fan of the series or new to the game, you'll love Adam and Eve 4!

title: Adam 'N' Eve: Zombies
description:
Adam and Eve: Zombies is another superb adventure from this fantastic series. You may not think that zombies exist in the prehistoric era, but in this game they certainly do! You must once again control Adam and help him through a series of levels to defeat the evil zombie cats (yes cats can be zombies!)
During each level you must solve a series of puzzle and help Adam destroy or evade the cats. Think quickly and look at how you could use different objects to help our hero escape. Simply click on an object to interact with it. Move quickly and keep an eye on any advancing zombie cats - if they catch up with you the game is over and you must restart the level! Can you complete every mission and reunite Adam with his Eve whilst avoiding the Zombie Cats?

title: Yin and Yang
description: Rejoin Yin and Yang by removing connected bricks. Connect 3 or more of the same bricks to remove them. You can connect bricks vertically or horizontally.

title: Wizard Jewels
description: Fun combination of 3 different match 3 mechanics: collapse, swap and connect. You can switch between the 3 game modes. In the first phase of this game you have to remove all grey backgrounds. In the second phase you have to guide the golden key to the keyhole. Rotate the game when needed with the arrows in view or the arrow keys.

title: Falling Candy
description: Candy is falling down: remove it before it clutters your screen. Get 3 or more of the same Candies in a row (horizontally, vertically or diagonally) to remove the candies. Use the arrows or arrow keys to move the candies around or to change the order of the falling candies.

title: Green Slaughter
description: Green Slaughter is a action shooter, take control of a elite soldier as you battle against reptiles that had taken over the world. Use your weapons and save the world.

title: BFF Floss Dance
description: The floss dance has taken over the world and the princesses are trying to learn it! Moana already knows its moves and she created a step-by-step guide for her BFFs to learn it too! Elsa and Ariel are eager to learn how floss but how about you? Will you join princess Moana dance class? Come on! It’s so easy once you’ve learned the basic moves, it’s fun, not to mention challenging for parents so let’s do it! Join the girls in getting the ‘BFF Floss Dance’ game started and first of all learn how to correctly perform each element of choreography making sure to also help Ariel and Elsa to do their part. Once you’ve mastered that, you can then try to do a synchronized floss dance together with our main characters but not before dressing them up! Browse through their sporty chic wardrobe and select your favorite top, pair of shorts or mini skirts, sneakers and cool accessories and create a colorful look for each girls! Now the only thing left to do is to see if Moana’s students will be able to do the floss. Go to the next page of the game and watch! Have fun playing the ‘BFF Floss Dance’ game for girls!

title: Burning Man Hairstyles
description: Our girl is so interested in attending the Burning Man Festival this year and she could your precious helping hand to properly prepare for it! This fun event takes place once a year when tens of thousands gather in Nevada’s the Black Rock Desert to create Black Rock City, a temporary metropolis dedicated to community, art, self-expression, and self-reliance. But before moving in there for eight full days she needs to deal with her festival hairstyle and with her statement outfits too so here if where your expert hands are needed, first as a hairstylist and secondly as a fashion adviser! Now if you are ready to start dealing with her iconic festival looks, come and join her in getting the ‘Burning Man Hairstyles’ game for girls started and take a closer look at all the options available at your disposal in your exclusive game! In terms of hairstyles, you have three options: select your favorite and then move to the next page of the game and step-by-step prepare her hair for the styling process, then style it up in the desired hairstyle and make sure to add a pop of color to her strands while using this season’s popular washable hair dye. Next you get to choose her statement outfit! There are many daring clothing pieces available in her festival wardrobe… feel free to play with all your favorite pieces and make sure you come up with a mind-blowing festival look for her. Don’t forget to also accessorize! Have a great time playing the ‘Burning Man Hairstyles’ Game for girls!

title: Snake Mania
description: Travel from island to island in the skill game Snake Mania, and try to collect all the coins. You must eat all of the coins with your snake in order to open the gates that lead to the next floating island. One false move can end your winning streak, so stay focused and be careful!

title: Fruit Pop
description: Match up the fruit and complete the level objectives in Fruit Pop, a fun and addictive match-3 game! Click on a piece of fruit and draw a line through all the identical pieces you can link up horizontally, vertically, and diagonally. Long combinations not only score lots of extra points, they also earn you handy-dandy booster bombs!

title: Monster Slumber Party Funny Faces
description: Elsa’s funny faces slumber party surely had inspired some people out there and I’m not talking only about Elsa’s fans but also about these Monster High ghouls who are having their own crazy pyjama party as well! Care to join them in? This weekend Draculaura, Lagoona Blue, Frankie Stein and you are going to have so much fun! So hurry up and join the ghouls in getting the ‘Monster Slumber Party Funny Faces’ dress up games for girls started and begin by selecting some colourful pajamas for each cutie pie here. Browse though their impressive collection of colourful pajamas with playful prints or garnished with super feminine details like lace, ruffles or bows and then select your favorites to first dress up Frankie Stein, then Draculaura and Lagoona Blue! Complete the chosen slumber party looks with a matching pair of slippers. Once you’re done you can then go to the second page of the game to see what happens next: Draculaura wakes up in the middle of the night with this crazy idea to cover the other two girl’s faces in a funny design. Of course you are going to help her out with it and even more… she’s going to draw something of your choice.

title: Descendants Hair Salon
description: Hehe, great news friends! Our hair salon series continues with another super fun hair-styling session and today your clients are none other than your favorite characters from the famous Descendants du Mal series: Evie, Mal and Loonie. The girls are getting ready to film some new episodes for the famous series and they need their colourful hair locks to be styled as nicely as possible. Can you help them out, ladies? In the ‘Descendants Hair Salon’ game for girls you get to recreate Evie’s signature braids, add some pinks highlights in Mal’s purple hair and create some lovely loose curls in Lonnie’s hair. So hurry up to join your favorite characters in, decide who is going to be the first to enjoy a professional hairstyling session and begin by washing your client’s hair with a delicate shampoo. Don’t forget to apply a nourishing hair mask as well and to use the hairdryer in order to prepare it for the styling process. Use the right tools to arrange it as your client desires and then go to the next page of the game to select an outfit to complement your client’s new haircut. Have a great time playing the ‘Descendants Hair Salon’ game for girls!

title: GTX Racing 2018
description: Grab your favorite car and race with other. You can earn money by finishing a game and winning the race. Use the money to upgrade your car or you will buy a new one which is faster than before. You can also buy a color for your car to make it looks cool. Enjoy the race and fasten your seat belt.

title: Beaver Bomber
description: You take on the role of a beaver who wants to destroy as many bridges as possible. Arrange the mess!

title: Return to the West
description: The zombies are coming to get you brains. Go and grab some weapons located on the area to defend your self against them. In order to get them down easily, shoot their heads. Run as fast as you can when they are near and don't let them get you. Each wave their count will get bigger and you will be facing not only a zombies but a humans with weapons so be careful.

title: Ice Cream Bar Html5
description: Serve the correct ice cream orders as fast as possible. Click on the requested ingredients in the correct order. Click on the ice cream when you are finished.

title: Dead Dungeon
description: Suddenly, you woke up inside the dungeon with nobody is around except the walking dead. You must survive in this dungeon. In order to do that, you must get geared up. You can get sword and shield inside the dungeon to defend and attack enemies in melee. To use a range attack, you must get the bow and arrow. Defeat them all and survive till the last of them.

title: Halloween Monster
description: This Halloween monster game is a tap based game. here we have to tap the screen to make our player jump. at the same time, we have to take care of our player that player should not collide with any obstacle.

title: Zombie Smash
description: In this game, you have to be very quick smashing the zombies before they get you. You can collect power ups such us the red fly swatter to smash them all and the clock to make them slow. You can get also a lightning power ups to prevent them passing. Smash them all and get the highest possible score.

title: Valentines Match3
description: The game is simple, you need to connect and match all the same heart's color. The more color you are connecting, it gives more time for you. If you match only pair of three, it will not add time bonus. So, you have to make it quick before the time runs out or else the game is over.

title: Swipes
description: The aim of this game is to get the possible highest score by swiping the correct color. When they drop the orbs, swipe it into their correct colors. But be careful, the black orbs are kinda tricky, once the this is dropped do not swipe and just let it pass. Enjoy!

title: Super Titagon
description: Can you able to keep up the fast rotating walls? Prove it then. Find a way to not bump on the walls by holding the mouse click button. Use your mouse skill to survive those fast moving walls. Get a score as much as you can and get the high score to pop your name in the leader board.

title: Pineapple Pen Master
description: Be a sharp-shooter and hit the pineapple with your sharp knife. Be careful with the dancing man because he can drag you and change your position.

title: Breakfast for Mom
description: Learn how to make a simple surprise breakfast for your mom, with following the steps in this game. First step is to prepare the mixture for pancakes, then bake them. When you are finished with pancakes, chop and bake the bacon and eggs. In the end you need to decorate the tray table with flower and the food decoration.

title: Flirting Masquerade
description: This girl will late, if you don't help her prepare for the masquerade tonight. Under the mask is easy to find some cute face for flirting, so don't wait, start with makeover treatments and face mask, make her skin shiny. Choose the makeup for her like real stylist and continue to the next steps, where is needed to find the perfect hairstyle and masquerade costume. She need to be a super attractive because her mission is to flirt with some handsome guy at the party.

title: Beer Pushing
description: Beer Pushing is an HTML5 game where you have to slide your mouse or finger on the screen to push the beer mug to the target area. Try to push with the first try in the marked place, the different pots with beer. Mug, bottle, glass is full with beer, careful with your swiping, you have only 5 tries. Good luck.

title: The Last Room
description: You are the last survival on the Earth. The air is too polluted. You have to defend the last tree and survive as long as you can. Avoid getting caught by the pollutants Stay close to the tree to get enough oxygen to survive.

title: Path
description: Find the path through this scenic and simple world

title: Smiles Match3
description: Smiles Match3 is a game which you will have to connect and match those the same smileys within a limited time. Hence, you can add more time bonus if you will match a more than three smileys which can give you an opportunity to earn more score. If your time runs out, then the game is over.

title: Mai-Chan's Sweet Buns
description: The 4 cards at the bottom of the screen represent the orders of Mai-Chan's customers. Each customer wants a specific number of a single type of pastry. Our task is to find and select a line of pastries on the board that matches one of the cards. We can select vertical or horizontal lines. But it needs to be an uninterrupted line of the same pastry.

title: Jelly Crush Match
description: Jelly crush match is a game which you will match the same jellies and pair them by a minimum of three jellies. It's not that quiet easy because when the time bar seen at the bottom becomes empty, the game is over. You had to be more quickly and do a match more than three jellies to add more time.

title: Kizi Kart
description: Rev up your engines and race through the wonderful world of Kizi Kart! Choose from the characters Kizi, Kissi, Spike, Tito or Gary. Each character has a very unique vehicle with different max speed, acceleration, weapon power and resistance. There are three tournaments namely Star Course, Rocket Race and Kizi Cup. Every tournament has 5 courses to finish and you need to be on top of the race so you can unlock the next course. In every course there are a lot of obstacles that you need to overcome. There are also power ups that you can use for your advantage. Collect all the coins for added bonus. Unlock all 5 courses so you can play the next tournament!  This HTML5 racing game is a game that everybody will love, from its cute graphics, adorable characters and to its challenging racing tracks! Play this game now and see how fast you can finish every track of the game!

title: Gunblood Remastered
description: Gun down opponents in the western world of Gunblood Remastered! A modernized version of the immensely popular Gunblood.

title: Grindcraft Remastered
description: Grindcraft remastered is a new and improved version of a Minecraft-inspired clicker game named Grindcraft. Start with wood production. It will help you create a digger so you will be able to collect different kinds of items such as stone, wood or gold and also, organize your resources to craft a new full range of Minecraft items like tools and structures. Mine different kinds of resources from the overworld.  Everything should be organized specially the basic ones because it is needed to build more complex tools. Once you already have the basic tools that are necessary to find iron, gold, etc., you now have the ability to build more advanced constructions and build better and stronger weapons. You can also hire first villagers that can help you work faster. Get all the needed items and plan out on how to make your tools more advanced. Have fun playing this minecraft-inspired game!

title: Shamaniac
description: Shamaniac is a fun HTML5 puzzle game that will test your investigative skills! You’ll be welcomed by an old Tree-Shaman who’s expecting you because he was warned by the constellation. He will tell some revelations about you but first you need to find his five little assistants. There are pieces of the puzzles that are scattered around. You need to find what fits where and understand the codes. You also need to memorize sequences of sounds. You better find the logic in every puzzle in order for you to release or find the five little assistants that will be placed on the hole that surrounds the Tree-Shaman. If ever you find yourself lost, you can always get some tip by ringing the bell that is hanging on the tree. After placing all the five assistants in their rightful place, give the Tree-Shaman his propheticstick and he will then say the chants and then deliver your revelations! He will tell you what you should meditate on, his assistants’ advice, your kind of magic, the animal that symbolizes you, your element and color. This fun puzzle game also brings you the magic eyed ball in where you can ask random questions. You can even unlock 12 medals as you play along this very enjoying game. Play now and see what your revelations are!

title: Bubble Touch
description: The task of this game is to blast the bubbles. There are some bubbles float, but inside they are bring bomb and you need to avoid them. Don't let to float away the clear bubbles and the bubbles with hearts inside. Be fast click the bubbles and earn points for your score.

title: Bubblegum Tricks
description: Bubblegum Tricks is an HTML5 mouse skill game where you need to pop the bubblegum on the target circumference.

title: Christmas Match 3 Html5
description: Make as many matches as you can in this fun Christmas themed match 3 game. Click and pull to match 3 or more same shapes. You are limited to the time, 30 seconds start with counting immediately when the game will start. Enjoy.

title: Crazy Parking Html5

Play this WebGL game, Monster Invasion, now and see if you can defeat the leader of the pack!

title: Raging Punch 3D

Defeat all your enemies to get to the next level. Your opponent will increase in numbers as you progress in the game making it harder to survive. Play this game now and unlock all the achievements and see if you can ever be in the leaderboard!

title: Super Scary Stacker
description:
Super Scary Stacker is a fun puzzle stacking game with an amazing and spooky Halloween theme. The aim of the game is simple – you must stack various spooky objects on top of each other in succession and they must hold for a certain amount of time without falling over. Each level presents a different selection of Halloween shapes, from hexagonal monsters to triangular pumpkins and square zombies.
The blocks must be stacked perfectly and you must look at the next objects to decide the best way to stack them together to create a stable structure. With over 50 different levels to play this game is a huge amount of fun and will keep you entertained for hours. The theme is cool and the gameplay and sounds are brilliant. Can you stack the spooky objects in time?

title: Wire
description:
Wire is a fantastic game of skill and reflexes – you control a wire that continually scrolls across the screen; by clicking your mouse, you must make the wire move up and down to avoid the different obstacles in your path. At the start of the level, you are notified of which color objects you must avoid – pay attention to this otherwise you will fail!
For example, you may start with a white color wire, and the message may state “Avoid anything dark”. This means that your wire can pass through any obstacle with a light color, but cannot pass through anything that is black – if you try and pass the wire through a black obstacle you will have to restart the level. You can also collect alien tokens as you progress – there are 100 in total, can you collect them all? This game will truly challenge your skill and concentration, how far can you take the wire?

The candy will pop and vanish from the grid, and the other sweets will come tumbling down to fill the open cells. Can you gather all the candy you need before you run out of moves?

The mad professor has conducted a crazy scientific experiment and has ended up zapping his own mind into his pet hamster's body. The professor wants to know whether he's still as brainy as before, so he's come up with a way to test his mental abilities. Will he be able to find his way through the mazes while rolling around in his hamster ball? The professor is brimming with enthusiasm, but as it turns out he will likely need a little bit of guidance from you to find the exit.

Pick two adjacent gems and make them swap places to line up three or more of the same color. You can make rows or columns when you match up the identical gems. Those gems will vanish, leaving space for new gems to come tumbling down. The gems you've collected will also be subtracted from the counter displayed at the top of the grid. Make sure you gather all the gems you need to complete each level.

Kicks are automatic when the ball hits your legs, and you can use your players body to defend or attack the ball.
