title: Extreme Battle Pixel Royale
description: Extreme Battle Pixel Royale is a first person multiplayer 3D shooting game. It has cool voxel graphics and a lot of fun and interesting maps to choose from. Create a room, set the time of play and numbers of players in the room and the game mode. Choose between Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch or Zombies. Select from the list avatars, Mercenary, SWAT or even Zombies. Kill as many as you can and earn money. Use that in purchasing items for your character customization or even buy and upgrade your weapons. Play now and dominate the game!

title: Kumba Kool
description: Join Kumba the ape in this exciting sidecroller and run, jump and fly with him through dangerous worlds to earn as many points as possible! Avoid obstacles and enemies on your way and try to go as far as you can. Collect coins for bonus points and pick up helpful power ups which transform your hero and give you an extra boost. Are you ready for the adventure?

title: Rival Rush
description: Become king of the road and master all levels! In this racing game, it's all about your skills - navigate your way through heavy traffic at full speed. Dodge cars and avoid accidents at all costs. Keep an eye on other vehicles changing lanes and use gaps to your advantage. If you get hit more than 3 times, the game is over. Can you beat all levels with 3 stars?

title: Pirates of Islets
description: ARGH! Pirates of Islets is a fantastic pirate adventure. Jump with Captain P' from islet to islet and carry off coins, power-ups and treasure chests filled with gold. Collect as many as possible on your way to the highest score and unlock new characters, power-ups and a new map. Prove your skills and show us a real pirate.

title: NoooooMan
description: Every victim has a protector…. control the most powerful Hero that you could imagine. NoooooMan sacrifices his life to save innocents. His power Nooooo is able to slow time, and throwing cutlery can resolve any dangerous situation.

title: Boj Giggly Park Adventure
description: Explore Giggly Park with Boj and friends. Boj is an award winning kids television series worldwide. Do wonderful things such as ride a bike, climb the tree, fly a kite, dig underground for treasures, ride the swing, control a helicopter remotely and more. Interact with various characters from the Boj universe, such as Mimi, Pops, Mr Cloppity, Denzil, Mia Twitch and more. This is a new and innovative game-play to encourage users to explore their curiosity.

title: Barrel Roll
description: Barrel Roll is an exciting game about rolling a ball into a dark tunnel and your goal is to reach the end of the tunner. Roll around and collect tokens while avoiding crashing into those lighted barriers. Speed up the ball and unlock stuff in this endless real-physics arcade survival game. Enjoy playing Barrel Roll game here at Y8.com!

title: Knight of Light
description: Knight of Light is a puzzle game where you try to lighten the shadow of the world. move like the light! fight like the light! collect the light and purify the shadow the light is easy to control hard to master. Purify the shadow with your ability to master the light.

title: Motorbike Simulator
description: Choose your motorbike, drive around or perform insane stunts. Feel free to do whatever you want.

title: 1000 Blocks
description: How many levels can you beat in this addictive puzzle game? In 1000 Blocks your task is to place different shapes on the grid and clear all stone blocks to complete a level. Position the shapes strategically to build horizontal or vertical lines. Only full lines are removed from the field. Use the lucky wheel once per level in case you don't have any moves left and win a power-up which can help you remove additional tiles. As a last resort, you can pick a free shape and place it on the grid. Try to finish as many levels as possible and achieve a high score!

title: Around the World: African Patterns
description: Discover the amazing history of Africa and it's beautiful artistic fashion. Play with the combinations of clothes, try the accessories and make Noelle look awesome with the proper make up.

title: Tomoko's Kawaii Phone
description: Oh no, what an accident! Tomoko's lovely phone got broken when she dropped it. Let's help her fix it! Carefully clean her phone, then replace the screen by opening up the phone and adding in the new glass. Then it's time to have fun decorating. Choose a color for the phone, add some kawaii accessories and turn the phone on either side to choose your favorite case for it. So cute!

title: Music Festival Party
description: Let's get the party started! Crystal, Olivia and Natalie are going to go to a music festival party and you get to organize the event, pick out decorations, and help them get dressed up with some lovely festival fashion. Put on some music to dance to, play with colored spray cans, and take a picture so they can remember this awesome concert!

title: Legendary Fashion: Hollywood Blonde
description: Legendary Fashion Icon Marilyn Monroe once said “we are all of us stars, and we deserve to twinkle”! So become a star and discover the glamorous life of a Hollywood blonde in the 1950s. Pick the perfect make-up for the beautiful actress and choose from several iconic dresses and hairstyles. Are you ready for your close-up?

title: Candy Land Dreams
description: The girls had the most awesome dream! Escape with them in Candy Land, a place of fairy tales and sweets. Help them decorate the dream land with delicious candies, and then, dress them up so the three girls look fantastic!

title: Frozen for Christmas
description: Freeze all the Elves to save Christmas. Use the arrow keys and space bar or the on-screen controls to control Santa.

title: Boj Coloring Book
description: Showcase your creativity via this coloring book, featuring Boj and friends. A fun, all-digital and reusable coloring book built for kids, parents and pre-school institutions. Features: - Multiple Boj themed templates to start with - Choose different brush sizes and colors - Save your works and print them. This feature is great for classrooms - Color interesting characters from the Boj universe, including Boj the Bilby himself, Mimi, Pops, Denzil, Mr Cloppity, Mia Twitch, Julie Twitch and more.

title: KickBlips
description: Welcome in this skateboard adventure, where you need to avoid the obstacles which are on your way, and try to collect the coins. Move up and down between the trees, jump the garbage bins, mailboxes and collect the coins.

title: Dumb Ways JR: Zany's Hospital
description: Before the Dumb Ways characters grew up, they were already making mischief in all sorts of places – planes, trains, and now at the hospital! Visit the cute and colourful Dumb Ways Hospital with Doctor Zany, and explore three main areas of play: a waiting room full of surprises to discover, a check-up room where children can play the role of doctor, and an ambulance that visits the hospital featuring fun guest appearances from the original Dumb Ways cast! This game engages young children in a playful experience of caring for others. Join Doctor Zany any help keep the Dumb Ways characters safe, happy and healthy!

title: Gold Mine Strike Christmas
description: Gold Mine Strike Christmas brings a new way of playing Gold Strike with a Christmas flavor. Throw candy canes, get rid of packages and use power ups to enhance your progress. The gold you acquire is used to upgrade the power ups.

title: Single Winter Battle Royale
description: Prepare to drop on military aircraft and carry out a dangerous reconnaissance mission on a strange snow mountain enemy base camp. Use your soldier's stealth combat skills for battle and survival as you engage enemy forces.

title: Double Date Html5
description: Ariel and Anna have a double date with their boyfriends. But before going to the movies they need to get beautiful. Take a look at their wardrobe and dress them beautifully!

title: Eliza Christmas Night
description: For the Christmas night Eliza want to be near the fireplace, wearing clothes with Christmas prints and accessories which are recognize for the season. Everything in the Christmas spirit. Make her choice easy, combine the colors and she will be happy. At the end, decorate her room also in the Christmas spirit. Enjoy.

title: Rise up Anime Edition
description: Rise Up in the Air – Manga edition is one of the most challenging and fun games of 2018. Totally free ! Rise up and protect your character with your light ball while it’s rising up! Be aware of the obstacles. Use your finger to move your light ball to protect your character from the object falling from the sky. In the game you can collect some gold to unlock awesome and very fun characters :) ! Clear your way as you rise up in the air !

title: Black
description:
𝗕𝗹𝗮𝗰𝗸 is a minimalistic puzzle game created by 𝗕𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲. In this game, your goal is to turn the entire screen black. Each level presents a unique challenge, and you'll need to think outside the box to solve them. The game features over 𝟮𝟱 𝗯𝗲𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗳𝘂𝗹𝗹𝘆-𝗰𝗿𝗮𝗳𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗽𝘂𝘇𝘇𝗹𝗲𝘀, each with its own logic.
If you get stuck, feel free to use the light bulb button that appears in the top-right corner for hints. There are multiple hints available for each level, so make sure to read them all. How quickly can you complete all 25 levels and conquer Black?

title: Ruya Demo
description: It features 8 of the 64 levels in Ruya. The full game features lots more content, 8 worlds with unique soundtracks, unlockable dreams with an ending!

title: Solitaire Classic Christmas
description: Winter is coming, so get comfy and relax with a cute Christmas version of the timeless card classic during the holiday season! Objective of this Solitaire Klondike game is to move all cards onto the four foundation piles, sorted by suit and rank in ascending order from Ace to King. On the field, cards can only be sorted in descending order alternating colors. Can you earn a high score?

title: Happy Dog
description: Take care of a cute little puppy! Play with her in the garden and clean her dirty fur afterwards to make it look fluffy and shiny again. Feed the adorable pet and style her for a party with her friends. Select a new color and pattern for her fur and apply cute accessories to create a unique look for your sweet dog. Finally, decorate the house and the garden and make your puppy completely happy!

title: Christmas Costume
description: The holiday season is just around the corner and you're not feeling it yet? This adorable dress up game will get you in the mood for Christmas! Combine tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, accessories and many more items to create your favorite outfit. Finish your look with a matching hairstyle, make-up and a cute hat and be the star at every Christmas party!

title: Fresdoka
description:
Run, shoot, punch and fight against great enemies.
Choose your favorite character, the best weapon and become the best player in Fresdoka! You can enjoy playing solo, shooting zombies and hiding from soldier enemies.

title: RC2 Super Racer
description: Here is another one chapter of the exciting racing game that lets you race against other players RC2 Super Racer. You have the freedom to choose your own car, race track and laps. Collect the surprise box in the race, they can be sure advantages against your opponents. Enjoy!

title: Little Pony Caretaker
description: Cutie Pegasus is so tired being the caretaker of all the animals in the palace. She has been so filthy after tending to others and now she wanted some tender love and care too. Fix her up and dress her in a very majestic outfit!. Play Little Pony Caretaker and make this pony into the best that she can be!

title: Ice Queen Beauty Makeover
description: The Ice Queen is feeling under the weather. The only thing that can make her happy again is to give her that great make-over! Give her some pampering facial and then glam her up with make-up. Change her clothes into a magnificent gown suited for a queen like her. Make her that powerful woman whom she really is!

title: Vincy's Lip Care
description: Princess Vincy got her lips infected. She needed some medical care immediately. Could you give her the best medical care and fix her infected lips? Play this game now and give Vincy the make over that she needs!

title: Fashion Contest Preps
description: Our three princesses are preparing for the Fashion Contest Event.Tonight you will take part at a dress up fashion battle where you will see our three princesses fight for first place in the Fashion Gala.Help them prepare for the contest and enjoy the event!

title: Highschool Day

title: Gulper io
description:
Gulper.io is a fun multiplayer snake game where colorful and gluttonous snakes compete to become the biggest on the field. You start small and grow by collecting glowing orbs scattered across the map. Every orb increases your size and score, helping you move higher on the leaderboard.
The main challenge in Gulper.io comes from interacting with other players. You can try to intercept opponents and make them collide with your snake, causing them to disappear and drop everything they collected. This creates exciting moments where quick thinking and smart movement can help you grow much faster. At the same time, you must stay alert, because one wrong move can end your run instantly.
A key rule to remember is that head-to-head collisions are dangerous. If two snakes crash into each other head first, both players are eliminated. This makes positioning and awareness extremely important. Sometimes avoiding a direct confrontation is the smarter choice, especially when you are already large.
What makes Gulper.io stand out is its speed boost ability. You can temporarily move faster to surprise opponents, escape risky situations, or cut off other snakes. Using speed does not cause a major penalty, but it slowly reduces your size over time. This creates an interesting balance between speed and growth, allowing different play styles to succeed.
Some players prefer a careful approach, slowly growing larger and avoiding danger. Others use fast movement and clever positioning to outplay opponents and collect large amounts of orbs quickly. Because of this variety, every match feels different and encourages you to experiment with new strategies.
The visuals are bright and clear, making it easy to track your snake and nearby players. Smooth movement and responsive controls help the game feel fair and enjoyable, even when the action becomes intense. Watching your snake grow longer and climb the leaderboard is satisfying and keeps you motivated to survive longer each time.
Gulper.io is designed for quick play sessions, but it is also easy to stay engaged for longer runs as you chase the top spot. Competing against real players adds excitement and unpredictability, making every game unique.
If you enjoy multiplayer snake games that reward smart movement, timing, and strategy, Gulper.io offers a lively and competitive experience. Collect orbs, use speed wisely, avoid dangerous collisions, and see how high you can climb on the leaderboard.

Defend your base in this survival shooting game, Zone Defender! You need to survive after three minutes of shooting all those creatures. Do not let them inside the red perimeter or else it will deduct your current defense gauge. You need to be fast in eliminating the monsters because once they got in your base it will be hard for you to keep up the pace!
Lock and load now and start shooting, see if you can even survive the longest three minutes of your life!

title: Robber Run
description: Run away from the police. Steal all the gems and coins. Jump over the stacks of tires, wood walls, trash cans and big boulders. Play Robber Run now and see for how long you can run away from the authorities!

description: Noelle has a dentist appointment because she has a tooth ache! Hurry up and help the doctor take care of Noelle's tooth ache. Brush her teeth , take care of her cavity, apply a filling, and distract Noelle so she won't feel a thing. Impress Noelle with your skills as a dentist.

Try on the dresses and outfits and choose the best for each princess. Don't forget to add some accessories that go well with the outfits. With your help, they'll be the loveliest ladies of the Renaissance Fair.

title: Buttons & Scissors Story
description: Buttons & Scissors Story is a fun puzzle game in which you'll have to cut all the buttons from the fabric. You can't cut just one button so better think of a logical move on how you can get rid all the buttons. You'll have to cut the buttons according to their colors. Cut horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Put your thinking caps on and start snipping those colorful buttons out!

title: Barrier
description: In this game you will be formula driver, and your job is to avoid Barriers on the road. How time is up the formula will go faster, so it will be interesting to see your driving skills in this game.

title: Ninja Cat Html5
description: Before you become a true ninja cat, one must finish all the tasks that will hone its skills and will prepare it to be the greatest ninja ever! You need fast reflexes and a clear mind in order to pass all the tests. Finish the test several times to get the best score.

title: 2 for 2
description: Connect the same numbers horizontally or vertically. The value of the number will double when you connect two or more of the same value. Reach the highest possible value without running out of moves. Test your mind if you can play longer in this math puzzle game 2 for 2. Challenge your mind and your reflexes and see if you can bag a spot in the leaderboard!

title: At the Same Time
description: At the Same Time is a challenging puzzle platform game where you will have to control two characters at the same time! Move the characters to the end of the level, make them work together to collect the keys to open the doors. Turn the timer on and see how fast you can complete all 8 levels. Are you ready? Enjoy playing At the Same Time game here at Y8.com!

title: DIY Dress Makeover
description: Victoria just bought some rather dated outfits, and needs you to rework them into fashion-forward dresses! Cut and sew the material, tailor it, add elastic, dye the fabric, apply ribbons and bows, belts and patterns! Impress your friends with your amazing creativity, learn about upcycling for fashion and design your dream dress in DIY Dress Makeover!

title: Garfield Dress Up
description: Garfield decides to spend the vacation with her girlfriend, but it is a little hard for him to choose what outfit looks to wear. He hopes that you can help him. Choose the suitable outfits and accessories for walking outside, touring, entertainment, and have dinner at a restaurant.

title: Gun Box Zombies
description: You are a lone policeman left to fight the zombie apocalypse in Gun Box, the incredibly challenging zombie game that pits you against a horde of zombies with whatever weapon you are lucky enough to lay your hands on. Fight off the zombies and unlock the question marks to pick up your latest weapon, then just hope it and your skills are enough to stay alive.

title: Princesses Relaxing Day
description: ven a princess needs a relaxing day once in a while. You may think that all they do all the time is to relax and have fun, but a princess has many duties. Diana, Warrior Princess and Cindy had a crazy week, and now all they want is a nice makeup, a pedicure and a lovely outfit to wear out in town for a movie and pizzas. And who is going to make it all happen? That's right, you! Be their stylist and help them feel good!

title: Demolition Man
description: Prepare for a combat as Demolition Man with a mission to complete each task assigned. Pick guns and bullets and get ready to survive incoming waves of enemy forces out to destroy you.

title: Princesses Love Lips Art
description: Arabian Princess, Princess Mermaid and Chinese Princess are getting ready for the biggest party of the year which is held in the campus. Everyone from the university is going to be there, including their crushes, so the princesses want to have a special and unique look tonight. An interesting and extraordinary lip art is just what they need and you are going to make create their makeup, then you have to pick their outfit, hairstyle and the accessories. Have fun!

title: Airport Rush
description: Airport Rush is an HTML5 game in where you have to manage an airport traffic. Control the flow of traffic from landing, docking and taking off. You'll have to make an aircraft use the runway one at a time. You cannot make them land and take off in the same runway at the same time. There are three terminals, and every terminal has a number of gates. Remember that the higher number of gates the higher number of planes you can cater. Play Airport Rush now and see how many plane you safely control from landing to take off!

title: Match Arena!
description:
Step in the Arena! World’s first Match 3 against real players. Absolutely new approach to the Match 3 games. You’ll definitely like it! Addictive game play: swap and match, make new friends along the way and be part of a breath-taking adventure all at once!
Test your strategy and skill against real opponents or connect with friends in live Match 3 action on hundreds of levels with unique settings, gorgeous effects and unexpected turns. New super PvP mechanics and super experiences.
Play and climb to the Golden League of Match Arena by completing exciting challenges on your way up! Let the cutest piggy-magic accompany you in your exciting and challenging journey.
Taste of the victory in Match Arena is sweeter than candy!

title: Archery
description: Archery is a simple HTML5 game that will test you shooting skills. Drag your mouse and aim your bow and arrow in the right trajectory. Kill your opponents as fast as you can before it kills you. Aim for the head because that's the fastest way to eliminate your enemies. Kill as many as you can and have your name at the leaderboard!

title: Pirate Jewel Collapse
description: Collapse groups of three or more of the same connected jewels. Click on connected groups (diagonal is also allowed). Reach the indicated goal

description: Stickman War is an Action/Shooter game where your mission is kill all the stickman to complete the game.

title: Balloon Defense Html5
description: Defend your star from the balloons! Throw bombs to the balloons to pop them. Do not let any balloon go near your star. Pop as many as you can and defend your star for as long as you can to get greater points that may put you in the highscore list! Play Balloon Defense now!

title: Cat and Ghosts
description: Defend your human from ghosts that will attack him while sleeping. They will try to wake him up so better slash them away. As the nights go longer the ghosts increases and different kinds of it appears. Make it through the whole nine nights to finish the game. You'll have three lives and if you lose, your score will be submitted to the leaderboard. Play Cat and Ghosts now and see how many nights you can survive!

title: Wrestle Jump Online
description: From the simple yet addicting game Wrestle Jump comes a multiplayer game Wrestle Jump Online. Now you can play it with random players or with your friends using another pc connected in the internet. Jump around and flip your opponent to the ground! Win five rounds to finish the game and emerge victorious in this action WebGL game!

title: Super Start
description: The world is being threatened by bugs and you have the mission to lead Super Start in this task, in a game that honors the classics of the 80s / 90s. Super Start is a frenetic arcade that resembles the difficulty of 8-bit games, where perseverance is the key to completing the game! How many points can you reach? Can you make it to the end? It only depends on you!

title: Space Defense
description: Build towers strategically and defend Hearth from an alien invasion.

title: Olivia Real Haircuts
description: Olivia wants to change her look! Help her find a hairstyle that really suits her. Cut her hair, curl it, straighten it, or color it until you find the perfect combination. Put your creativity at work and give Olivia a whole new makeover.

title: Masquerade Ball Fashion Fun
description: Audrey, Jessie and Yuki are getting ready to go to a Masquerade Fashion Ball. Choose one of the girls and pick your favorite outfit for her. The other girls will join them on this important night, with their own fashion choices!

title: Princess Movie Night
description: The two princesses are getting ready for an awesome thrilling night of watching their favorite movies, but they need your help to decorate the room, and pick out what snacks they should munch on. Finally, you can give them cool 3d glasses, and find them a comfortable outfit fit for lounging around in front of their favorite films!

title: Victoria's Retro Real Makeover
description: Victoria, as a modern designer, knows that fashion trends always return, so you shouldn't be surprised that she's planning on a retro makeover as her latest look. Join her during this beauty treatment, apply face masks, correct imperfections and clean her face. Then, find the best make-up and pick your favorite outfit, hair-styling and accessories. With your help she'll be retro-chic, cute and timeless!

title: Princesses Home Decor Experts
description: Ice Princess and Ana have just started their interior design business and they already have so many clients. The sisters have to decorate two bathrooms, two livings and two gardens and the deadline is due very soon. This means that each sister has to work on a project, as this way they will have time to finish all the establishments. You can show off your decorator skills and help out the girls as they really need it. Get creative and start designing something wonderful! Have fun!

title: Princesses Contest: Stripes vs Dots
description: Ice Princess and Ana have signed up for a fashion contest and each of the has been given a theme. Ana's theme is dots while Ice Princess's is stripe. Both girls have to create an outfit, a makeup and a hairstyle. They are allowed to work with a stylist and that's going to be you. Before applying the makeup make sure to pluck their eyebrows and use a face cleanser and concealer. Help them pick the best dress and get the winner look. Have fun!

title: Princesses College Reunion
description: This fair lady has just found out from Arabian Princess that there's going to be a college reunion tomorrow. Warrior Princess is going as well and she is so excited about meeting up with her ex classmates, finding out about what they did in take last year. The princesses would like to look good on this event so become their stylist. You need to create their makeup, hairstyle and outfit. Have fun!

title: Princesses New Year's Party Day and Night
description: Blondie and Diana are going to have a wonderful New Year's Eve celebration because they have traveled in the most beautiful tropical paradise to celebrate the last day of the year partying day and night. This morning all they have to do, is get ready for the longest and best party of the year! You of course, are going to be their stylist. Prepare their daytime and night time party makeup and outfit. Have fun!

title: Princesses Remembering Christmas
description: It's the most wonderful time of the year! Warrior Princess, Cindy and Aura are getting ready for a Christmas shopping spree, as they can't wait to decorate their house in the lovely christmassy spirit. The girls also want to buy new outfits for the holidays and the xmas party. But the girls want to look great on this shopping session, so help them dress up in something cute, cozy and warm. Beside the outfit, they also need their hair and nails done, so get creative and have fun!

Primer and foundation are necessary before applying make-up, and a lip balm will keep your lips hydrated. Setting powder prepares your face for make-up, and a hydrating mist will help set the make-up so it'll last longer. Mix and mach the make up and outfits and create cool looks.

Place your ships according your logic, how will be hardest hitting, or choose the cube to replace it random. Try to be the first player to sink all of the opposing players' ships wins the game. Brilliant game for encouraging logical thinking!

Play smart and bounce balls off the walls to reach strategically important bubbles - dropping big clusters can give you a huge bonus! Use powerful boosters to score even more points and try to reach the highest score!

Use your fine dentist skills to take care of her cavity and apply a filling, while also distracting Audrey to calm the pain. Thanks to you, Audrey's teeth will shine!

description: Farm Clash 3D is themed first-person shooter game. Find your favorite firearm and shoot it out in the multiplayer farm world. Try to hit your opponents while avoiding being shoot yourself. If you enjoy the action of 3D FPS games, Farm Clash is a must see browser game.

description: Well, the goal of Snow Battle.io is to receive XP points, increase your frags counter and control the arena. Try different strategies in Snow Battle.io and use the most effective one. Snow Battle.io can be played solo, with friends or with online players all over the world.

So, when she uploaded it on the internet, it became viral and most of the people wanted to make some for their lovely pets, too! Can you follow each step to make a successful puppy cupcake?

This lovely school girl named Ana and her sister named Wendy, are excited for their first day of school. They have stunning school uniforms to choose from and as well as accessories. Do you like any of these activities? So come try it yourself and you will see that this game offers much more than this and that you will do not want to play anything else! Have fun.

Regardless of device, play the same crossword puzzle as everybody else - Easy selection of puzzle grid to insert answers - Virtual keyboard for mobile and tablet users. Easily enter your answers to solve the puzzles - Random puzzles generated from a pool of questions and answers - Relaxing theme, suitable for everyone

title: Frosty Foxy
description: Help the sly fox and his family to collect beautiful crystals in the snowy Arctic. To collect the crystals, use the keys right and left, to jump, press the space bar or the up arrow. When you recruit a certain number of crystals, you can unlock other characters from the fox family.

title: Free Rally 2
description: Here's the most anticipated sequel of the WebGL driving game Free Rally! This part two is packed with more action and a new map to play in. Roam around the city or compete in a race with other players of the game. Choose from a long list of vehicles that you can drive. There are cars, motorcycles, buggy, trucks and even a helicopter. You can also be the police and stop all the speeding vehicles and it's game over for them. This game will definitely give you that fun you've been looking for.

title: Circle Clock
description: Tap or click in the right time and try to cover clockwise with same color in watch. The clockwise will go with different speed and in different s ways, so it will be fun and interesting. Try to get the best score and enjoy.

description: Welcome to ROBOTIC Sports: Tennis; create your very own robot and challenge yourself in the sport of tennis. There are four modes that you can choose from, Tournament, Challenge, Practice and 2 Player mode. In Tournament, you'll have to play three rounds against increasingly more difficult rivals! Each round consists of one set match that you have to win. While in Practice mode, you'll play a match with your own rules! Set your rival's level and select from hardcore, grass or clay to play on. In Challenge mode there are three games that you can choose from, Hit the Target, Wall Bounce and Balloon Pop which are all fun and exciting to play. Lastly the 2 Player Mode where you can play with a friend and have fun. Earn lots of points while playing the game and you might end in the leaderboard or unlock all the achievements of this game. Pet your racket and play now!

Collect magic eggs to transform Chuck into his alter ego super hero.

OOval will makes you crazy!

But be careful, there are a lot of evil monsters, tricky obstacles and deadly traps that will be waiting for him on his adventure!

Have fun with Yummy Fusion and see how far you can get.

description: Bounce the incoming ball with a head butt! Miss 3 and its game over!

description: Audrey was on her way home when she discovered an abandoned Pomeranian puppy by the road, so she decided to take it home. Help our heroine clean up the cute dog, treat the fleas, brush its fur, feed it and officially adopt the puppy, Pom Pom.

title: Cat Simulator: Kitty Craft!
description: Be a cute little cat for a day in this fun and cute game Cat Simulator: Kitty Craft! Catch mice, break some vases, ruin some food and annoy people. Unlock all the seven places and explore by finishing all the quests. Customize your kitty by using the coins you earned from finishing your missions and purchasing clothes, collar, pendant and even a hat. You can also feed, wash and play with your kitty. Play this game now and enjoy the feline life!

title: Adam & Eve 5 Part 2
description: Adam and Eve 5: Part 2 is the second part of the fifth episode in the Adam and Eve series. In this episode, the goal is to help the game character Adam to continue his journey and find true love. Each level features challenges and logic puzzles. Can Adam finally meet the beautiful Eve?

Adam and Eve 5: Part 1 is another cool adventure in the fun Adam and Eve series. This time, Adam has run away from his previous love and wants to find a new soul mate! You must help him complete a variety of different challenges to persevere and find his Eve. 
This is a point & click game and you must interact with various different objects on each level to solve the puzzle and help Adam move forward. As you progress the challenges become harder but you will get ever closer to your true love! Can you help Adam achieve his goal?

title: Crocodile Simulator Beach Hunt
description: Be a hungry crocodile and hunt food at the beach. Take a bite from humans, squid, dolphin and even a big whale! Don't let the crocodile die in hunger so better give all it wants to eat. There are two beaches that you can explore and see if there's anything edible. Play  Crocodile Simulator Beach Hunt now and fill this hungry hungry croc with lots of meat!

title: Impossible Ball Glow Twist
description: Impossible ball glow twist is an amazing arcade, endless, runner, spin game. You exist as a bouncy ball and your aim is to run zig zag, jump right to left and stay in the line. Avoid falling of block, square cubes. As you run, you collect shiny jewels reward. The world consists of neon/glow tile cube boxes (similar to piano tiles). Other may say that reminds a some geometry hexagon or octagon spiral way. As time progresses, the world changes its color. The background ( sky ) is made by particles that are made from jelly dots, speed clouds, arrow phases, circle and stars. At some point you are in rainbow magic fairy tale world. Became a forward risk tapster, maximize your rush progress in this vector road world.

title: Crazy Machines
description: Drag the machine to rotate its arm and smash the approaching enemies. Survive and smash all the enemy. Buy better weapons or a spaceship can make it easier for you to pass! Crazy Machines features various upgraded machines with different skins to use and an endless levels.

title: Color Bump 3D
description:
Color Bump 3D does what it says on the tin. You – a sphere – bump objects in 3D. Well, only the objects of YOUR colour– touch anything else and you shatter into a million tiny pieces. There’s no coming back from that.
Such a simple concept then, but it’s easy to find yourself failing a specific level over and over again.

title: Golf Park
description: Its time to play golf. Golf park is a simple and addictive game. Like a normal golf you need to get the ball into the hole. Just tap to load the ball power and release to hit a shot. You get 10 balls and at every point you get a new ball to hit. Start playing and make a highscore.

title: Donut Shooter
description: A fun game which you will match all the same donuts and to pop them before they pass through line. The sweetness in this game depends on your play so match them as you can. Enjoy!

title: Starship Runner
description: Starship Runner features spaceship customization, easy control & endless game-play.

title: Coloruid 2
description: Welcome to the world of bright colors! In Coloruid 2, you have to turn the whole playing field into one color by strategically changing others. Pay attention, because you can't make any mistakes!

title: Summer Lake 1.5
description: Summer lake is the new free fishing game. In this game you can catch Bluegill, Bowfin, Crucian, Redhorse, Sunfish, Northern pike, Gar, Buffalo, Snakehead, Velifer. For every caught fish, you will get money. With this money you can buy new bait, rods and fishing places. The game have 6 places, 24 baits, 7 types of a fishing rods. And this game is completely free!

title: Green Lake
description: In the game Green Lake are hiding the most large fish. Going out fishing with the game, you can discover the most beautiful fishing areas. Your goal is to catch as many fish as you can. Catch small and big fish, try to get all improvement: a new place, a rods, a lures.

title: Go Fish
description: Throw your hook to have a big catch. Try to avoid the barrels, especially the big one with the skull on it, because you will die. Try to catch fish as much as possible so you will have a point and big high score. Enjoy!

title: Gold Miner HTML5
description: The main task in this HTML game is to collect gold. Collect only gold and avoid the stones. You especially need to avoid the stone with skull, because if you touch it you will die.

title: Galaxy
description: You are in the Galaxy in the endless shooting game. Click with your mouse on left or right side on your screen, and the spaceship will start to move in that way. Avoid the bullets from your enemy, or you will turn to the beginning.

title: French Fashion Real Haircuts
description: Let's learn about French haircuts. Get your scissors and let your creativity run free. Cut, trim, curl and straighten hair. Try to get a daring look! After that, put some accessories and choose an outfit for this beautiful French girl. Have fun!

title: Animal Detectives Investigation Mischief
description: Bunny Cop and Fox Detective have no time to waste on their investigation of a missing otter, help them run a license plate sneakily at the DMV, before the sloths catch up. Use bonuses to get more time and progress to cause a little mischief to the fastest working sloth.

title: Jessie's Winter Fashion
description: Winter is here and Jessie knows it's time to change your wardrobe for the season! Prepare with our favorite tomboy for a family party, pick a fashionable outfit, do her makeup and she'll be ready for a festive evening!

title: Audrey Venice Carnival Fashion
description: Explore the mysterious fashion of the Venice Carnival with Audrey! Dress up the glamorous fashionista in one of a kind ball gowns inspired by the carnival and don't forget to accessorize. Masks, dresses, fans, fabulous makeup and hairdos are all important for a successful Venetian costume, combine them to create your very own.

title: Valentine's Day Singles Party
description: Valentine's Day can be quite annoying when you're single, but Audrey found a way to celebrate this day with her best friends Jessie and Victoria at a Singles Party. Help the girls pick out the best decorations for the party and dress them up in chic outfits.

title: Nymphiad
description: Somewhere in the dark mazes beneath the temple of Tithonus a lost nymph seeks the way back to the world of daylight. However this journey won't be easy. Nobody can be sure that the chosen path is right in this cursed place.

title: Basket Ball
description: A fun and quick Basket Ball Game. Simply shoot the ball to the hoops! Set high-scores and beat your previous records!

title: Wild Animal Zoo City Simulator!
description: Wild Animal Zoo City Simulator is action, casual adventure game, where you play as a crazy, angry, frenzy and stupid animals in city. Your aim is to cause destruction, mess, wreck, demolish, ram, smash everything interactive and also annoy citizens. In your mission you gain points and experience, the faster you get them the more bonus you receive. Town environment contains a lot of obstacles such as explosive cars, pixel fence, barrels, block lawns, streetlights, street hydrants, cube dustbins and many other. You can choose from a range of different animals including a crocodile, an elephant, a hippo and a lion. Help them escape and cause mayhem on the city streets!

title: Urban Counter Terrorist Warfare
description: Are you a fan of the good old counter terrorist battles? Here is some news for you: There is the best 3D third person shooter in real-time. Take the part in the vanguard at the battlefield of urban counter terrorist warfare! You can enjoy the improved graphics and enticing sound effect of this free online game!

title: Traffic Car Racing
description: Traffic Car Racing is a fun driving game in which you can experience the joy of city driving in 4 modes - You can play free mode, traffic mode, checkpoint mode or the drift mode. Accumulate cash and use it to upgrade new cars.

title: Sportbike Simulator
description: Try this game and you may like the motorcycles. Three models of sports bike are at your disposal to try, and feel the adrenaline. Choose the map and bike and start to drive it where you want and at a speed that suits you on the road. Be careful, you can lose the control easy, but don't worry, thanks to God, it's just a game, you can start again.

title: Stunt Simulator Multiplayer
description: Stunt Simulator Multiplayer is a cool multiplayer online driving simulation game to to prove your skills behind the wheel of a stunt car. You can do all kinds of stunts on different maps with friends and players from all over the world. Try to earn enough points and show off your crazy stunts. Get rewarded for the tricks that you manage to pull off.  Test and master your car and make perfect stunts in constant acceleration. The more stunts you do, the higher the score. Can you be the highest scorer? Enter the game and prove your strength.

title: Knife Rain
description: A game that can make more excitement as you throw a knife to the rolling wood. Keep your eye on throwing so can hit a vacant area without an existing knife. Let's test out your ability how you can manage to throw them.

title: Red Html5
description:
Developer Bart Bonte has struck again with another part of the famous colorful puzzle game series!
The sequel to the famous  'Yellow'  and 'Black' games is here, and this time you'll manage the red color! In all possible states and shapes!
Can you make the screen red in 25 levels?
Each level has its own logic, good luck and enjoy!

title: Cheer Up Moody Ally
description: Moody Ally is sad and needs your help to cheer up! Take her on a fun walk in the park with her lovely friends. Cook one of 3 delicious snacks to keep her happy! And of course, help her stay creative by coloring her drawings! Will you brighten her day?

title: Happy Glass Online
description: This glass is happy because it always filled with water, but today it lost all it's water, so it becomes sad. now you are the only person can save it, draw a line to make the water flow down, if the glass filled with water, it will become happy again. there are many levels waiting for you, Have fun!

title: Offroad Racer
description: Offroad Racer is a very challenging 3D racing game where you have to drive on a rough terrain. Choose from the five awesome cars and start racing. Manage your way driving through steep slopes and uneven roads. Finish all three laps and be the first one to get to the finish line. Play this game now and see if you can win the race using all the cars!

title: Slendrina Must Die: The House
description: Legend says that the house is haunted by a creepy woman named Slendrina, the creature who can't be killed. Armed with a pistol you need to find a way to escape the house. Defend yourself from that scary lady, the only way to finish her is to collect all the papers that will show her secret. You need to act fast before she really gets you! Play this game now and have that chilling experience and prove that Slenderina can die!

title: Small Journey
description: Small Journey is a fun adventure game where you the valiant Knight from the Hero Village has been given quests that you must fulfill. Explore the map and increase your experience by fighting the monsters. You'll be rewarded for every victory with gold. Use that gold in purchasing items that can increase your stat and will make your more powerful so you can finish all your mission. Play Small Journey and unlock all the achievements and fight all the monsters and emerge victoriously so you can be in the leaderboard. Unsheathe your sword now and start slaying!

title: Slide Blocks Puzzle
description: Easy to play and amazing game for all age. Play it for free now! "Slide blocks : the puzzle" is a simple and addictive puzzle game to challenge your mind.

description: Fire your employees before they can steal your donuts by standing in their ways. Move from lane to lane using the number 1-5 keys.

title: Cannon Ship
description: Cannon ship is a classic shooter game but with modern touches! This is not another typical classic horizontal scrolling shooter game! It’s impressive, great pure arcade game! You can upgrade your ship, destroy a bosses and many different enemies!

title: Grapple Ninja
description: Pull yourself towards victory in this fast paced physics adventure! Use your grappling hook to collect coins and avoid traps.

title: Ariel Save Nemo
description: Ariel went out to take a vacation today, suddenly she find an injured fish and she recognized it's Nemo. She decide to take a surgery for him, can you help her?

title: Mini Golf
description: If you like playing golf but you don't have enough time, you can come here and try this golf online game. Shoot the ball into the hole in different mountains, you need to aim accurately, the fewer times you use, the higher score you will get. Show your golf talent and enjoy the time with your friends!

title: Marine Invaders
description: Buckle up and get your submarine ship ready to shoot against the onslaught of marine invaders. Collect and purchase upgrades to fortify your ship!

title: Couple Fashion
description: Dress up this beautiful couple for their first date. Choose from lots of fashion items and create stylish outfits.

title: Color Me Girlsplay
description: Join our Girlsplay girls and have fun creating the most awesome artwork in our coloring book. Choose either to color a custom drawing or put your imagination to work and create your own story line.

title: Avoid The Balls
description: Avoid The Balls is a simple yet challenging HTML5 game. Collect all the yellow rectangles and avoid all the balls. It might seem easy but wait until you play it. Once you collect the yellow rectangle, it'll be replaced with a bouncing ball. The many rectangles you collected the more the balls will appear and crowd the area making it hard to avoid it. This is a matter of skill and fast reflexes. You only have five lives, use it well. Play this game now and collect as many as you can and be one in the leaderboard!

title: Mummy Plastic Surgery
description: A mummy was discovered and with science had come back to life! Now it's time for you to make her look alive. Give her that youthful skin and a perfect smile with clean pearly white teeth. Do her make-up and glam her up. Dress her into a very fashionable outfit. Make her one of the Millennials and not the old mummy she once before. Play this fun HTML5 game, Mummy Plastic Surgery. And give this mummy a complete transformation. Unlock all the achievements as you play this game and share your creation with other players by grabbing the screenshot of your best work!

title: School Day Preps
description: It's Princess Annie's first day in college and she wants a good first impression. Give her a glam make up and dress her up in a very fashionable outfit!

title: Summer Fun
description: The three princesses are out for a summer break, and they wanted to go to the famous waterpark. Princess Riley already has her swimsuit and will take the two sisters to the store and picks the best swimsuit that they can ever find. Dress them up in a very glam bathing suit with matching sandals and sunglasses!

title: Mouse Connection
description: Can you connect the indicated food for the mouse? The goal is given top left. Connect the food vertically or horizontally.

title: The Little Pet Shop in the Woods
description: The princess just opened the Little Pet Shop In The Woods, but it's a bit empty. Help her gather coins to create the cute woodland creatures. Sell them to customers and gather more coins in order to find all the secret pets. Have fun!

title: Block Crush
description: Block Crush is an HTML5 mouse skill game where the only goal of this game is to crush the blocks at the right time. There are some blocks that will trick you so be cautious.

title: Princesses Adventures
description: The ever green beauty Emma, Mia and Audrey are getting bore and dull on their regular royal looks and outfits. They decided to take the new looks for them today and they planned to have adventures outfits like in the Residential Evil series. Will be the part of their costume selection? Then here you go! Rock the princess world!

title: Bongo Beat Down
description: First fight it out to see who wins the super attack, Then brawl it out by dashing around the screen and attacking each other. First to 2 wins, wins the game!

title: Ball Battle
description: Ball Battle is a very simple game to play. You are the white ball in the middle trying to avoid all of the other balls that are larger than you. Yet the way to increase your score is to eat (run into) the other balls that are smaller than you. When you eat a ball the radius (size) of you cicle increases. But you must remember that as your ball gets bigger, the other balls will increase in their size as well. Another addition to the game is that when your score reaches a multiple of 50, (50,100,150 etc.) then your ball (and the other balls) will go back to their original starting size. As well as the speed of ALL balls will slightly increase making it more difficult. Don't worry though, you will keep your score, all that happens is the balls go back to the size they started as. Now you might be thinking, "that's kinda dumb." On the contrairy actually, if you ball never resets in size, then the other balls will keep getting bigger, and so will your ball. And eventually after you have reached a certain score, it will be impossible for you to continue without running into a ball that is larger than you. Therefore your would receive a game over, and that would just be unfair.

title: Jungle TD
description: Jungle TD is a a 3d tower defense game with a theme of jungle, your objective is to protect the base by placing right defenses at right spots. Monsters will start coming in waved as soon as battle is started. Plan your strategy to choose the effective defense against monsters. Don't let them reach the tent. Good Luck

title: Dockyard Car Parking
description: Dockyard Car Parking features 45 challenging levels with different obstacles to pass. Enjoy realistic parking simulator with 2 awesome cars that have car upgrades and customization you will surely enjoy!

title: Feed the Mouse
description: The mouse is hungry! Feed the mouse by collecting cheese, ham and bread. But beware of the various obstacles. Get cakes for upgrades by collecting food, earning achievements and completing the different levels.

title: Color Trouble 3D
description: Color Trouble 3D is a mouse skill game where the only goal is to pass by the obstacles with the same color of the ball. Those obstacles that have different color from the ball should be avoided. Each level has different difficulties. Also, be careful with the obstacles because it may trick you and move from time to time. Have fun playing this exciting game!

title: Maths Challenge
description: This game needs a fast thinking about mathematics. You can choose either addition, subtraction, division, multiplication, or mix. You need to be hurry because of the time limit and get the highest score as possible.

title: Kitty Paradise
description: Kitty Paradise is an exciting cat quest game where you will act as a cat who will be doing several tasks before proceeding to the next stage. Each stage will have its own difficulty so be very quick in finding those things that you need to interact with. There will be also a running time so you need to move fast in accomplishing the tasks. You can select different kinds of cat according to your liking.

title: Basket Training
description: Train that shooting skills in this fun and challenging HTML5 game Basket Training. Try to shoot on those three hoops with a corresponding score. Every successful shot the points will double its value. The higher the points you earn the greater the chance of being in the leaderboard. Make every shot counts because you'll be playing for a limited time only. Play now and see how many points you can earn.

title: Peacemakers 1919
description:
Redraw the borders of the world after a global conflict. Inspired by the Paris peace talks of 1919.
You must meet the needs of the people, their countries and their diplomats, by drawing short borders, without isolated pockets , following landmarks and the distribution of nationalities.

title: Crazy Climb Racing
description: Drive on a rough terrain where you have to do uphill driving in this fun WebGL game, Crazy Climb Racing. Start the race with a simple car and drive the mountainous road. Collect all the coins and fill your car with fuel, so you can finish the game. With the coins you have collected you can unlock all the vehicles like trucks, motorcycle and even a tank. You can also unlock new roads to drive through. Play this game now and see how long can you balance your vehicle.

title: Jumbled io
description: Find the matching letters in the awesome jumble and move them into the matching boxes at the bottom of the game. The more letters you have collected in a sequence, the bigger your points boost will be.But watch out, other players can ruin your collection success - use the lock icon to protect your collected letters!

title: Stickman Rise Up
description: Stickman Rise Up Escape is an amazing endless game in which you must help our heroic stickman rise into the sky with his balloon. You must help the stickman to protect the balloon from hitting any obstacle.

title: Super Rush Street Racing
description: Choose your super model sport car and start with race. Try to overtake all members in the race, reach at the end, win the price, which you can spend it on upgrading your car. Unlock the new maps filled with picturesque nature, mountains, various curved and sharp turns, a fishing town, beach and so many places that will be great. Enjoy your race!

title: Puzzle Brain
description: Is your memory in good condition? Well, you can test it in this game. Try to remember the place and blocks, which hide the orange kittens at the start of each level, and later when all blocks will be black, guess the right ones.

description: Make-up is fun for everybody! Follow our beauty guru's tutorial for interesting beauty tips. Primer and foundation are necessary before applying make-up, and a lip balm will keep your lips hydrated. Setting powder prepares your face for make-up, and a hydrating mist will help set the make-up so it'll last longer. Have fun applying make-up and choosing a cool outfit and hairstyle fit for a beauty guru!

title: More Fashion Do's and Dont's
description: Are your ready for more fashion do's and dont's? Rachel is going to donate all of her clothes and buy some new ones. You'll have to teach her which clothes suits her apple shaped body best. Audrey has some advice too so that you can help Rachel learn all about Fashion DO'S and DONT's.

title: Gothic Princess Real Makeover
description: It's Halloween time and this princess wants to try on a whole new Pastel Goth style to go with it! With your help she'll dye her hair black and enjoy a wonderful spa session. Try on edgy make-up, and then pick out her dress, hairstyling, jewelry and pets.

title: Battlestar Mazay
description: Two-dimensional arcade shooter about the adventures of Mazay, who tried on the role of captain of the star cruiser.

title: Baby Hazel: Newborn Vaccination
description: Today is vaccination day for Baby Matt!! But he is fast asleep and Hazel is trying all tricks to wake him up. Can you assist Hazel in taking care of Matt in this endearing sibling care game? Keep Matt busy by playing with him so that he does not cry while being vaccinated.

title: Piggy Night
description: Fly and launch the pig and evade all the wondering creatures. Don't bump on them or else they will eat you. Make a highest score as possible. You can also get a protection to prevent you to back from the start. Enjoy!

description: Drag the ball left or right to position it. Quickly swipe or trace a curve to roll the ball.

Therefore, you must create a family, give birth to cubs and improve your home. In addition, the panda can help other pandas by performing various tasks.

How to be popular : * Collect followers from anywhere on the map! * Grab other players' followers to eliminate them! * Lead hundreds of people and show them who's the boss!

title: Rally Racer
description: Step on the gas, push your car to the limit and complete every race. Good luck!

title: Baby Hazel: Flower Girl
description: Wow! Baby Hazel's Aunt Lisa is getting married and in her wedding she wants Baby Hazel to be her Flower Girl. Baby Hazel is very excited for this and hence she goes for shopping with her mom. Baby Hazel is very choosy for her dress, so help her in selecting dress, shoes and accessories best suitable for her. Fun is not finished yet. She needs some makeover to look very pretty. Help her with her makeup to make her look most beautiful girl and finally dress her up as Flower Girl.

Hit all bottles, the better your accuracy the more stars you will earn.

description:
Fly your spaceship across space and try to destroy as many aliens as you can. While fighting the enemy, you also need to dodge asteroids that are blocking your path.
Thankfully, your spaceship is protected with a shield that can absorb most of the damage.

Try to memorise the place of the super hero cards, and match the two same to clean all cards.
If both hidden images match, then you get some points and the images are removed. If the images don't match then they hide again and you can continue searching for a matching pair. The more you can remember, than better for your.

description: Bubble Shooter Pet features three star ranking system in level mode, endless mode with many levels to play and an awesome new bubbles and power ups.

description: Archery apple shooter features a fun realistic game of physics with shooting distance ranking system , endless mode & addictive game play you will surely enjoy!

description: Do you like waterball fight ?

Wait for the right moment to shoot the ball past these players as they pass back and forth in front of the goal.

Bats are invading your castle, and the only way to fend off them is to solve Math problems. You can choose from addition, subtraction, multiplication, or a mix of the three. 
Solve the math puzzle on time and shoot, before the bat pass the dotted line.

Fishing game Willow pond immerses you deep into the fun and beauty of Lake fishing. 
In the game are hiding the most large fish and are new beautiful places. This is the closest you can get to real fishing from the comfort of your own office.

Vary your shooting technique and bend your kicks to defeat the walls and the keeper. Aim for the target or the corners to score bonus points. Do you have what it takes to earn a high score and win the cup?

Set in a mysterious ancient temple, your task is to move all cards onto the four foundation piles, sorted by suit and rank in ascending order from Ace to King. On the field, cards can only be sorted in descending order alternating colors. Choose between two card designs, a 1 and 3 card mode and the position of your deck for your convenience. Can you achieve a high score?

description: Do you have what it takes to win the World Cup? Prove your free kick skills in this fast-paced 3D soccer game! Swipe to shoot and try to achieve the target score in every round. Collect stars to unlock cool new brushes and avoid the bombs at all costs. Dunk as many balls as you can and earn a high score!

title: Fallout Racer
description: A nuclear catastrophe has left the earth in ruins. You play as a lonesome survior in desperate need for water. Escape ground zero and race your truck through a destroyed landscape. Try to be fast and collect as many water bottles as possible. Be careful not to tip your vehicle over and reach the goal in each level!

title: Thug Racer
description: Join the two wannabe thugs Ratty and Weasel on an epic driving journey inspired by an 80s arcade classic! Start the engine and feel the speed as you race across the tracks. Outrun other cars on your way to any of the five goal lines - the decision is yours as to which track you'll travel. Watch out for speed traps along the way - the police are there to do their job and you are not going to make their life easy!

title: Kuu Kuu Harajuku DIY Kawaii Stickers
description: Unleash your creativity and decorate these lovely rooms. You get to choose what character will be included in the scene.

title: Giant Rabbit Run
description: Giant Rabbit Run is an HTML5 game where you will control this adorable bunny. Collect coins and easter eggs along the way and don't forget to switch lanes if needed. Avoid the obstacles by switching lanes, jumping, or gliding down. Have fun playing this awesome and interactive game!

title: High School Gossip
description: Rob has just landed back from his trip to Europe. Join and read the conversation with his best friends. And in their conversation, the main topics are Rob's Euro trip and those hot gossips at High School.

title: Air War 1941
description: The open skies are your battlefield in this scrolling shooter game. Pilot your fighter plane as you engage enemy aircraft in thrilling dog fights. Move through the level trying to gun down as many enemy airplanes as possible. Collect as many coins as possible to make the best score, who will win the battle for air superiority?

title: Stunt Planes
description: How good are you to flight ? Cross to hoops with booster on to get a max of points! Thousands levels to complete!

title: Moto Traffic
description: Moto Traffic features 4 game modes 3 environments and colorful motorcycle skins.

title: Girls Fix It: Audrey Spring Cleaning
description: Audrey has a beautiful house, but she wants to start spring-cleaning! She needs your help to vacuum, clean the grimy windows and repair the tears in the wallpaper. After that you can decorate her living room together and change her outfit!

title: Cleopatra Real Haircuts
description: The queen of Egypt is getting a new haircut! In this Real Haircuts title you have the amazing privilege to cut, trim and dye Cleopatra's beautiful black hair. Born to be a leader, Cleopatra will choose anything golden so you can let your imagination explore a wealthy golden world to create a stunning hairstyle. Be the queen's artist and make endless combinations of colors, hair length and royal style. Maybe a golden scarabaeus hairpin will finish the creative act along with a mummy dress to remember the mysterious side of Cleopatra. Have fun as a queen's hairstylist!

title: Cam & Leon Donut Hop
description: Hop in and out of donuts, but don't hit the obstacles! Cam and Leon Donut Hop features 2 funny and cute characters, hopping their way around the park.

title: Chuck Chicken Memory Match
description: Match your favorite Chuck Chicken cards, and do it in the shortest amount of time! Discover cool cards featuring Chuck, Flick, Wing as well as nemesis cards including Dr Mingo, Dee, Don, Dex.

title: Subway Runner
description: In Subway Runner the player is taking the role of Jim, a teenager who spends all of his free time on the streets of a huge metropolis. He and his friends are often engaged in such activities as drawing graffiti and skateboarding – usually while running away from the ever-vigilant policemen. Your main goal in this game is to run away from them as long as possible while drawing as many graffiti as you can. Police cars are fast, but you must be faster. Navigate your path through the intricately tangled mess of the streets of the metropolis and try your best to avoid relentless cops who are fed up with your graffiti. You will meet a lot of various obstacles on the streets, such as police cars blocking the roadway or a bunch of crates left by negligent workers. To continue your race you’ll have to overcome these obstacles by jumping, turning on the left or on the right and diving under them. Collect coins and secrets along the way and become the living legend of the urban streets.

title: Battleships Ready Go!
description:
Battleships Ready Go is a guessing war game. Place your ships strategically across the open sea.
Then, try to sink the enemy ships, before own own navy ships are sunk.
Features:
Interactive tutorial
Fast paced music and gameplay
Millions of battleship arrangements, for hours of gameplay
Clever AI to compete against

title: Brick Breaker
description:
Drag the paddle to catch the steel ball. Bounce the ball against the bricks, to break them.
How high can you score?
Fans of Arkanoid and Breakout will appreciate this game!
Features:
Random levels
Cool powerup such as paddle elongation, extra health, twin guns and triple steel balls!
Interactive tutorial
Cool and sleek design suitable for the 21st century

title: Crazy Snake
description: This Crazy Snake wants to eat all kinds of fast foods like: cakes, burgers, pizza, cakes, pancakes, donuts, etc. Go in all directions and feed your snake to grow, but be careful, do not let bigger snakes, eat the yours.

title: Princess Double Date
description: The two princess BFFS are taking their boyfriends out on a double date. Dress up each couple, and pick out the perfect accessories and hairstyles for all of them. Then, decide where they'd have the best time around town! With your help, they'll have a wonderful double date!

title: Bunny Storm
description: Feed the blue monster. Be careful - there's a nasty bunny that tries to get in your way!

title: Elite Racing
description: Elite Racing features an in-game shop with 13 cars 4 tracks, multiple game modes with AI opponents -and car color customizations.

title: Yummy Slot Machine
description: If you enjoy free slot machine games, then Tasty slot machine is the game for you. Beautiful classic slot style gameplay comes with tasty food and big wins.

title: Flappy Cupid
description: Flappy Cupid is fun flapping html5 game suitable for all ages. Fly as long distance as possible and have fun. Happy Valentine!

title: Crazy Pixel Apocalypse 3
description:
Try Crazy Pixel Apocalypse 3 Survival multiplayer in 3D where you can fight against players and Bots zombie and soldier from all over the world. In this Edition FPS you can use multiple guns (from axes to sniper) and play with friends on incredible maps. Choose your weapon and start to wreak havoc and destruction in this SURVIVAL environment!
Battle against friends with a wide variety of weapons, including bazookas, mini-weapons, axes, shotguns, combat rifles, snipers, RPG and many others!

title: Fidget Spinner Scifi X Racer
description: Fidget Spinner Scifi X Racer is a game that requires much focus. Try to steer your flying fidget spinner and avoid getting hit by walls or any obstacles on the way. Be quick in keeping your spinner away from the moving blocks. Collect rings for additional points and get some power-ups on the way!
